In advanced implementations, particularly in BMC500 5.13.0 and later versions, PhysicalLocation is represented as an object field with sub-components including Info (read-only), InfoFormat (read-only), and PartLocationContext (readable), which together provide hierarchical and contextual details about the drive’s location within the same enclosure. These metadata fields enhance the precision of drive identification and management within complex storage architectures. The property is consistently described across sources as representing the physical position of a drive in relation to other components in a storage array, chassis, or rack, supporting system-level organization and maintenance assurance. While some descriptions emphasize a literal or fixed positional label like \"HDD Plane,\" others highlight the dynamic, hierarchical, and informative nature of the field, indicating that it not only denotes location but also carries formatted context for system management and diagnostics."}

{"reference_id": "4", "content": "---\ndate: 2025/12/31\ntitle: storage\n---\n---\n# Storage 存储管理服务\n\n## 版本信息\n\n| 项目     | 内容        |\n| :------- | :---------- |\n| 组件版本 | 1.100.41          |\n| 首发版本 | openUBMC 1.0.0 |\n| 文档作者 | openUBMC    |\n| 最后更新 | 2026-05-29  |\n\n## 1. 组件概述\n\n### 1.1 组件简介\n\nStorage（存储管理服务）是 openUBMC 系统中的存储组件管理模块，负责管理 RAID 控制器、物理硬盘、逻辑盘、磁盘阵列和超级电容（BBU）等存储资源。支持通过 I2C（博通 RAID 卡）和 MCTP（1880/PMC RAID 卡）两种通信方式实现带外管理，同时支持通过 BMA（Board Management Agent）获取带内信息。\n\n### 1.2 解决什么问题\n\nStorage 组件为用户提供了完整的 RAID 卡管理能力，包括 RAID 控制器状态监控与配置、物理盘健康检测与操作、逻辑盘的创建/删除/属性设置、磁盘阵列管理、BBU 状态监控等功能。通过 Storage 组件，用户可以在不依赖主机操作系统的情况下完成存储资源的全生命周期管理。\n\n### 1.3 核心功能\n\n- 控制器管理：支持 RAID 控制器信息获取、工作模式设置、回拷/JBOD/一致性校验等高级特性配置\n- 硬盘管理：支持物理盘信息获取、健康检测、热备设置、定位灯控制、固件状态管理等\n- 逻辑盘管理：支持逻辑盘创建（新建阵列/已有阵列/CacheCade）、删除、属性设置（读写策略/IO策略/访问策略等）\n- 阵列管理：支持磁盘阵列信息查询，包括容量、RAID类型、关联逻辑盘和物理盘\n- BBU 管理：支持超级电容状态监控、健康检测、温度监测\n- PHY 误码诊断：支持 SAS PHY 层误码采集、分析和告警\n- 配置导入导出：支持存储配置的备份和恢复\n- IPMI 命令：支持 55 个 OEM IPMI 命令，覆盖控制器/逻辑盘/物理盘/阵列的查询与设置\n\n### 1.4 关键术语表\n\n| 术语             | 解释                                                                 |\n| :--------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| SML              | Storage Management Library，RAID 卡管理库，通过 I2C 或 MCTP 与 RAID 卡通信 |\n| BMA              | Board Management Agent，主机侧代理，将主机端信息通过带内通道推送给 BMC |\n| PD               | Physical Drive，RAID 控制器下属的轻量物理盘对象，通过 SML 操作物理盘 |\n| Drive            | 统一物理盘模型，RAID 盘与 NVMe 盘共用，承载完整的物理盘属性和操作 |\n| Volume           | 逻辑盘对象，代表 RAID 控制器创建的逻辑磁盘 |\n| DiskArray        | 磁盘阵列对象，代表 RAID 控制器下的磁盘组 |\n| CacheCade        | SSD 缓存加速技术，使用 SSD 作为机械硬盘的读写缓存 |\n| JBOD             | Just a Bunch Of Disks，磁盘直通模式，不经过 RAID 控制器 |\n| BBU              | Battery Backup Unit，超级电容/电池备份单元，用于断电时保护缓存数据 |\n| 一致性校验       | 定期校验逻辑盘数据一致性的功能，支持自动修复 |\n| 回拷             | Copyback，当热备盘替换故障盘后，自动将数据从热备盘拷贝到新换上的盘 |\n\n### 1.5 外部交互边界图\n\n```mermaid\ngraph TB\n    subgraph 北向接口\n        Redfish[Redfish接口]\n        WEB[WEB-REST接口]\n        CLI[CLI命令行]\n        SNMP[SNMP接口]\n        IPMI[IPMI接口]\n    end\n\n    subgraph Rackmount仓\n        Rackmount[Rackmount<br/>北向接口映射]\n    end\n\n    subgraph Storage仓\n        Storage[Storage组件<br/>存储管理服务]\n    end\n\n    subgraph 南向依赖\n        hwproxy[hwproxy<br/>I2C通道管理]\n        libmgmt[libmgmt_protocol<br/>SML管理库]\n    end\n\n    subgraph RAID卡\n        BroadcomRAID[博通RAID卡<br/>SAS3108/3508/3408/3908]\n        PMCRAID[1880/PMC RAID卡]\n    end\n\n    Redfish -->|HTTP/HTTPS| Rackmount\n    WEB -->|HTTP/HTTPS| Rackmount\n    CLI -->|命令调用| Rackmount\n    SNMP -->|SNMP协议| Rackmount\n    IPMI -->|IPMI协议| ipmi_core[ipmi_core组件<br/>IPMI命令路由]\n\n    Rackmount -->|D-Bus资源协作接口| Storage\n    ipmi_core -->|调用注册函数| Storage\n\n    Storage -->|Plugin/I2C"}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "树对象（控制器、物理盘、逻辑盘等）\n4. 完成资源树对象上树，供应用层通过资源协作接口访问\n\n**SML兼容接口函数指针列表（表4）：**\n\n| 函数指针 | 功能描述 | libsml_dev实现说明 |\n| -------- | -------- | ----------------- |\n| `pfn_add_ctrl` | 添加RAID控制器到管理列表 | 注册控制器设备树节点 |\n| `pfn_remove_ctrl` | 从管理列表中移除控制器 | 注销控制器设备树节点 |\n| `pfn_init_ctrl_over_i2c` | 初始化LSI RAID控制器（I2C通信） | 初始化设备树访问通道 |\n| `pfn_exit_ctrl_over_i2c` | 退出LSI RAID控制器管理 | 释放设备树访问通道 |\n| `pfn_update_ctrl_cache` | 更新storelib缓存 | 刷新设备树节点数据 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_info` | 获取控制器基本信息 | 读取设备树Controller节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_sas_addr` | 获取控制器SAS地址 | 读取设备树Controller.SASAddr |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_health` | 获取控制器健康状态 | 读取设备树Controller.Status |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_bbu_status` | 获取BBU状态 | 读取设备树BBU.Stat节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_phy_err_count` | 获取控制器SAS PHY误码计数 | 读取设备树Controller.PHY.Metrics |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_exp_phy_err_count` | 获取Expander PHY误码（兼容旧接口） | 读取设备树Expander.PHY.Metrics |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_ld_list` | 获取逻辑盘ID列表 | 遍历设备树Volume节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_pd_list` | 获取物理盘列表 | 遍历设备树Drive节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ld_info` | 获取逻辑盘详细信息 | 读取设备树Volume节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_exp_list` | 获取Expander列表 | 遍历设备树Expander节点 |\n| `pfn_get_exp_phy_err_count` | 获取指定Expander PHY误码 | 读取设备树Expander.PHY.Metrics |\n| `pfn_get_ld_pd_list` | 获取逻辑盘成员盘列表 | 读取设备树Volume.Association |\n| `pfn_get_pd_info` | 获取物理盘详细信息 | 读取设备树Drive节点 |\n| `pfn_get_pd_smart_info` | 获取物理盘SMART信息 | 读取设备树Drive.Metrics |\n| `pfn_get_pd_smart_info_spec` | 按filter获取指定SMART项 | 读取设备树Drive.Metrics指定字段 |\n| `pfn_pd_operation` | 物理盘操作 | 通过设备树写入操作指令 |\n| `pfn_get_pd_log` | 获取物理盘日志 | 读取设备树Drive日志节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_array_list` | 获取阵列列表 | 遍历设备树DiskArray节点 |\n| `pfn_get_array_info` | 获取阵列信息 | 读取设备树DiskArray节点 |\n| `pfn_get_ctrl_boot_mode` | 获取BIOS启动模式 | 读取设备树Controller.Settings |\n| `pfn_config_operation` | RAID配置操作（创建LD） | 通过设备树写入RAID配置操作 |\n| `pfn_ld_operation` | 逻辑盘操作 | 通过设备树写入Volume操作指令 |\n| `pfn_ctrl_operation` | 控制器操作 | 通过设备树写入Controller操作指令 |\n| `pfn_diag_encl_comm_error` | Expander背板通信故障诊断 | 通过设备树获取诊断数据 |\n| `pfn_diag_pd_sense_error` | 硬盘sense code诊断 | 通过设备树获取Drive诊断数据 |\n| `pfn_mock_diag_ctrl_event` | 模拟插入RAID卡事件（诊断用） | 通过设备树写入模拟事件 |\n| `pfn_get_phy_diag_topo_info` | 获取PHY误码诊断拓扑信息 | 读取设备树PHY拓扑节点 |\n| `pfn_clear_ctrl_diag_event` | 清除RAID卡诊断事件 | 通过设备树写入清除指令 |\n| `pfn_register_handle_event_info` | 注册事件处理回调 | 注册设备树事件监听回调 |\n| `pfn_trans_drive_data` | 传输硬盘厂商数据 | 通过设备树传递厂商数据 |\n\n## 7.4 关键接口\n\n**libsml_dev库核心接口：**\n\n1. **初始化接口**：初始化libsml_dev库，建立设备树访问连接\n2. **函数指针注册接口**：向上层注册所有SML兼容函数指针\n3. **设备树读取接口**：按接口规范从设备树读取RAID各组件数据\n4. **设备树写入接口**：将操作指令写入设备树，驱动南向驱动执行\n\n# 8. Use Case五实现：南向RAID卡管理DFX功能兼容\n\n## 8.1 设计思路\n\nRAID卡管理切换到南向驱动模式后，需要确保原有的告警、传感器等DFX功能完整继承，与历史版本保持一致，无任何功能缺失。\n\n**实现思路：**\n\n1. **告警功能继承**：\n   -"}

{"reference_id": "6", "content": "---\ndate: 2026/04/29\ntitle: Storage 模块设计说明（4+1 视图）\n---\n---\n\n# Storage 模块设计说明（4+1 视图）\n\nStorage 组件是 openUBMC 中负责存储控制器、物理盘、阵列、逻辑盘等资源统一管理的独立子系统。本章节从软件架构 4+1 视图模型出发，对 Storage 模块的层级调用关系、SO 依赖关系以及核心对象之间的关联进行系统性说明。\n\n> 代码仓地址：`https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/storage`\n\n## 一、逻辑视图（领域模型与对象关系）\n\n### 1.1 领域对象总览\n\n核心领域对象均定义在 `src/lualib` 下，通过 `mc.orm.object` 封装为可持久化对象，并由 `object_manager` 统一管理：\n\n- **Controller 相关**\n  - `controller/controller_object.lua` 中的 `c_controller`\n  - 负责 RAID 控制器的发现、基本属性（温度、类型、BDF、SlotId）与健康状态维护，以及控制器级操作（模式切换、SlowDisk 检测开关等）。\n- **Drive 相关**\n  - `drive/drive_object.lua` 中的 `c_drive`\n  - 描述单块物理盘的拓扑属性（槽位、Enclosure、RefControllerId）、LED 状态、SMART/健康信息、预故障/故障状态等。\n- **Array（DiskArray）相关**\n  - `array/array_object.lua` 中的 `c_array`\n  - 表示 RAID 阵列，维护阵列容量、空闲空间、成员盘列表（`RefPDSlots` / `RefPDEnclosures`）以及关联逻辑盘列表 `RefVolumes`。\n- **Volume（逻辑盘）相关**\n  - `volume/volume_object.lua` 中的 `c_volume`\n  - 表示逻辑卷，维护 RAID 级别、缓存/访问策略、容量、重构状态、所属阵列等，并通过 `RefDiskArrayList` / `RefDrives` 关联阵列和物理盘。\n- **Drives 集合与对象管理**\n  - `drives/drives_object.lua`、`object_manager` 系列\n  - 将同类对象聚合成集合，为健康统计、告警判断等提供遍历能力。\n- **SML 适配与底层访问**\n  - `sml/init.lua` 提供 `sml.get_array_info / get_ld_info / get_pd_info / ctrl_operation` 等高层接口。\n  - SML 再经 `l_sml_adapter.cpp` 动态加载 `/usr/lib64/libsml_base*.so`、`libsml_custom_base*.so`、`libpd_log_parse*.so` 等 vendor 库。\n\n### 1.2 关键对象关系类图\n\n下面用简化类图描述 Controller / Drive / Array / Volume 之间的核心依赖关系（仅保留关键字段，便于理解结构）：\n\n```mermaid\nclassDiagram\n    class c_controller {\n      +Id:int\n      +TypeId:int\n      +SlotId:int\n      +BootDevices:string[]\n      +RefDrives:string[]\n      +on_add_pd()\n      +on_del_pd()\n    }\n\n    class c_drive {\n      +Id:int\n      +SlotNumber:int\n      +EnclosureId:int\n      +RefControllerId:int\n      +RefVolumeList:int[]\n      +RefDiskArrayId:int\n      +Presence:int\n      +FaultLed:int\n      +prefault_by_*\n      +fault_by_*\n      +on_presence_changed()\n    }\n\n    class c_array {\n      +Id:int\n      +RefControllerId:int\n      +RefVolumes:int[]\n      +RefPDSlots:int[]\n      +RefPDEnclosures:int[]\n      +UsedSpaceMiB:int\n      +TotalFreeSpaceMiB:int\n    }\n\n    class c_volume {\n      +Id:int\n      +RefController:int\n      +RefDiskArrayList:int[]\n      +SpanCount:int\n      +RAIDType:int\n      +CapacityBytes:int\n      +State:int\n      +BootPriority:int\n      +SSDCachecadeVolume:int\n      +AssociatedVolumes:int[]\n    }\n\n    c_controller \"1\" o--> \"*\" c_drive : RefDrives / RefControllerId\n    c_controller \"1\" o--> \"*\" c_array : RefControllerId\n    c_array \"1\" o--> \"*\" c_volume : RefVolumes\n    c_volume \"*\" o--> \"*\" c_drive : RefVolumeList\n    c_volume \"*\" o--> \"*\" c_array : RefDiskArrayList\n```\n\n可以看到：\n\n- **控制器是核心聚合根**：通过 `RefDrives` / `RefControllerId` 管理所有物理盘，通过 `RefControllerId` 管理所有阵列。\n- **阵列 `c_array` 绑定在固定控制器上**，同时维护自己的逻辑盘列表 `RefVolumes` 与成员盘槽位/Enclosure 列表。\n- **逻辑盘 `c_volume` 在阵列与物理盘之间搭建桥梁**：既记录自身所在阵列，又维护成员盘与 CacheCade 关系。\n- **物理盘 `c_drive` 既从控制器视角被管理，又从阵列/逻辑盘视角作为成员参与 RAID 关系。**\n\n### 1.3 对象与 SML / 事件系统的协作\n\n- **对象刷新**：\n  - `c_controller / c"}

{"reference_id": "8", "content": "---\ndate: 2026/06/02\ntitle: SAS/SATA盘信息无法获取问题分析\n---\n---\n\n# 问题背景\n\n- 单板类型：自研板；\n- 软件版本：openUBMC 25.06；\n- 涉及功能：硬盘，web页面硬盘信息显示；\n- 触发条件：背板上接了两个sata盘，系统侧装了iBMA，BMC的web页面查询硬盘信息。\n- 业务表现：预期硬盘信息显示正常；实际因硬盘信息缺失。\n\n# 问题复现步骤\n\n硬盘背板上接上两个SATA盘，系统侧安装BMA，BMC页面查看硬盘信息。\n\n# 关键日志信息\n\nweb页面硬盘信息：\n  ![web页面盘信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-1.png)\niBMA上报硬件日志信息：\n  ![iBMA上报信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-7.png)\n\n# 定位过程\n\n1. 查看host_agent是否收到了硬盘信息，目前从日志上看iBMA已发送，且属性信息显示有数值，确认已经收到；\n  ![硬盘属性信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-2.png)\n2. 查看sr中有没有PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象，因此丝印文件中有没有硬盘丝印，发现丝印为空；\n  ![丝印信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-3.png)\n3. 确认硬盘背板是否配置PCIeAddrInfo，没有配置的话无法上报丝印；sas/sata盘更新是通过silktext来映射到对应的盘的。基本逻辑大概是：hostagent上面silktext=Disk2，那么就会跟硬盘的Name匹配，如果匹配上了，就会把相关数据更新到对应的Drive对象上。\n4. 配置了PcieAddrInfo_SAS之后，silkconfig.json中硬盘丝印正常生成，但host_agent的.SilkScreen字段依旧是null，还是无法获取硬盘信息；\n  ![配置文件截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-4.png)\n  ![BMC属性信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-5.png)\n  ![硬盘丝印信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-6.png)\n5. 排查槽位号是否能对上；检查Drive对象的NodeId、RelativeSlot等属性，PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象的Location、SlotID、ControllerType、ContainerSlot等属性；\n\n# 问题原因\n\n硬盘丝印信息不正确，即PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象中的Bus、Device、Function、PortID这几个属性配置不正确，导致BMC无法正确的上报丝印信息，系统侧无法根据正确的根据丝印信息上报SAS/SATA盘信息。\n\n# 解决方案\n\nPcieAddrInfo_SAS对象中的Bus、Device、Function、PortID这几个属性重新配置到正确值。"}
```

{"entity": "Oem", "type": "artifact", "description": "Oem, short for Original Equipment Manufacturer, is a multifaceted concept primarily characterized as a vendor-specific extension field within the Redfish API, designed to accommodate proprietary data, custom attributes, and non-standard functionality not covered by the core Redfish schema. As a flexible namespace, Oem enables hardware vendors to extend Redfish resources with manufacturer-specific configurations, settings, and actions across a wide range of resource types, including System, Chassis, Manager, NetworkAdapter, StorageController, Processor, FirmwareInventory, PowerConverter, Drive, LogService, and CertificateService. Within these contexts, Oem typically contains structured data such as public configuration parameters (e.g., in a Public section), custom actions (e.g., PCIeDevices.Reset, SPOSInstallPara, ExportLog), diagnostic or status information (e.g., Severity, PowerMetricsExtended), hardware-specific identifiers (e.g., HeadNodeId, BunchType, Device BDF values), and network-related attributes (e.g., IPVersion, DNSAddressOrigin, Protocol, ActiveStandby). It also supports cryptographic functions such as cryptographic erase, SSH key management, certificate management, and task-specific parameters like TaskPercentage. The Oem field may include vendor identifiers and is often structured as a dedicated object within Redfish responses, supporting both embedded and top-level deployment within standard API outputs.\n\nWhile most descriptions emphasize Oem’s role in enabling vendor-specific extensions in Redfish interfaces—particularly within the openUBMC ecosystem—some references describe Oem in distinct, context-specific roles. Notably, Oem is described as an interface for handling proprietary functionality specifically within power supply systems, indicating a domain-specific application of the extension mechanism. Additionally, Oem is associated with a compliance mode in SchemaComplianceMode that maintains legacy openUBMC data structure and formatting, preserving backward compatibility with older clients. This mode ensures that systems can continue to operate with legacy data formats, illustrating a dual function: enabling innovation through vendor extensions while accommodating system stability through legacy support. The term is also viewed as a namespace or prefix used in system configurations to denote vendor-specific extensions, reinforcing its role as a standardized yet extensible mechanism within structured data environments.\n\nIn summary, the term Oem refers primarily to a standardized, extensible field in the Redfish API used to integrate vendor-specific data and functionality, with common implementations seen in systems such as openUBMC. It serves as a mechanism to bridge the gap between open standards and proprietary hardware capabilities, supporting features like firmware configuration, diagnostics, security operations, and network management. While some sources clarify its role specifically within power supply systems or as a compliance mode for legacy compatibility, these represent specialized applications of the broader Oem extension framework. The consistent thread across all descriptions is Oem’s function as a flexible, vendor-extendable namespace within standardized APIs—ensuring interoperability while supporting innovation across diverse hardware implementations.<SEP>Oem is an interface for handling proprietary or vendor-specific functionality within the power supply system."}
{"entity": "Actions", "type": "category", "description": "Actions is a core concept within the Redfish API framework, serving as a standardized mechanism for defining and invoking executable operations on various system resources. As a Redfish resource or property, Actions is typically represented as a JSON object or array that contains a list of available operations and their associated metadata, including target endpoints, input parameters, and action-specific information. This functionality enables remote management and automated interaction with physical components and services in data center infrastructure.\n\nThe Actions collection is present across multiple Redfish resources and services, including drive resources, network adapters, power supplies, thermal metrics, certificate services, license services, update services, and the Contamination Detection service. For drive resources, Actions supports operations such as Reset, Crypto Erase, and vendor-specific actions, often utilizing ActionInfo endpoints to provide invocation details. Similarly, for network adapters, it includes a Reset action with associated input parameters. The CertificateService uses Actions to define operations like ImportNtpKey, ImportCertificate, DeleteCertificate, and the management of Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs). The UpdateService leverages Actions for firmware updates via operations such as SimpleUpdate, and may include both standard and OEM-defined extensions.\n\nActions also plays a critical role in system-level management, providing access to functions such as LED control, SuperPod reset, temperature history clearing, and board reset. These operations are exposed as executable commands through dedicated endpoints defined within the Actions structure. For example, the ThermalMetrics resource employs Actions to allow retrieval and modulation of thermal data, while the SyslogService uses it for tasks like certificate import and system telemetry collection. Additionally, the KVM service includes actions such as SetKvmKey, and the SMS service contains operations relevant to system management.\n\nThe Actions mechanism is not limited to hardware components; it extends to software and orchestration workflows. Notably, within the context of GitHub, the term \"Actions\" refers to a continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) system used to automate testing, building, and deployment processes for projects such as cri-dockerd. While this usage is specific to software development and unrelated to Redfish, it highlights a broader technical semantics of \"Actions\" as executable workflows.\n\nIn summary, Actions is a central, standardized interface in the Redfish framework that encapsulates a comprehensive set of operations applicable to diverse resources, including drives, network adapters, power supplies, and various services. It ensures consistent, extensible, and secure access to system management functions through well-defined API endpoints, often supporting both standard and OEM-defined functionality. This unified approach enables interoperability, automation, and scalable management across heterogeneous hardware environments.<SEP>Actions is a Redfish resource path that allows invocation of specific operations.<SEP>Actions is a configuration group that defines available security-related operations.<SEP>Actions is a top-level configuration category containing executable actions for the SecurityService.<SEP>Actions is a section in the Redfish API that contains executable operations."}

{"entity": "PredictiveFailure", "type": "attribute", "description": "PredictiveFailure is a read-only attribute used in storage drive diagnostics to indicate whether a potential failure has been predicted based on monitoring of various diagnostic metrics. It functions as a binary flag, where the value 0 signifies normal operation and the absence of predicted failure, while the value 1 indicates that the system has detected an imminent or potential hardware failure prior to its occurrence. This field serves as an early warning mechanism, allowing proactive maintenance or data migration before actual failure happens. The flag is set by the drive's internal diagnostic algorithms, which analyze performance and health indicators to assess the likelihood of future failure. By default, PredictiveFailure is initialized to 0, reflecting a baseline state of normalcy. Its primary role is to signal impending drive failure proactively, supporting system reliability and data integrity. The attribute is consistently described across all sources as an indicator derived from predictive analytics rather than actual failure, emphasizing its forward-looking diagnostic nature."}

--> CODE_GEN\n    CODE_GEN --> interface_layer\n\n    JSON_PCIe -->|\"定义接口\"| PCIeDevice\n    JSON_NVMe -->|\"定义接口\"| NVMe\n    JSON_Smart -->|\"定义接口\"| NVMe_Smart\n\n    PCIeDevice -->|\"组合\"| NVMeDisk\n    NVMe -->|\"组合\"| NVMeDisk\n    NVMe_Management -->|\"组合\"| NVMeDisk\n    NVMe_Smart -->|\"组合\"| NVMeDisk\n    NVMe_ProductInfo -->|\"组合\"| NVMeDisk\n    Cooling -->|\"组合\"| NVMeDisk\n\n    NVMeDisk -->|\"厂商实现\"| huawei\n    NVMeDisk -->|\"厂商实现\"| other\n```\n\n## 2. 前置准备\n\n### 2.1 准备编译环境\n\n可参考社区的[Docker开发环境搭建](https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/docs/blob/main/docs/zh/development/tool_guide/docker_env.md)。在完成环境搭建后，推荐通过scripts目录下的smart_build.sh完成首次编译，如果希望通过手动构建的方式，可参考本项目的[README.md文档](https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/component_drivers/blob/main/README.md)\n\n### 2.2 明确硬盘信息\n\n#### 必需信息\n\n| 信息项 | 说明 | 示例 |\n|-------|------|------|\n| **VID** | Vendor ID（厂商ID） | `0x19e5` |\n| **DID** | Device ID（设备ID） | `0x0222` |\n| **SVID** | Subsystem Vendor ID | `0x19e5` |\n| **SSID** | Subsystem Device ID | `0x0052` |\n\n#### 协议信息\n\n- 支持的通信协议（NVMe-MI标准协议、厂商OEM扩展等）\n- 协议命令集（获取温度、SMART信息等命令的定义）\n- 数据格式（响应数据的字节序、字段定义等）\n\n#### 硬件信息\n\n- 硬盘容量\n- 是否支持NVMe-MI over PCIe\n- 是否支持NVMe-MI over SMBus\n- 特殊功能（如厂商特定SMART信息等）\n\n### 2.3 了解驱动规范\n\n驱动规范定义了驱动需要实现的接口。硬盘的驱动规范可参考本项目归档的[硬盘驱动规范](https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/component_drivers/blob/master/docs/3.3-硬盘驱动规范.md)，机器可读定义在[`dmc/`](https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/component_drivers/tree/master/dmc)（总览：[Device Management Contract](https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/component_drivers/blob/master/docs/3-DeviceMgmtContract.md)）\n\n### 2.4 了解工程目录\n\nComponent Drivers项目采用分层架构设计，硬盘驱动适配需要了解以下关键目录结构：\n\n#### 2.4.1 项目整体结构\n\n```\ncomponent_drivers/\n├── drivers/              # 设备驱动实现目录（各类硬件设备驱动）\n├── gen/                  # 自动生成的代码目录（接口基类）\n├── libraries/            # 协议库目录（通信协议封装）\n├── tests/                # 测试代码目录\n├── docs/                 # 文档目录\n├── include/              # 公共头文件目录\n└── meson.build           # 构建配置文件\n```\n\n#### 2.4.2 硬盘驱动目录结构（drivers目录）\n\n`drivers/`目录包含所有硬件设备的具体驱动实现，按设备类型组织。以下为PCIe NVMe硬盘驱动的核心目录结构（节选，完整内容见[代码仓](https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/component_drivers/tree/master/drivers/pcie_nvme/huawei)）：\n\n```\ndrivers/\n├── pcie_nvme/            # PCIe NVMe硬盘驱动（本指南重点）\n│   └── huawei/           # 华为硬盘驱动\n│       ├── csr/                          # 设备配置文件\n│       │   ├── 14140224_PROTOCOL_19e5.dds   # 设备描述（DDS）\n│       │   └── 14140224_PROTOCOL_19e5.sr    # 资源描述（SR）\n│       ├── hw_nvme_pcie4/  # 华为NVMe PCIe4硬盘实现\n│       │   ├── hw_nvme_pcie4.h          # 硬盘主对象头文件\n│       │   ├── hw_nvme_pcie4.cpp        # 硬盘"}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "---\ndate: 2026/06/02\ntitle: SAS/SATA盘信息无法获取问题分析\n---\n---\n\n# 问题背景\n\n- 单板类型：自研板；\n- 软件版本：openUBMC 25.06；\n- 涉及功能：硬盘，web页面硬盘信息显示；\n- 触发条件：背板上接了两个sata盘，系统侧装了iBMA，BMC的web页面查询硬盘信息。\n- 业务表现：预期硬盘信息显示正常；实际因硬盘信息缺失。\n\n# 问题复现步骤\n\n硬盘背板上接上两个SATA盘，系统侧安装BMA，BMC页面查看硬盘信息。\n\n# 关键日志信息\n\nweb页面硬盘信息：\n  ![web页面盘信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-1.png)\niBMA上报硬件日志信息：\n  ![iBMA上报信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-7.png)\n\n# 定位过程\n\n1. 查看host_agent是否收到了硬盘信息，目前从日志上看iBMA已发送，且属性信息显示有数值，确认已经收到；\n  ![硬盘属性信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-2.png)\n2. 查看sr中有没有PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象，因此丝印文件中有没有硬盘丝印，发现丝印为空；\n  ![丝印信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-3.png)\n3. 确认硬盘背板是否配置PCIeAddrInfo，没有配置的话无法上报丝印；sas/sata盘更新是通过silktext来映射到对应的盘的。基本逻辑大概是：hostagent上面silktext=Disk2，那么就会跟硬盘的Name匹配，如果匹配上了，就会把相关数据更新到对应的Drive对象上。\n4. 配置了PcieAddrInfo_SAS之后，silkconfig.json中硬盘丝印正常生成，但host_agent的.SilkScreen字段依旧是null，还是无法获取硬盘信息；\n  ![配置文件截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-4.png)\n  ![BMC属性信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-5.png)\n  ![硬盘丝印信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-6.png)\n5. 排查槽位号是否能对上；检查Drive对象的NodeId、RelativeSlot等属性，PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象的Location、SlotID、ControllerType、ContainerSlot等属性；\n\n# 问题原因\n\n硬盘丝印信息不正确，即PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象中的Bus、Device、Function、PortID这几个属性配置不正确，导致BMC无法正确的上报丝印信息，系统侧无法根据正确的根据丝印信息上报SAS/SATA盘信息。\n\n# 解决方案\n\nPcieAddrInfo_SAS对象中的Bus、Device、Function、PortID这几个属性重新配置到正确值。"}
{"reference_id": "6", "content": "��盘 ID | CSR 配置 |\n| NodeId | 输出 | string | 资源唯一 ID | — |\n| SlotNumber | 输出 | uint8 | 槽位号 | 默认255 |\n| Name | 输出 | string | 硬盘名称 | Disk0 等 |\n| Presence | 输出 | uint8 | 在位状态 | 0=不在位，1=在位 |\n| CapacityMiB | 输出 | uint32 | 容量 | MiB |\n| Model | 输出 | string | 型号 | — |\n| Manufacturer | 输出 | string | 厂商 | — |\n| SerialNumber | 输出 | string | 序列号 | — |\n| Revision | 输出 | string | 固件版本 | — |\n| Protocol | 输出 | uint8 | 协议类型 | 0=Unknown,1=SCSI,2=SAS,3=SATA,4=FC,6=PCIe |\n| MediaType | 输出 | uint8 | 介质类型 | 0=HDD,1=SSD,2=SSM,255=Unknown |\n| FirmwareStatus | 输出 | uint8 | 固件状态 | 20+ 枚举值 |\n| TemperatureCelsius | 输出 | int32 | 温度 | °C |\n| CapableSpeedGbs | 输出 | uint8 | 支持速率 | Gb/s |\n| NegotiatedSpeedGbs | 输出 | uint8 | 协商速率 | Gb/s |\n| PowerOnHours | 输出 | uint32 | 通电时长 | 小时 |\n| PredictedMediaLifeLeftPercent | 输出 | uint8 | 预估剩余寿命 | 0~100%, 255=无效 |\n| RotationSpeedRPM | 输出 | uint32 | 转速 | RPM(HDD) |\n| BlockSizeBytes | 输出 | uint32 | 块大小 | Bytes |\n| HotspareType | 输出 | uint8 | 热备类型 | 0=None,1=Global,2=Dedicated |\n| RebuildState | 输出 | uint8 | 重构状态 | 0=无，1=进行中 |\n| RebuildProgress | 输出 | uint8 | 重构进度 | 0~100% |\n| PatrolState | 输出 | uint8 | 巡检状态 | 0=无/完成，1=巡检中 |\n| PredictedFailCount | 输出 | uint32 | 预故障计数 | — |\n| MediaErrorCount | 输出 | uint32 | 介质错误计数 | — |\n| OtherErrorCount | 输出 | uint32 | 其他错误计数 | — |\n| LocationIndicatorState | 输出 | uint8 | 定位灯状态 | 0=关，1=开 |\n| BootPriority | 输出 | uint8 | 启动优先级 | — |\n| SASAddress1 | 输出 | string | SAS 地址 1 | — |\n| SASAddress2 | 输出 | string | SAS 地址 2 | — |\n| RefControllerId | 输出 | uint8 | 关联控制器 ID | — |\n| RefVolumeList | 输出 | string | 关联逻辑盘列表 | — |\n| RefDiskArrayId | 输出 | string | 关联阵列 ID | — |\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值 | 含义 | 触发条件 | 处理建议 |\n| :----- | :--- | :------- | :------- |\n| 0 | 成功 | 正常执行完成 | 无 |\n| 非 0 | 失败 | 硬盘不在位或操作不支持 | 检查硬盘状态 |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- 查询物理盘详细信息（健康/温度/容量/速率等）\n- 设置硬盘热备类型（全局/专属/取消）\n- 点亮/关闭硬盘定位灯\n- 设置硬盘固件状态（Online/Offline/JBOD 等）\n- 加密擦除硬盘数据\n\n#### 限制条件\n\n- # Storage 存储管理服务

## 版本信息

| 项目     | 内容        |
| :------- | :---------- |
| 组件版本 | 1.100.41          |
| 首发版本 | openUBMC 1.0.0 |
| 文档作者 | openUBMC    |
| 最后更新 | 2026-05-29  |

## 1. 组件概述

### 1.1 组件简介

Storage（存储管理服务）是 openUBMC 系统中的存储组件管理模块，负责管理 RAID 控制器、物理硬盘、逻辑盘、磁盘阵列和超级电容（BBU）等存储资源。支持通过 I2C（博通 RAID 卡）和 MCTP（1880/PMC RAID 卡）两种通信方式实现带外管理，同时支持通过 BMA（Board Management Agent）获取带内信息。

### 1.2 解决什么问题

Storage 组件为用户提供了完整的 RAID 卡管理能力，包括 RAID 控制器状态监控与配置、物理盘健康检测与操作、逻辑盘的创建/删除/属性设置、磁盘阵列管理、BBU 状态监控等功能。通过 Storage 组件，用户可以在不依赖主机操作系统的情况下完成存储资源的全生命周期管理。

### 1.3 核心功

| -------- | -------- | ----------------- |
| `pfn_add_ctrl` | 添加RAID控制器到管理列表 | 注册控制器设备树节点 |
| `pfn_remove_ctrl` | 从管理列表中移除控制器 | 注销控制器设备树节点 |
| `pfn_init_ctrl_over_i2c` | 初始化LSI RAID控制器（I2C通信） | 初始化设备树访问通道 |
| `pfn_exit_ctrl_over_i2c` | 退出LSI RAID控制器管理 | 释放设备树访问通道 |
| `pfn_update_ctrl_cache` | 更新storelib缓存 | 刷新设备树节点数据 |
| `pfn_get_ctrl_info` | 获取控制器基本信息 | 读取设备树Controller节点 |
| `pfn_get_ctrl_sas_addr` | 获取控制器SAS地址 | 读取设备树Controller.SASAddr |
| `pfn_get_ctrl_health` | 获取控制器健康状态 | 读取设备树Controll

# Storage 模块设计说明（4+1 视图）

Storage 组件是 openUBMC 中负责存储控制器、物理盘、阵列、逻辑盘等资源统一管理的独立子系统。本章节从软件架构 4+1 视图模型出发，对 Storage 模块的层级调用关系、SO 依赖关系以及核心对象之间的关联进行系统性说明。

> 代码仓地址：`https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/storage`

## 一、逻辑视图（领域模型与对象关系）

### 1.1 领域对象总览

核心领域对象均定义在 `src/lualib` 下，通过 `mc.orm.object` 封装为可持久化对象，并由 `object_manager` 统一管理：

- **Controller 相关**
  - `controller/controller_object.lua` 中的 `c_controller`
  - 负责 RAID 控制器的发现、基本属性（温度、类型、BDF、SlotId）与健康状态维护，以及控制器级操作（模式切换、SlowDisk 检测开关等）。
- **Drive 相关**
  - `drive/drive_object.lua` 中的 `c_drive`
  - 描述单块物理

- **docs_zh_development_specifications_redfish_details_Chassis_Drives.md**

| WeekAndYearOfManufacture | string | true |  -  | 生产日期 |
| BlocksSentToInitiator | number | true |  -  | 发送到启动器的块 |

title: SAS/SATA盘信息无法获取问题分析

# 问题背景

- 单板类型：自研板；
- 软件版本：openUBMC 25.06；
- 涉及功能：硬盘，web页面硬盘信息显示；
- 触发条件：背板上接了两个sata盘，系统侧装了iBMA，BMC的web页面查询硬盘信息。
- 业务表现：预期硬盘信息显示正常；实际因硬盘信息缺失。

# 问题复现步骤

硬盘背板上接上两个SATA盘，系统侧安装BMA，BMC页面查看硬盘信息。

# 关键日志信息

web页面硬盘信息：
  ![web页面盘信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-1.png)
iBMA上报硬件日志信息：
  ![iBMA上报信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-7.png)

# 定位过程

1. 查看host_agent是否收到了硬盘信息，目前从日志上看iBMA已发送，且属性信息显示有数值，确认已经收到；
  ![硬盘属性信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-2.png)
2. 查看sr中有没有PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象，因此丝印文件中有没有硬盘丝印，发现丝印为空；
  ![丝印信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-3.png

  ---
date: 2026/06/02
title: SAS/SATA盘信息无法获取问题分析
---
---

# 问题背景

- 单板类型：自研板；
- 软件版本：openUBMC 25.06；
- 涉及功能：硬盘，web页面硬盘信息显示；
- 触发条件：背板上接了两个sata盘，系统侧装了iBMA，BMC的web页面查询硬盘信息。
- 业务表现：预期硬盘信息显示正常；实际因硬盘信息缺失。

# 问题复现步骤

硬盘背板上接上两个SATA盘，系统侧安装BMA，BMC页面查看硬盘信息。

# 关键日志信息

web页面硬盘信息：
  ![web页面盘信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-1.png)
iBMA上报硬件日志信息：
  ![iBMA上报信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-7.png)

# 定位过程

1. 查看host_agent是否收到了硬盘信息，目前从日志上看iBMA已发送，且属性信息显示有数值，确认已经收到；
  ![硬盘属性信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-2.png)
2. 查看sr中有没有PcieAddrInfo_SAS对象，因此丝印文件中有没有硬盘丝印，发现丝印为空；
  ![丝印信息截图](../../images/fault/sata2075-3.png

The project is closely associated with the rackmount repository, which it maintains on GitCode, including configuration files for tools like ipmcget and source code for BMC firmware and system-level commands.\n\nopenUBMC functions as a modular, micro-component-based framework with a software architecture that supports scalability and developer-friendliness, leveraging the Skynet framework for task management and enabling concurrent operations via skynet.fork. It incorporates multiple components such as the iam (identity and access management), nsm (network services management), oms (operational maintenance), devmon (device monitoring), and Storage components for managing storage devices, power supplies, and NVMe/SATA hardware. The system supports advanced features such as CPLD zero-downtime upgrades, dynamic PCIe card loading, and secure file operations using C and Lua libraries to mitigate vulnerabilities.\n\nThe platform provides a full-stack solution for BMC-based systems, offering management capabilities through multiple protocols, including IPMI, Redfish (with OEM extensions like SchemaComplianceMode and vendor-specific namespaces), SNMP (with SNMPv3 authPriv security), Web REST API, and CLI. It includes support for hardware abstraction layers, enabling compatibility with various storage protocols such as NVMe-MI and SFF VPD, and manages hardware health via sensors, alarms, and telemetry reporting. Commands are extensively documented, with versioning tracked in revision histories; notable versions include 1.0.0 (initial release), 25.06 (released June 26, 2025), and 26.09 (introducing enhanced security features and configurations).\n\nopenUBMC also supports enterprise-grade management features such as iBMCv2 transition capability, secure boot, and customizable configuration policies. It provides a suite of SDKs, dev tools, Docker images, and build frameworks (using Conan, CMake, and U-Boot) that facilitate incremental development and integration with multi-chip and low-memory environments. The system includes diagnostic and self-discovery mechanisms like CSR-based hardware reading and supports VME-based firmware upgrades. It integrates with higher-layer systems via Northbound interfaces, including Redfish, Web-backend, CLI, and SNMP, enabling full-scenario, full-connection, and full-intelligence operations.\n\nThe project is deeply embedded in open-source ecosystems like openEuler and promotes standardization through its management of MIB modules (e.g., OPENUBMC-SERVER-MIB), technical specifications, and documentation. It oversees command definitions (e.g., Activate Session, Get-BBU-Cell-Voltage, Set-ACPI-Power-State, Cold Reset), protocol stacks, and security models. The organization behind openUBMC maintains repositories, manages version control, and ensures consistent release cycles and compliance with open standards: the software is used for monitoring, power management, event handling, configuration management, and product lifecycle operations across server and network equipment."}

{"entity": "Oem", "type": "artifact", "description": "Oem, short for Original Equipment Manufacturer, is a multifaceted concept primarily characterized as a vendor-specific extension field within the Redfish API, designed to accommodate proprietary data, custom attributes, and non-standard functionality not covered by the core Redfish schema. As a flexible namespace, Oem enables hardware vendors to extend Redfish resources with manufacturer-specific configurations, settings, and actions across a wide range of resource types, including System, Chassis, Manager, NetworkAdapter, StorageController, Processor, FirmwareInventory, PowerConverter, Drive, LogService, and CertificateService. Within these contexts, Oem typically contains structured data such as public configuration parameters (e.g., in a Public section), custom actions (e.g., PCIeDevices.Reset, SPOSInstallPara, ExportLog), diagnostic or status information (e.g., Severity, PowerMetricsExtended), hardware-specific identifiers (e.g., HeadNodeId, BunchType, Device BDF values), and network-related attributes (e.g., IPVersion, DNSAddressOrigin, Protocol, ActiveStandby). It also supports cryptographic functions such as cryptographic erase, SSH key management, certificate management, and task-specific parameters like TaskPercentage. The Oem field may include vendor identifiers and is often structured as a dedicated object within Redfish responses, supporting both embedded and top-level deployment within standard API outputs.\n\nWhile most descriptions emphasize Oem’s role in enabling vendor-specific extensions in Redfish interfaces—particularly within the openUBMC ecosystem—some references describe Oem in distinct, context-specific roles. Notably, Oem is described as an interface for handling proprietary functionality specifically within power supply systems, indicating a domain-specific application of the extension mechanism. Additionally, Oem is associated with a compliance mode in SchemaComplianceMode that maintains legacy openUBMC data structure and formatting, preserving backward compatibility with older clients. This mode ensures that systems can continue to operate with legacy data formats, illustrating a dual function: enabling innovation through vendor extensions while accommodating system stability through legacy support. The term is also viewed as a namespace or prefix used in system configurations to denote vendor-specific extensions, reinforcing its role as a standardized yet extensible mechanism within structured data environments.\n\nIn summary, the term Oem refers primarily to a standardized, extensible field in the Redfish API used to integrate vendor-specific data and functionality, with common implementations seen in systems such as openUBMC. It serves as a mechanism to bridge the gap between open standards and proprietary hardware capabilities, supporting features like firmware configuration, diagnostics, security operations, and network management. While some sources clarify its role specifically within power supply systems or as a compliance mode for legacy compatibility, these represent specialized applications of the broader Oem extension framework. The consistent thread across all descriptions is Oem’s function as a flexible, vendor-extendable namespace within standardized APIs—ensuring interoperability while supporting innovation across diverse hardware implementations.<SEP>Oem is an interface for handling proprietary or vendor-specific functionality within the power supply system."}

{"entity": "KVMMgmt", "type": "organization", "description": "KVMMgmt is a multifaceted entity within system management frameworks, primarily associated with KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine) and related virtualization technologies. It functions as a configurable permission type that governs access to KVM-specific functionalities, including keyboard, video, and mouse (KVM) control, thereby enabling remote management of virtual machines. This permission category is integral to virtual machine management, allowing authorized users to perform critical administrative tasks remotely. The KVMMgmt permission is explicitly defined as a valid privilege level tied to Key-Value Management, where it regulates access to key-value metadata and associated memory management operations, highlighting its role in both virtualization and data management contexts. Furthermore, KVMMgmt is specified as a Boolean data field indicating the permission status for remote KVM management; it grants read-only access and supports change broadcasting, ensuring consistency across managed environments. It is also recognized as the applicable device model for the Set-VNC-Configuration command, linking it directly to remote visualization and access protocols. Despite the apparent variation in definitions—ranging from hardware-specific device models to abstract permission categories—these descriptions are best interpreted as overlapping aspects of a unified management construct. The most coherent interpretation is that KVMMgmt serves as a permission-based framework that encompasses remote KVM access, virtual machine control, key-value metadata handling, and system-level configuration, all under a standardized privilege model. Conflicts in description, such as the distinction between a device model and a permission field, likely stem from different contextual perspectives within a larger system architecture, where KVMMgmt is represented both as a functional entity and as a policy-level access control construct."}

{"entity": "virt-manager", "type": "artifact", "description": "virt-manager is a graphical tool used for managing virtual machines, serving as a desktop user interface for virtualization management on Linux systems. It is specifically designed to work with the libvirt API and is commonly used in conjunction with QEMU/KVM to manage virtualized environments. The tool provides a user-friendly interface for configuring, starting, stopping, and monitoring virtual machines, making it accessible for both beginners and experienced administrators. virt-manager supports the management of virtual machines across different architectures, although performance may be slower compared to direct command-line interactions. It is widely utilized for managing virtual machines, including specific distributions such as Ubuntu VMs, within virtualized systems. As a robust and open-source solution, virt-manager plays a key role in simplifying virtual machine administration through a centralized graphical interface.<SEP>virt-manager is a graphical user interface tool for managing virtual machines.<SEP>A graphical tool for managing virtual machines through a user-friendly interface."}

| 重启操作属性的访问路径 |\n| Actions.Oem.Public.#ComputerSystem.FruControl | object | true | - | FRU重启操作 |\n\n## supported_methods\n\n- GET\n- PATCH\n- POST (ACTION)\n\n# HTTP methods\n\n## GET\n\n**命令功能**\n\n查询指定系统资源信息\n\n**参数说明**\n\n| 参数 | 参数说明 | 取值 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| device_ip | 登录设备的IP地址 | IPv4或IPv6地址 |\n| system_id | 系统资源的ID | 针对机架服务器取值为1；针对高密服务器取值为BladeN；针对刀片服务器取值为BladeN或SwiN；针对X6800 V5等取值还可为Enc；针对设备U位取值为UN；针对机柜取值为Rack |\n| auth_value | 执行该GET请求时，必须在\"Headers\"中携带\"X-Auth-Token\"值用于鉴权 | 可通过/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions创建会话时获得 |\n\n**使用实例**\n\n请求样例：\n```http\nGET https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Systems/1\n```\n\n请求头：\n```\nX-Auth-Token: 123456789***********************\n```\n\n请求消息体：无\n\n响应样例：\n```json\n{\n  \"@odata.context\": \"/redfish/v1/$metadata#ComputerSystem.ComputerSystem\",\n  \"@odata.id\": \"/redfish/v1/Systems/1\",\n  \"@odata.type\": \"#ComputerSystem.v1_23_0.ComputerSystem\",\n  \"Id\": \"1\",\n  \"Name\": \"Computer System\",\n  \"AssetTag\": null,\n  \"Manufacturer"}
{"reference_id": "4", "content": "# KVM集成\n\n## 修订记录\n\n| openUBMC版本号 | 修订日期 | 修订内容 |\n| -------------- | -------- | -------- |\n| 25.06 | 2025/06/26 | 初稿，新增命令详情 |\n\n**相关命令：**\n\n- [设置KVM参数（Set KVM Parameter）](../details/OEM-30h/Cmd-94h/21h-设置KVM参数（Set-KVM-Parameter）.md)\n- [获取KVM参数（Get KVM Parameter）](../details/OEM-30h/Cmd-94h/20h-获取KVM参数（Get-KVM-Parameter）.md)\n- [设置认证关键字（Set Authentication Key）](../details/OEM-30h/Cmd-93h/04h-设置认证关键字（Set-Authentication-Key）.md)\n\nBMC支持浏览器地址URL集成KVM功能，为保证系统正常运行，需要满足运行环境要求、并按照相关步骤完成开发。\n\n## 环境要求\n\n不同BMC版本存在差异，请以具体版本支持情况为准：\n\n| 运行环境 | 配置要求 |\n| -------- | -------- |\n| 操作系统 | Windows XP 32位 |\n| | Windows 7 32位/64位 |\n| | Windows 8 32位/64位 |\n| | Windows Server 2008 R2 64位 |\n| | Windows Server 2012 64位 |\n| | Redhat 4.3 64位 |\n| | Redhat 6.0 64位 |\n| | Mac OS X v10.7 |\n| 浏览器 | Internet Explorer 8.0/10.0（仅适用于Windows操作系统），其中Internet Explorer 10.0不支持Windows XP |\n| | Mozilla Firefox 9.0/23.0 |\n| | Chrome 13.0/31.0（仅适用于Windows操作系统） |\n| | Safari 5.1（仅适用于MAC操作系统） |\n| Java运行环境 | JRE 1.6.0 U25/1.7.0 U40 |\n\n## 注意说明\n\n- KVM集成功能适用华为支持KVM功能的服务器。\n- 由于客户有可能使用华为多种服务器、多个版本，部分版本服务器可能不支持此调用方式，可能存在兼容性问题。\n- 考虑到JAR包的版本配套问题，集成时不建议在本地缓存JAR包，而应该每次打开远程控制台时从服务器BMC下载JAR包（在打开remote_access.asp页面时会自动下载）。\n\n## Web 集成\n\n### 不加密的情况下URL登录KVM\n\n1. 首先设置KVM为非加密状态\n\n   设置KVM的加密状态必须要管理员权限。可以在BMC的web上设置，也可以用IPMITool设置，ipmi的设置关闭加密命令：\n\n   ```bash\n   ipmitool -I lanplus  -U  root -P <Password> -H 192.168.2.100 raw 0x30 0x94 0xdb 0x07 0x00 0x21 0x02 0x00 0x00 0x01 0x00\n   ```\n\n   参数说明：\n\n   - `-I lan`：表示通过网络访问，-I lanplus为加密，lan无加密功能\n   - `-H 192.168.2.100`：BMC的IP地址，此处根据实际情况填写\n   - `-U root`：BMC本地用户名，此处根据实际情况填写\n   - `-P <Password>`：BMC用户密码，此处根据实际情况填写\n\n   不是红色字体的部分是头部信息（一般无须修改），红色字体是设置KVM的加密状态：\n\n   - `0x00`是非加密状态\n   - `0x01`是加密状态\n\n2. 通过IPMITool设置识别ID\n\n   为防止非法用户通过本地KVM控制台连接BMC，并使用KVM功能，BMC需要根据用户识别ID确认用户身份，通过IPMITool工具可以设置识别ID，有两条命令都可以设置ID，使用时只要发送其中任意一种设置命令来设置识别ID即可：\n\n   **第一种命令：**\n\n   ```bash\n   ipmitool -I lanplus -H 192.168.2.100 -U root -P <Password> raw 0x30 0x93 0xdb 0x07 0x00 0x04 0x00 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x3 0x72 0x6f 0x6f 0x74 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0 0x0\n   ```\n\n   参数说明：\n\n   - `-I lan`：表示通过网络访问，-I lanplus为加密，lan无加密功能\n   - `-H 192.168.2.100`：BMC的IP地址，此处根据实际情况填写\n   - `-U root`：BMC本地用户名，此处根据实际情况填写\n   - `-P <Password>`：BMC用户密码，此处根据实际"}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "---\nresource_type: \"KvmService\"\n\nparent_resource_type: \"Managers\"\n\nresource_definition : \"oem\"\n\nversion: \"v1_0_0\"\n\ndate: 2026/07/01\n\ntitle: KvmService\n---\n\n# ResourceDefinition\n\n## uris\n\n- `/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/KvmService`\n\n## properties\n\n| 名称 | 类型 | 是否只读 | 取值范围/枚举值 | 说明 |\n| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |\n| @odata.context | string | true |  | KVM资源模型的OData描述信息 |\n| @odata.id | string | true |  | KVM资源的访问路径 |\n| @odata.type | string | true |  | KVM资源的类型 |\n| Id | string | false |  | KVM资源的ID |\n| Name | string | true |  | KVM资源的名称 |\n| MaximumNumberOfSessions | number | true |  | KVM最大会话数 |\n| NumberOfActivatedSessions | number | true |  | KVM当前会话数 |\n| ActivatedSessionsType | string | true |  | KVM会话类型 <br>● “Shared”：共享 <br>● “Private”：独占 <br>● null：暂无会话 |\n| EncryptionConfigurable | boolean | true |  | KVM加密可配置状态 <br>● “true”：KVM加密使能状态支持修改 <br>● “false”：KVM加密使能状态默认开启且不支持修改 |\n| EncryptionEnabled | boolean | false |  | KVM加密使能 |\n| PersistentUSBConnectionEnabled | boolean | false |  | 虚拟键盘、鼠标持续连接使能 |\n| SessionTimeoutMinutes | number | false |  | 会话超时时间 |\n| AutoOSLockEnabled | boolean | false |  | 系统自动锁定使能 <br>● “true”：支持最后一个远程登录用户离开时，业务侧OS自动锁定 <br>● “false”：不支持业务侧OS自动锁定 |\n| AutoOSLockType | string | false |  | 系统自动锁定方式 <br>● “Custom”：自定义 <br>● “Windows”：Windows锁定 |\n| AutoOSLockKey | array | false |  | 系统自动锁定自定义快捷键 |\n| VisibleJavaKvm | boolean | true |  | Java KVM入口显示状态 <br>● true：显示 <br>● false：不显示 |\n| DisableKeyboardDuringBiosStartup | boolean | false |  | 禁止BIOS启动阶段通过热键进入BIOS Setup菜单BMC300 5.10.0.1及以上版本支持 |\n| KvmService.SetKvmKey | object | true |  | 设置KVM Key |\n| target | string | true |  | 操作路径 |\n| Redfish.ActionInfo | string | true |  | 操作信息查询路径 |\n| code | string | true |  | 指示消息注册表中特定消息ID的字符串 |\n| message | string | true |  | 与消息注册表中的消息对应的易读的错误消息 |\n| MessageId | string | true |  | 消息ID |\n| RelatedProperties | array | true |  | 消息相关属性 |\n| Message | string | true |  | 详细信息 |\n| MessageArgs | array | true |  | 信息参数 |\n| Severity | string | true |  | 严重性Redfish支持的严重级别包括：OK、Warning、Critical |\n| Resolution | string | true |  | 解决建议 |\n\n## supported_methods\n\n- GET\n- PATCH\n- POST\n\n# HTTP methods\n\n## GET\n\n**命令功能**\n\n查询 KVM 资源\n\n**命令格式**\n\nURL: https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/KvmService\n\n请求头:\n```\nX-Auth-Token: auth_value\n```\n\n\n请求消息体: 无\n\n**参数说明**\n\n| 参数 | 参数说明 | 取值 |\n|------|----------|------|\n| device_ip | 登录设备的IP地址 | IPv4或IPv6地址 |\n| auth_value | 请求消息的鉴权参数 | 可通过/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions创建会话时获得 |\n\n**使用指南**\n\nGA140C机型不支持\n\n**使用实例**\n\n请求样例：\nGET https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/KvmService\n\nX-Auth-Token: auth_value\n请求消息体：无\n\n响应样例：\n```json\n{\n  \"@odata.context\": \"/redfish/v1/$metadata#HwKvmService.HwKvmService\",\n  \"@odata.id\": \"/redfish/v1/Managers/1/KvmService\",\n  \"@odata.type\": \"#HwKvmService.v1_0_0.HwKvmService\",\n  \"Id\": \"KvmService\",\n  \"Name\": \"Kvm Service\",\n  \"MaximumNumberOfSessions\": 2,\n  \"NumberOfActivatedSessions\": 0,\n  \"ActivatedSessionsType\": null,\n  \"EncryptionConfigurable\": true,\n  \"EncryptionEnabled\": false,\n  \"PersistentUSBConnectionEnabled\": true,\n  \"SessionTimeoutMinutes\": 0,\n  \"AutoOSLockEnabled\": true,\n  \"AutoOSLockType\": \"Custom\",\n  \"VisibleJavaKvm\": true,\n  \"DisableKeyboardDuringBiosStartup\": false,\n  \"AutoOSLockKey\": [\n    \"Control\",\n    \"Alt\",\n    \"L\"\n  ],\n  \"Actions\": {\n    \"#KvmService.SetKvmKey\":"}
{"reference_id": "6", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 1121,\r\n  \"question\": \"RAID-SP686C/ RAID-SP186卡ddiso安装OS指导_openEuler20.03SP3 - content: 一、下载软件包\\n\\n根据OS下载对应驱动软件包，如下以openEuler20.03SP3举例说明，链接：TaiShanServer iDriver 系列 智能管理软件4.0.3 软件补丁下载 - 华为\\n\\n驱动软件包如下：\\n\\n二、OS安装\\n\\n说明：\\n（1）RAID卡已通过optionROM界面配置完成用于OS安装的RAID组，建议OS安装用双盘RAID1，操作指导详细见：华为服务器 RAID控制卡 用户指南(Arm) 04 - 华为\\n（2）设置启动项：华为服务器 RAID控制卡 用户指南(Arm) 04 - 华为\\n\\n（3）HDD介质需要关闭盘cache功能\\n创建RAID组时，如果是HDD盘并且用于安装系统，建议关闭盘cache功能\\n\\n步骤1：虚拟光驱挂载系统ISO镜像\\n\\n登录BMC网页（或者使用kvm_client_windows工具登录）并输入服务器BMC IP地址以及用户名和密码。\\n在虚拟控制台窗口工具栏中，单击（光驱图标）。\\n弹出虚拟光驱对话框，如图2-1所示。\\n图2-1 虚拟光驱对话框\\n\\n选中“镜像文件”，单击“浏览”。\\n弹出“打开”对话框。\\n选择操作系统的ISO镜像文件，单击“打开”。\\n在虚拟光驱对话框中，单击“连接”。\\n当“连接”显示为“断开”后，表示虚拟光驱已连接到服务器。\\n\\n步骤2 ：重启系统\\n\\n1.在工具栏中，单击（重启图标），选择重启。\\n弹出确认对话框。\\n2.单击“确定”。\\n3.在系统启动阶段，按“Delete”进入BIOS。\\n4.按“←”、“→”方向键切换至“Exit”界面。\\n5.选择虚拟光驱启动（UEFI DVD-ROM VM 1.1.0），按“Enter”，如图2-2所示。\\n图2-2 选择虚拟光驱启动\\n\\n步骤 3：安装系统\\n\\n1.进入安装起始界面，默认选择第一项，然后按‘e’\\n\\n2.如下图选择在linux行末添加“linux dd”，然后按“Ctrl+x”启动\\n\\n3.加载驱动，在如下图界面，加载iso格式驱动，需要先弹出系统镜像，然后再插入驱动iso。\\n\\n4.安装驱动iso镜像，输入“r”回车刷新，再输入驱动iso序号，本次为“1”，回车，可看到挂载的驱动镜像，输入“1”回车选择驱动，再输入“c”回车加载驱动\\n\\n5.虚拟光驱弹出驱动镜像，插入系统ISO，输入“r”刷新，按系统ISO序号，本次为“4”，再输入“c”进入系统\\n\\n6.等待几分钟后，进入系统安装界面\\n\\n7.识别到硬盘后，根据客户实际需要进行安装\\nlinks: #h-1, https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/management-software/taishanserver-idriver-pid-251215329/software/258151893?idAbsPath=fixnode01%7C23710424%7C251364417%7C9856629%7C251215329, #os-2, https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/doc/EDOC1100048779/3cde3102, https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/doc/EDOC1100048779/c56771cf, #h-1iso-3, #h-2-4, #h-3-5\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": {"reference_id": "7", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 4678,\r\n  \"question\": \"openeuler kvm虚拟机virt-insatll命令行部署 - content: 想要在openeuler 22.03 lts sp3 系统中 再虚拟一个ubuntu22.04，也不是非常复杂\\n宿主机使用VM 安装openeuler 22.03 lts sp3   打开CPU嵌套虚拟化功能\\n\\n1 准备阶段：以下命令，在宿主机openeuler 22.03 lts sp3 系统操作：\\n开放一个端口用于VNC连接，需要大于等于5900 ，此处使用5906端口\\nfirewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=5906/tcp        #–permanent永久 回显success\\nfirewall-cmd --reload        #回显success 重新加载firewalld的配置以使更改生效\\n创建网桥，没有网桥，只能宿主机访问虚拟机，外网不能访问。 网桥相当于一个虚拟交换机，可以使宿主机和虚拟机处于同一个网段，配置网桥 ，物理机、虚拟机网卡都行\\nip  add  查看网卡名字  我的是ens33  地址  172.16.100.17/24\\nens33: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000\\nlink/ether 00:0c:29:8b:b4:51 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff\\ninet 172.16.100.17/24 brd 172.16.100.255 scope global noprefixroute ens33\\ncd /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/   #切换到网卡文件目录，里面有ifcfg-ens33一个网卡文件\\n备份网卡文件 cp ifcfg-ens33 ifcfg-ens33.bak\\n在/etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ It serves as a guidance mechanism to recommend specific actions or steps to address a reported issue. The Resolution field is typically implemented as a string value that provides clear, actionable recommendations for users or administrators to resolve the error or condition described. These recommendations may include specific corrective procedures, configuration changes, or system checks. In cases where no action is required, the field may contain the value \"None,\" indicating that the issue does not necessitate intervention. This value is consistently used across multiple descriptions to denote the absence of a recommended fix. The Resolution field is also present in various message formats, including those in error responses, where it suggests appropriate follow-up actions. It functions as a key component in diagnostic and troubleshooting workflows, helping users interpret and respond to system alerts efficiently. While several descriptions refer to Resolution as a parameter or property in Redfish responses, its core purpose remains consistent: delivering actionable guidance for addressing issues, with \"None\" signaling that no corrective measure is necessary. Although one distinct interpretation exists—where Resolution refers to display settings such as 3840×2160 or 640×480—this usage is contextually separate and semantically different from the technical diagnostic context described in the majority of entries. However, given the overwhelming consistency of the diagnostic interpretation across the input, the primary and predominant definition of \"Resolution\" in this context is as a string field within ExtendedInfo or error messages recommending corrective actions for reported issues.<SEP>Resolution is a field in the response describing possible actions to resolve an issue.<SEP>Resolution is a field in message configuration that provides guidance on how to address a message event.<SEP>Resolution refers to the number of pixels displayed on a screen, defining image clarity.<SEP>Resolution indicates the display resolution of the system, set to 1600x900 pixels."}

{"entity": "KVM", "type": "artifact", "description": "KVM refers to two distinct, commonly conflated concepts: Kernel-based Virtual Machine, a virtualization technology integrated into the Linux kernel, and Keyboard, Video, Mouse, a remote console access technology. The primary and most widely recognized meaning of KVM is Kernel-based Virtual Machine, a full virtualization solution for Linux systems that enables the creation, management, and execution of virtual machines on x86 and aarch64 architectures, including Kunpeng 920 servers. As a part of the Linux kernel since 2007, KVM functions as a hypervisor, leveraging hardware virtualization extensions such as Intel VT-x and AMD SVM to provide near-native performance. It operates via the /dev/kvm device interface and the kvm kernel module, forming the foundation for virtualization platforms like QEMU and libvirt. KVM is used extensively in enterprise environments and open-source distributions such as openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP4 to support virtualized workloads, allowing multiple virtual machines to run concurrently on a single physical server. It is employed for tasks such as system boot management, PXE boot setup, and remote diagnostics.\n\nThe second interpretation of KVM stands for Keyboard, Video, Mouse, referring to a remote console technology used for network-based access to a server's console. This functionality enables users to remotely control the keyboard, video output, and mouse input of a server, ideal for system administration, boot-time diagnostics, and troubleshooting. This KVM service is often integrated into server management frameworks like iBMC and is accessible via protocols operating on port 2198, handling control messages and data transmission. It supports session-based access, with session count and mode settings, and is frequently used in conjunction with virtual console interfaces such as those managed through the iam system. Notably, this remote KVM feature can be accessed through eSPI for virtualized console access and is relied upon for capturing and displaying server OS images during boot processes. Despite the shared acronym, this usage is distinct from Kernel-based Virtual Machine and pertains to remote management rather than virtual machine hosting.\n\nDue to the dual meanings of KVM, potential confusion exists in technical documentation and user interfaces. While both concepts are used in Linux-based server environments, they serve different roles: KVM as a hypervisor enables virtualization infrastructure, whereas KVM as a remote console enables out-of-band server access. In some contexts, such as Kunpeng 920 server deployments, KVM-based virtualization has been observed to exhibit boot issues and kernel-related errors, highlighting the importance of appropriate hardware and software compatibility. Overall, KVM as Kernel-based Virtual Machine is a core component of modern Linux virtualization, while the KVM remote console technology remains a vital tool for server management and system recovery.<SEP>KVM (Keyboard, Video, Mouse) is a remote access technology used for controlling a computer system remotely through virtualized input and output.<SEP>KVM is a virtual machine monitor used for remote access and control of a system, with configurations for shared and exclusive access modes.<SEP>KVM (Keyboard, Video, Mouse) is a hardware solution used for remote server management, experiencing display issues after system startup.<SEP>KVM is a hardware device used to switch video, audio, and computer signals between multiple sources and displays."}

{"entity": "openUBMC", "type": "artifact", "description": "openUBMC is an open-source firmware and software project providing BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) functionality and infrastructure for server and hardware management. Developed and maintained by Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd., it is licensed under the Mulan PSL v2 license and serves as a comprehensive platform for managing server systems through standardized interfaces. The project is closely associated with the rackmount repository, which it maintains on GitCode, including configuration files for tools like ipmcget and source code for BMC firmware and system-level commands.\n\nopenUBMC functions as a modular, micro-component-based framework with a software architecture that supports scalability and developer-friendliness, leveraging the Skynet framework for task management and enabling concurrent operations via skynet.fork. It incorporates multiple components such as the iam (identity and access management), nsm (network services management), oms (operational maintenance), devmon (device monitoring), and Storage components for managing storage devices, power supplies, and NVMe/SATA hardware. The system supports advanced features such as CPLD zero-downtime upgrades, dynamic PCIe card loading, and secure file operations using C and Lua libraries to mitigate vulnerabilities.\n\nThe platform provides a full-stack solution for BMC-based systems, offering management capabilities through multiple protocols, including IPMI, Redfish (with OEM extensions like SchemaComplianceMode and vendor-specific namespaces), SNMP (with SNMPv3 authPriv security), Web REST API, and CLI. It includes support for hardware abstraction layers, enabling compatibility with various storage protocols such as NVMe-MI and SFF VPD, and manages hardware health via sensors, alarms, and telemetry reporting. Commands are extensively documented, with versioning tracked in revision histories; notable versions include 1.0.0 (initial release), 25.06 (released June 26, 2025), and 26.09 (introducing enhanced security features and configurations).\n\nopenUBMC also supports enterprise-grade management features such as iBMCv2 transition capability, secure boot, and customizable configuration policies. It provides a suite of SDKs, dev tools, Docker images, and build frameworks (using Conan, CMake, and U-Boot) that facilitate incremental development and integration with multi-chip and low-memory environments. The system includes diagnostic and self-discovery mechanisms like CSR-based hardware reading and supports VME-based firmware upgrades. It integrates with higher-layer systems via Northbound interfaces, including Redfish, Web-backend, CLI, and SNMP, enabling full-scenario, full-connection, and full-intelligence operations.\n\nThe project is deeply embedded in open-source ecosystems like openEuler and promotes standardization through its management of MIB modules (e.g., OPENUBMC-SERVER-MIB), technical specifications, and documentation. It oversees command definitions (e.g., Activate Session, Get-BBU-Cell-Voltage, Set-ACPI-Power-State, Cold Reset), protocol stacks, and security models. The organization behind openUBMC maintains repositories, manages version control, and ensures consistent release cycles and compliance with open standards: the software is used for monitoring, power management, event handling, configuration management, and product lifecycle operations across server and network equipment."}

{"entity": "BMC", "type": "artifact", "description": "BMC refers to the Baseboard Management Controller, a specialized microcontroller embedded in server motherboards and computer systems to monitor and manage hardware health, configuration, and remote administration. It serves as a dedicated subsystem responsible for overseeing system-level functions such as environmental monitoring, including temperature, fan speed, power supply status, and GPU temperatures. The BMC operates independently of the main system processor, enabling out-of-band management, which allows for remote diagnostics, monitoring, and control even when the primary system is powered off or unresponsive. It supports standardized protocols such as IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) and MCTP (Management Controller Transport Protocol), facilitating commands for hardware discovery, sensor data collection, and event reporting. The BMC is critical in managing system health by generating default sensor numbers, handling data source synchronization, and triggering alarms during fault conditions. It plays an essential role in lifecycle management, including firmware updates, verification, parsing, and coordination of upgrade processes—such as those involving CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) firmware—where it initiates, manages, and validates upgrades. Additionally, the BMC manages network configuration, including IPMI communication, session handling, and gateway connectivity, and supports features like NTP synchronization for system timekeeping. It handles various hardware functions such as monitoring M.2 drive attributes (presence, capacity, health, temperature, remaining life), managing PCIe devices, and supporting remote server installation and firmware provisioning. The BMC also manages system components such as the ASU modul, including handling hot-plug events and configuration synchronization, and communicates via protocols like LocalBus and IPMB (Intelligent Platform Management Bus), typically assigned the slave address 0x20. It manages user access through systems like LDAP and SNMP, enables two-factor authentication through certificate import, and supports storing critical data such as Silkscreen configurations, SR files, CSR (Certificate Signing Request) data, and SilkConfig JSON files. While primarily a hardware component, certain descriptions reference BMC as an organization involved in system management, digital certificate issuance, firmware upgrades, and configuration services. However, the overwhelming majority of descriptions consistently identify BMC as a hardware-based Baseboard Management Controller responsible for hardware monitoring, remote control, system configuration, and inventory reporting in enterprise and rack-mounted server environments."}

{"entity": "Service", "type": "concept", "description": "Service is a term used across multiple technical domains, each reflecting a distinct yet conceptually related role. In Kubernetes, Service is a fundamental abstraction that defines a stable network endpoint for accessing a set of Pods, enabling reliable communication within a containerized cluster. It supports various types: ClusterIP for internal cluster networking, NodePort for exposing services on static ports across nodes, and LoadBalancer for external access via cloud provider infrastructure. Kubernetes Services manage traffic distribution among Pods and are integral to container orchestration, often complementing cgroups for resource control. They represent logical groupings of containerized workloads with defined access patterns, transcending individual applications.\n\nWithin operating systems, particularly Linux distributions like openEuler, Service denotes a background process or daemon managed by the systemd init system. These Services are configured via unit files that define execution behavior, dependencies, restart policies, and recovery mechanisms, ensuring reliability and consistency in system-level operations. The Service directory contains system-level service scripts that facilitate startup, monitoring, and lifecycle management of such processes. This model underpins critical system functions and enables robust, automated management of daemons.\n\nIn software engineering and system architecture, Service refers to a functional component with a defined lifecycle: init → start → run → stop → cleanup. It may be registered and managed by a service factory within frameworks such as libmcpp, or by a centralized ServiceManager, ensuring controlled deployment, lifecycle management, and consistent behavior. D-Bus services further extend this concept, representing logical entities that encapsulate a set of objects provided by a process, identified by a unique name, enabling inter-process communication across system boundaries.\n\nIn enterprise software contexts, Service denotes ongoing support functions, including updates, patches, technical assistance, and maintenance, vital for long-term system stability and security. This interpretation is evident in projects like openEuler/eggo, where the term is used to describe a repository section handling external integrations and deployment services. Additionally, in state management, Service appears as a state value—such as in TaskState—to indicate that a task is managed by a background service, or as a status indicator for system features like remote event synchronization, where it denotes that the service is enabled but currently inactive.\n\nWhile the term “Service” shares a unifying theme—providing functionality or access—the specific meaning varies significantly depending on context. These include Kubernetes networking abstractions, systemd-managed daemons, software component models, D-Bus communication constructs, lifecycle-manged system units, and state indicators. Despite these diverse implementations, they all reflect the core idea of structured, managed access to services for reliable system and application operation. The multiplicity of meanings underscores the necessity of contextual clarity when discussing “Service” within technical environments.<SEP>Service refers to a system or functional component that can be queried or managed via the ipmcget tool, particularly in the context of hardware or system monitoring.<SEP>Service is a runtime component responsible for managing business logic and operations.<SEP>A Service refers to a functional component in the system, such as a network protocol or console service.<SEP>A service is a background process managed by the operating system, such as a Docker daemon."}

{"entity": "POST", "type": "event", "description": "POST is an HTTP method widely used across various system resources and services to create new resources, submit data, or initiate actions on a server. It is a fundamental HTTP verb supported by the Redfish interface and other API frameworks, primarily for sending data to a server to create or update a resource. The method is extensively employed in system management and configuration tasks, such as creating new disk erase configurations within the SPDriveEraseCollection, generating new OS installation configurations, and establishing new SPRAID resource instances. POST is also used to create or update secure data elements, including certificates via the Certificates resource, account configurations, and license information through the LicenseService. It facilitates the submission of data for processing, such as update parameters to trigger the SimpleUpdate action or test metric reports in the ClearMetricReports action.\n\nThe method is instrumental in managing and triggering specific operations across multiple system components. For instance, POST is used to perform actions on the KvmService resource, such as setting KVM key configurations, and on the NTP service to import group keys via the #NtpService.ImportNtpKey action. It also supports invoking actions on the WorkRecord resource, such as adding new work records, and on the LogService to export logs. In addition, POST enables the creation and submission of diagnostic configurations via the SPDiagnoseCollection, and allows for system-level tasks such as initiating memory isolation or scrubbing processes on the MemoryHighRAS resource or within the FPCService.\n\nPOST plays a critical role in firmware and system management workflows, including initiating firmware update actions, installing new SP plugins, and managing drive and PCIe device resources. It is also used to create custom roles within the RoleCollection, perform actions on the SecurityService, and manage network adapter configurations. Furthermore, POST is utilized in specialized contexts like triggering the GenerateCSR action, replacing certificates, resetting ThermalMetrics, and refreshing installable BMA via the SmsService. The method is consistently applied in resource creation and action invocation across the Redfish API, demonstrating its versatility as a standard mechanism for server-side data processing and state changes. In all these contexts, POST serves as the primary method for transmitting request bodies to the server, thereby enabling dynamic and stateful interactions with system resources."}

{"reference_id": "4", "content": "mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nCursor\\n在 Cursor 的 MCP 配置中添加：\\n使用 npx：\\n{\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"]\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n使用全局安装：\\n{\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nCline (VS Code Extension)\\n在 VS Code 设置中配置 MCP servers：\\n使用 npx：\\n{\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"]\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n使用全局安装：\\n{\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\nTrae-CN\\n在 trae 设置中配置 MCP servers：\\n使用 npx：\\n{\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"npx\\\",\\n      \\\"args\\\": [\\\"-y\\\", \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"]\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n使用全局安装：\\n{\\n  \\\"mcpServers\\\": {\\n    \\\"openeuler-portal\\\": {\\n      \\\"command\\\": \\\"openeuler-portal-mcp\\\"\\n    }\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n详细功能说明\\n1. SIG 信息查询 (get_sig_info)\\n查询 openEuler 特别兴趣小组（SIG）的详细信息，或查询仓库/maintainer 所属的 SIG 组。\\n何时使用：\\n\\n用户询问某个 SIG 的信息、维护者、仓库等\\n用户提到具体的 SIG 名称（如 Kernel、ai、Compiler）\\n用户想了解某个仓库属于哪些 SIG 组\\n用户想查询某个 maintainer 参与了哪些 SIG 组\\n\\n参数：\\n\\nsig_name (string, 必需): 查询关键词，可以是 SIG 名称、仓库名或 maintainer 的 Gitee ID\\nquery_type (string, 可选): 查询类型，默认为 “sig”（智能查询）\\n\\n\\\"sig\\\": 智能查询模式，自动按 SIG → 仓库 → maintainer 顺序尝试\\n\\\"repos\\\": 仅查询仓库所属的 SIG 组\\n\\\"maintainer\\\": 仅查询 maintainer 所属的 SIG 组\\n\\n特性：\\n\\n智能查询：自动识别输入类型，无需指定查询模式\\n模糊搜索：支持不同大小写变体（如 ai → AI）\\n多类型支持：可查询 SIG、仓库、maintainer\\n\\n返回信息：\\n\\nSIG 基本信息（名称、描述、邮件列表）\\nMaintainers 列表和详细信息\\n仓库列表（最多显示 20 个）\\nCommitters 统计（显示前 10 位活跃贡献者）\\n分支管理信息（显示前 3 个分支组）\\n\\n示例问题：\\n\\n“Kernel SIG 的维护者是谁？”\\n“ai SIG 管理哪些仓库？”\\n“kernel 仓库属于哪些 SIG 组？”\\n“gzbang 这个 maintainer 参与了哪些 SIG？”\\n\\n2. CVE 安全公告查询 (get_cve_info)\\n查询 openEuler CVE（Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures）安全公告信息。\\n何时使用：\\n\\n用户询问安全漏洞、CVE 信息\\n用户想了解某个软件包的安全问题\\n用户查询特定 CVE 编号的详情\\n\\n参数：\\n\\nkeyword (string, 必需): 查询关键词，可以是 CVE 编号或软件包名\\npage (number, 可选): 页码，默认为 1\\npage_size (number, 可选): 每页显示记录数，默认 20，最大 1000\\n\\n返回信息：\\n\\nCVE ID（漏洞编号）\\n摘要（漏洞描述）\\nCVSS 评分（漏洞严重程度）\\n状态（如已修复、调查中等）\\n发布时间和更新时间\\n受影响的产品和软件包\\n安全公告编号\\n\\n示例问题：\\n\\n“查询 kernel 相关的 CVE”\\n“openssl 有哪些安全漏洞？”\\n“CVE-2024-1234 的详细信息”\\n\\n3. 下载信息查询 (get_download_info)\\n查询 openEuler 下载信息、镜像仓列表和版本信息。\\n何时使用：\\n\\n用户想下载 openEuler ISO 镜像\\n用户询问某个版本的下载地址\\n用户想查找镜像站点\\n用户想了解有哪些可用版本\\n\\n参数：\\n\\nquery (string, 必需): 查询关键词\\nquery_type (string, 可选): 查询类型，默认为 “auto”\\n\\n\\\"auto\\\": 自动查询，支持版本号和模糊搜索"}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "---\nresource_type: \"KvmService\"\n\nparent_resource_type: \"Managers\"\n\nresource_definition : \"oem\"\n\nversion: \"v1_0_0\"\n\ndate: 2026/07/01\n\ntitle: KvmService\n---\n\n# ResourceDefinition\n\n## uris\n\n- `/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/KvmService`\n\n## properties\n\n| 名称 | 类型 | 是否只读 | 取值范围/枚举值 | 说明 |\n| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |\n| @odata.context | string | true |  | KVM资源模型的OData描述信息 |\n| @odata.id | string | true |  | KVM资源的访问路径 |\n| @odata.type | string | true |  | KVM资源的类型 |\n| Id | string | false |  | KVM资源的ID |\n| Name | string | true |  | KVM资源的名称 |\n| MaximumNumberOfSessions | number | true |  | KVM最大会话数 |\n| NumberOfActivatedSessions | number | true |  | KVM当前会话数 |\n| ActivatedSessionsType | string | true |  | KVM会话类型 <br>● “Shared”：共享 <br>● “Private”：独占 <br>● null：暂无会话 |\n| EncryptionConfigurable | boolean | true |  | KVM加密可配置状态 <br>● “true”：KVM加密使能状态支持修改 <br>● “false”：KVM加密使能状态默认开启且不支持修改 |\n| EncryptionEnabled | boolean | false |  | KVM加密使能 |\n| PersistentUSBConnectionEnabled | boolean | false |  | 虚拟键盘、鼠标持续连接使能 |\n| SessionTimeoutMinutes | number | false |  | 会话超时时间 |\n| AutoOSLockEnabled | boolean | false |  | 系统自动锁定使能 <br>● “true”：支持最后一个远程登录用户离开时，业务侧OS自动锁定 <br>● “false”：不支持业务侧OS自动锁定 |\n| AutoOSLockType | string | false |  | 系统自动锁定方式 <br>● “Custom”：自定义 <br>● “Windows”：Windows锁定 |\n| AutoOSLockKey | array | false |  | 系统自动锁定自定义快捷键 |\n| VisibleJavaKvm | boolean | true |  | Java KVM入口显示状态 <br>● true：显示 <br>● false：不显示 |\n| DisableKeyboardDuringBiosStartup | boolean | false |  | 禁止BIOS启动阶段通过热键进入BIOS Setup菜单BMC300 5.10.0.1及以上版本支持 |\n| KvmService.SetKvmKey | object | true |  | 设置KVM Key |\n| target | string | true |  | 操作路径 |\n| Redfish.ActionInfo | string | true |  | 操作信息查询路径 |\n| code | string | true |  | 指示消息注册表中特定消息ID的字符串 |\n| message | string | true |  | 与消息注册表中的消息对应的易读的错误消息 |\n| MessageId | string | true |  | 消息ID |\n| RelatedProperties | array | true |  | 消息相关属性 |\n| Message | string | true |  | 详细信息 |\n| MessageArgs | array | true |  | 信息参数 |\n| Severity | string | true |  | 严重性Redfish支持的严重级别包括：OK、Warning、Critical |\n| Resolution | string | true |  | 解决建议 |\n\n## supported_methods\n\n- GET\n- PATCH\n- POST\n\n# HTTP methods\n\n## GET\n\n**命令功能**\n\n查询 KVM 资源\n\n**命令格式**\n\nURL: https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/KvmService\n\n请求头:\n```\nX-Auth-Token: auth_value\n```\n\n\n请求消息体: 无\n\n**参数说明**\n\n| 参数 | 参数说明 | 取值 |\n|------|----------|------|\n| device_ip | 登录设备的IP地址 | IPv4或IPv6地址 |\n| auth_value | 请求消息的鉴权参数 | 可通过/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions创建会话时获得 |\n\n**使用指南**\n\nGA140C机型不支持\n\n**使用实例**\n\n请求样例：\nGET https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/KvmService\n\nX-Auth-Token: auth_value\n请求消息体：无\n\n响应样例：\n```json\n{\n  \"@odata.context\": \"/redfish/v1/$metadata#HwKvmService.HwKvmService\",\n  \"@odata.id\": \"/redfish/v1/Managers/1/KvmService\",\n  \"@odata.type\": \"#HwKvmService.v1_0_0.HwKvmService\",\n  \"Id\": \"KvmService\",\n  \"Name\": \"Kvm Service\",\n  \"MaximumNumberOfSessions\": 2,\n  \"NumberOfActivatedSessions\": 0,\n  \"ActivatedSessionsType\": null,\n  \"EncryptionConfigurable\": true,\n  \"EncryptionEnabled\": false,\n  \"PersistentUSBConnectionEnabled\": true,\n  \"SessionTimeoutMinutes\": 0,\n  \"AutoOSLockEnabled\": true,\n  \"AutoOSLockType\": \"Custom\",\n  \"VisibleJavaKvm\": true,\n  \"DisableKeyboardDuringBiosStartup\": false,\n  \"AutoOSLockKey\": [\n    \"Control\",\n    \"Alt\",\n    \"L\"\n  ],\n  \"Actions\": {\n    \"#KvmService.SetKvmKey\":"}

{"reference_id": "7", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 4678,\r\n  \"question\": \"openeuler kvm虚拟机virt-insatll命令行部署 - content: 想要在openeuler 22.03 lts sp3 系统中 再虚拟一个ubuntu22.04，也不是非常复杂\\n宿主机使用VM 安装openeuler 22.03 lts sp3   打开CPU嵌套虚拟化功能\\n\\n1 准备阶段：以下命令，在宿主机openeuler 22.03 lts sp3 系统操作：\\n开放一个端口用于VNC连接，需要大于等于5900 ，此处使用5906端口\\nfirewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=5906/tcp        #–permanent永久 回显success\\nfirewall-cmd --reload        #回显success 重新加载firewalld的配置以使更改生效\\n创建网桥，没有网桥，只能宿主机访问虚拟机，外网不能访问。 网桥相当于一个虚拟交换机，可以使宿主机和虚拟机处于同一个网段，配置网桥 ，物理机、虚拟机网卡都行\\nip  add  查看网卡名字  我的是ens33  地址  172.16.100.17/24\\nens33: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000\\nlink/ether 00:0c:29:8b:b4:51 brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff\\ninet 172.16.100.17/24 brd 172.16.100.255 scope global noprefixroute ens33\\ncd /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/   #切换到网卡文件目录，里面有ifcfg-ens33一个网卡文件\\n备份网卡文件 cp ifcfg-ens33 ifcfg-ens33.bak\\n在/etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ 目录下面，vi ifcfg-ens33  编辑网卡文件，删除原来所有字符，写入以下内容：\\nTYPE=Ethernet\\nNAME=ens33\\nDEVICE=ens33\\nONBOOT=yes\\nBRIDGE=br0\\n注意两个 ens33  需要和你实际网卡名称一样 有的是enp1s0 等等，ip add命令 可以看到网卡名称\\nbr0自定义，你可以写别的字符,但必须前后一致。\\n在/etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ 目录下面，vi ifcfg-br0  新建ifcfg-br0文件，写入以下内容：\\nTYPE=Bridge\\nDEVICE=br0\\nONBOOT=yes\\nIPADDR=172.16.100.17\\nNETMASK=255.255.255.0\\nGATEWAY=172.16.100.254\\nip 地址 子网掩码  网关根据你实际使用情况填写  照抄是没有用的。\\nsystemctl restart NetworkManager    #使网卡编辑更改生效\\nmkdir -p /123   #根目录下面建立一个文件夹 名字123\\n用MobaXterm 或 Xftp 7等终端把   ubuntu22.04安装文件传输进/123文件夹， 完成后在/123目录下面有   ubuntu-22.04.4-live-server-amd64.iso  这样一个文件\\n2 实施阶段： {"reference_id": "8", "content": ",\n    TUESDAY,\n    WEDNESDAY,\n    THURSDAY,\n    FRIDAY,\n    SATURDAY\n};\n\nenum Color {\n    RED,\n    BLACK,\n    BLUE\n};\n\nvoid colorize_calendar(Week today, Color color);\n\ncolorize_calendar(BLUE, SUNDAY); // 编译报错，参数类型错误\n\n// 不好的例子:\nconst int SUNDAY = 0;\nconst int MONDAY = 1;\n\nconst int BLACK  = 0;\nconst int BLUE   = 1;\n\nbool colorize_calendar(int today, int color);\ncolorize_calendar(BLUE, SUNDAY); // 不会报错\n```\n\n当枚举值需要对应到具体数值时，须在声明时显式赋值。否则不需要显式赋值，以避免重复赋值，降低维护(增加、删除成员)工作量。\n\n```cpp\n// 好的例子：S协议里定义的设备ID值，用于标识设备类型\nenum DeviceType {\n    DEV_UNKNOWN = -1,\n    DEV_DSMP = 0,\n    DEV_ISMG = 1,\n    DEV_WAPPORTAL = 2\n};\n```\n\n程序内部使用，仅用于分类的情况，不应该进行显式的赋值。\n\n```cpp\n// 好的例子：程序中用来标识会话状态的枚举定义\nenum SessionState {\n    INIT,\n    CLOSED,\n    WAITING_FOR_RESPONSE\n};\n```\n\n应当尽量避免枚举值重复，如必须重复也要用已定义的枚举来修饰\n\n```cpp\nenum RTCPType {\n    RTCP_SR = 200,\n    RTCP_MIN_TYPE = RTCP_SR,\n    RTCP_RR    = 201,\n    RTCP_SDES  = 202,\n    RTCP_BYE   = 203,\n    RTCP_APP   = 204,\n    RTCP_RTPFB = 205,\n    RTCP_PSFB  = 206,\n    RTCP_XR  = 207,\n    RTCP_RSI = 208,\n    RTCP_PUBPORTS = 209,\n    RTCP_MAX_TYPE = RTCP_PUBPORTS\n};\n```\n\n#### 规则9.1.2 不允许使用魔鬼数字\n\n所谓魔鬼数字即看不懂、难以理解的数字。\n\n魔鬼数字并非一个非黑即白的概念，看不懂也有程度，需要自行判断。\n例如数字 12，在不同的上下文中情况是不一样的：\ntype = 12; 就看不懂，但 `months_count = years_count * 12`; 就能看懂。\n数字 0 有时候也是魔鬼数字，比如 `status = 0`; 并不能表达是什么状态。\n\n解决途径：\n对于局部使用的数字，可以增加注释说明\n对于多处使用的数字，必须定义 const 常量，并通过符号命名自注释。\n\n禁止出现下列情况：\n没有通过符号来解释数字含义，如` const int ZERO = 0`\n符号命名限制了其取值，如 `const int XX_TIMER_INTERVAL_300MS = 300`，直接使用`XX_TIMER_INTERVAL_MS`来表示该常量是定时器的时间间隔。\n\n#### 规则9.1.3 常量应该保证单一职责\n\n**说明**：一个常量只用来表示一个特定功能，即一个常量不能有多种用途。\n\n```cpp\n// 好的例子：协议A和协议B，手机号(MSISDN)的长度都是20。\nconst unsigned int A_MAX_MSISDN_LEN = 20;\nconst unsigned int B_MAX_MSISDN_LEN = 20;\n\n// 或者使用不同的名字空间：\nnamespace Namespace1 {\n    const unsigned int MAX_MSISDN_LEN = 20;\n}\n\nnamespace Namespace2 {\n    const unsigned int MAX_MSISDN_LEN = 20;\n}\n```\n\n#### 规则9.1.4 禁止用memcpy_s、memset_s初始化非POD对象\n\n**说明**：`POD`全称是`Plain Old Data`，是C++ 98标准(ISO/IEC 14882, first edition, 1998-09-01)中引入的一个概念，`POD`类型主要包括`int`, `char`, `float`，`double`，`enumeration`，`void`，指针等原始类型以及聚合类型，不能使用封装和面向对象特性（如用户定义的构造/赋值/析构函数、基类、虚函数等）。\n\n由于非POD类型比如非聚合类型的class对象，可能存在虚函数，内存布局不确定，跟编译器有关，滥用内存拷贝可能会导致严重的问题。\n\n说明：`memcpy_s`、`memset_s`是微软或C11 Annex K提供的安全函数，并非标准C++；在标准C++环境中应使用`std::memcpy`、`std::memset`，或直接通过构造函数完成初始化。\n\n即使对聚合类型的class，使用直接的内存拷贝和比较，破坏了信息隐蔽和数据保护的作用，也不提倡`memcpy_s`、`memset_s`操作。\n\n关于`POD`的详细定义，请参考C++标准对平凡类型（trivial）与标准布局类型（standard-layout type）的说明。\n\n#### 建议9.1.2 变量使用时才声明并初始化\n\n**说明**：变量在使用前未赋初值，是常见的低级编程错误。使用前才声明"}

{"entity": "Controller", "type": "artifact", "description": "The term \"Controller\" refers to a broad category of system components that serve as central management units across various computing domains, with distinct implementations in hardware, software, and storage architectures. In the context of storage systems, a Controller is a hardware or software component responsible for managing and interfacing with storage drives and arrays. It oversees critical operations such as the creation, deletion, and configuration of logical disks, maintains the health status of physical drives, and handles tasks like mode switching and SlowDisk detection. Specifically, in RAID systems, the Controller is a core component responsible for managing both logical and physical disk operations, ensuring data integrity and performance efficiency. The IDE controller is a specialized variant used for interface with storage devices, while a storage controller entity manages array and drive operations with focus on reliability and configuration.\n\nIn the realm of NVMe storage, the Controller functions as the processing unit within an NVMe SSD, receiving commands from submission queues and managing data input/output operations, including queue arbitration. The NVMe Controller acts as the central processing unit of the SSD, executing commands and facilitating data flow between the host system and the storage media. Similarly, in IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) environments, the Controller manages IPMI operations and routes messages to appropriate system components, enabling remote monitoring and management of hardware.\n\nIn web development, particularly within the .NET Framework, \"Controller\" refers to a base class in the System.Web.Mvc namespace, serving as a foundational element for building MVC (Model-View-Controller) controllers. This software-based Controller handles user requests, processes input, and orchestrates responses—providing a structured pattern for web application development.\n\nAdditionally, in the context of test systems, a Controller is defined as the system component responsible for managing the execution of test items, coordinating their operation, and monitoring their status. This includes querying indicator lights and their respective statuses for operational diagnostics. Notably, while the term \"Controller\" is consistently used to denote a central coordinating unit, the specific functionality and scope vary significantly based on the domain—ranging from low-level hardware management in storage and NVMe devices, to high-level software orchestration in web frameworks and system testing.
