Additionally, Type determines the method of data handling, such as bit-level versus block-level read/write operations, and governs the format of data exchange—whether a certificate or license is delivered as plain text or via a URI—and supports export/import formats including \"text\" or \"URI\".\n\nWithin operational and processing workflows, Type specifies the nature of an action or step, identifying the kind of operation to be performed—such as \"Count\", \"Expand\", \"Convert\", \"Suffix-Add\", \"Switch\", or custom \"Script\" transformations—within a processing flow or automation step. It also categorizes resources in system processing, distinguishing between entities like Property, Method, List, Task, or Paging. In command and request structures, Type defines the interface type (e.g., Ethernet, InfiniBand), the HTTP method (e.g., GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE), or the operational mode (e.g., hard or soft reset), with values encoded as U8 integers or strings and used in both request and response bodies.\n\nIn testing and diagnostic frameworks, Type identifies the category of a test or validation procedure—such as self-check, manual preparation, burn-in, result verification, or equipment interaction—specific to Dft classes (e.g., DftI2c, DftSPI, DftUsb, DftNandFlash, DftPmu) with values ranging from 1 to 6. It may also define test item types, with some configurations consistently using the value 4 for LED or PMU tests, and indicates sensor or register access modes (e.g., bit or block level). In firmware and device management, Type identifies controller models or functionality (e.g., SSDP resource type like __initialized.___bmc), firmware components (e.g., Bios), or optical modules.\n\nFurthermore, in runtime environments such as systemd, Type defines service types (e.g., simple, forking, oneshot) and denotes the status of monitoring checks (e.g., starting, running, online). In programming languages like Lua, Type is a built-in function used to determine the runtime type of a variable. While the core function of Type as a classifier and identifier remains consistent, its interpretation varies significantly across technical domains—ranging from hardware component categorization to HTTP method specification and schema-based data typing—underscoring its central role in system interoperability, configuration consistency, and validation across layers of software and hardware infrastructure.<SEP>Type is a field indicating the class or category of a device or unit."}

{"entity": "Fru_Expander", "type": "artifact", "description": "Fru_Expander is a field-replaceable unit (FRU) object that represents an expandable hardware component within a system, specifically associated with an expansion board. It serves as a critical data component responsible for storing and managing key identifiers and metadata, including the FRUID (FRU Identifier), FruId, PCB ID, version, name, power state, health status, EEPROM status, type, data ID, connector group ID, board ID, and a unique identifier. As a FRU object, Fru_Expander plays a central role in system identification and hardware management, providing structured information that maps physical PCB attributes to corresponding FRU data. It functions both as a configuration object and a hardware component, enabling system-level recognition and tracking of the expansion board. Additionally, Fru_Expander acts as a unique key (FruID) used for reading and writing EEPROM contents via IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface), which allows for remote management, diagnostics, and firmware updates. Its comprehensive metadata enables accurate inventory tracking, fault detection, and lifecycle management within the system architecture. Collectively, the descriptions confirm that Fru_Expander is a multifaceted FRU object essential for maintaining hardware integrity, traceability, and operational control within the system."}

{"entity": "UniqueId", "type": "attribute", "description": "UniqueId is a globally unique identifier assigned to a hardware component, primarily used for asset tracking, configuration management, and system inventory. It serves as a critical reference for identifying and managing components across various platforms and systems, particularly within TianChi environments where it is required for component identification. The identifier is typically constructed by combining vendor-specific information and a component ID, forming a structured and standardized format. Multiple descriptions confirm that the UniqueId is derived from Vendor and ComponentID data, often stored in a non-volatile memory source such as EEPROM, ensuring persistent and reliable retrieval. The identifier is automatically assigned to Field Replaceable Units (FRUs) and other Phoenix components at the time of manufacturing or deployment.\n\nThe format of UniqueId is consistent across several instances, with examples such as \"00000001010302023922\" and \"00000001030302023936\" being used in TianChi systems to uniquely represent specific components. While the identifier is mandatory for TianChi components, it is considered optional for other component types, indicating a context-dependent requirement based on system architecture or operational policies. The composite nature of the UniqueId—based on vendor and component ID—ensures global uniqueness and minimizes the risk of identifier collisions across diverse hardware and systems. Overall, UniqueId functions as a standardized, machine-readable, and persistent label essential for lifecycle management, diagnostics, and inventory control in distributed hardware systems.<SEP>UniqueId is a read-only attribute representing the component's unique identifier, derived from Vendor and ComponentID, broadcasting changes."}

{"entity": "BoardId", "type": "attribute", "description": "BoardId is a unique identifier used across various hardware components and systems to distinguish individual board instances within a computing environment. It serves as a digital fingerprint for physical or expansion boards, enabling accurate identification and configuration. The identifier is typically assigned at the hardware level and may be derived from or stored in non-volatile memory such as the EEPROM header, where it is used for hardware identity verification and comparison. For PCIe devices, including network interface cards (NICs) and expansion cards, BoardId specifies the unique board ID, with some examples including \"0x005e\" for specific NICs and \"0x007b\" for the SP570 card. In the context of system boards, BoardId acts as a numeric or string-based identifier, such as a 16-bit value, used to identify the main motherboard or platform board.\n\nThe value of BoardId varies based on system architecture and component type. In non-TianChi systems, BoardId is commonly set to 65535 as a default or placeholder value. Similarly, for Phoenix components, a default value of 65535 is used, while non-Phoenix component boards employ a 16-bit identifier. This distinction indicates that BoardId behavior may be system- or vendor-specific. The field also appears in configuration files, such as the CSR (Component Specification Register) file for network cards, where its absence can lead to configuration errors, underscoring its importance in hardware setup and initialization.\n\nBeyond standard board identification, BoardId plays a role in advanced device management and configuration frameworks. It is used in Redfish URI paths as a placeholder for board-specific references and is integral to configurations like DriveStartSlotConfigItem, where it identifies the unique board housing a hard drive backplane. The identifier is also read directly from the CSR or EEPROM, reinforcing its role in low-level device recognition and diagnostics. Overall, while BoardId is consistently described as a unique identifier for hardware boards across a range of contexts—including system boards, PCIe cards, network adapters, and expansion cards—the specific representation (numeric vs. string, value ranges, default values) depends on the system, component type, and vendor specifications.<SEP>BoardId is a read-only attribute representing the component's board ID, broadcasting changes."}

{"entity": "SystemId", "type": "concept", "description": "SystemId is a unique identifier used across multiple contexts within computing and system management frameworks, primarily to distinguish between individual system instances in multi-host or multi-system environments. It serves as a critical field for scoped configuration, resource identification, and hardware component association. The parameter is consistently described as a read-only, system-level identifier, with most sources defining it as an 8-bit unsigned integer (U8), representing a single byte and typically ranging from 1 to 255, where a value of 1 is the default in single-host scenarios and represents the primary system instance. In some contexts, it is defined as a 32-bit signed (S32) or unsigned (U32) integer, but these instances are rare and may pertain to specific operations such as firmware activation or management events.\n\nSystemId functions as a dynamic placeholder, often expressed as ${SystemId} in configuration files, scripts, or device path templates, dynamically substituted at runtime to reflect the current system context. It appears in various technical contexts: as an optional parameter in the ipmcget command to specify the target system for power state queries or maintenance data retrieval; in request headers to identify a specific system during API or BMC interactions; and as a field in the Redfish API path or hierarchical resource structures (e.g., /bmc/dev/Systems/) to target a particular server or system instance. It is also used in firmware management workflows, such as updates, activations, and digest refreshes, where it identifies the host system or component targeted for operation—either individually or collectively when set to 255 to signify “all systems”.\n\nThe identifier is integral to component-level tracking and belongs to various system components, including fans, LEDs, memory modules, processors, power supplies, pumps, and sensors. It identifies the host system to which these components belong, enabling accurate state reporting, log correlation, and configuration management. For instance, in fan and pump management, SystemId groups cooling-related configurations within a specific system context. Similarly, in memory systems, it represents the OS system or host in which the memory is installed, and in CPU contexts, it denotes the host system where the processor resides, often with a mandatory value range from 1 to 8 in VRD power and configuration fields.\n\nSystemId is widely implemented in BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) environments such as the BMC Kepler framework and is used in multiple classes and structs including DftPowerButton, DftPmu, IsolationItem, StructIdentifier, and awm_m11p_card. It also plays a role in secure boot, event metadata, and privilege setting operations, where it identifies the system context for access control. Although predominantly a U8 field, there are isolated references describing it as a mixed-type, string-based, or 16-bit (U16) attribute, with some sources noting it is currently unused or reserved. Despite these variations, the core function of SystemId remains consistent: to uniquely and reliably tag a system or component to its host within a distributed or multi-instantiated computing environment.\n\nIn summary, SystemId is a critical, read-only, 8-bit unsigned integer identifier used throughout firmware, BMC, and hardware management systems to distinguish between hosts, components, and system instances. It is dynamically resolved in configuration paths, universally defaulting to 1 in single-host deployments, and is used to scope API calls, firmware operations, event tracking, hardware component referencing, and system-specific management tasks across both multi-host and single-host setups. Its versatility and consistency in function across diverse system interfaces highlight its foundational role in system-level identity and orchestration.<SEP>SystemId is a variable used in configuration to identify the system.<SEP>SystemId is a system context variable used in static references, identifying a system instance.<SEP>SystemId is a data field identifying the host system number associated with the sensor using an unsigned 8-bit integer.<SEP>SystemId is a fixed variable name used in resource paths to denote a system identifier."}

{"reference_id": "3", "content": "| 与 TypeId 一一对应 |\n| TypeId | 输出 | uint32 | 控制器型号 ID | SAS3108/3508/3408/3908 等 |\n| Name | 输出 | string | 控制器名称 | CSR 配置或带外获取 |\n| OOBSupport | 输出 | uint8 | 是否支持带外管理 | 0=不支持，1=支持 |\n| FirmwareVersion | 输出 | string | 固件版本 | 依赖 OOB |\n| WorkMode | 输出 | string | 当前工作模式 | RAID/HBA/JBOD/Mixed |\n| SupportedMode | 输出 | string | 支持的工作模式 | — |\n| MemorySizeMiB | 输出 | uint32 | 内存容量 | MiB |\n| SerialNumber | 输出 | string | 序列号 | — |\n| DeviceInterface | 输出 | string | 设备接口速率/协议 | — |\n| SASAddr | 输出 | string | SAS 地址 | — |\n| TemperatureCelsius | 输出 | int32 | 芯片温度 | °C |\n| MaxStripSizeBytes | 输出 | uint32 | 最大条带值 | Bytes |\n| MinStripSizeBytes | 输出 | uint32 | 最小条带值 | Bytes |\n| NVDataVersion | 输出 | string | NVData 版本 | — |\n| PCIeLinkWidth | 输出 | uint8 | PCIe 带宽 | — |\n| ReadCachePercent | 输入/输出 | uint8 | 读缓存比例百分比 | 0~100 |\n| CopyBackState | 输出 | bool | 回拷使能状态 | — |\n| SmarterCopyBackState | 输出 | bool | SMART 回拷使能状态 | — |\n| JBODState | 输出 | bool | JBOD 使能状态 | — |\n| HotSpareActivationMode | 输出 | string | 热备激活模式 | Failure/Predictive/Unknown |\n| NoBatteryWriteCacheEnabled | 输出 | bool | 无电池写缓存使能 | — |\n| BootDevices | 输出 | string | 启动设备列表 | — |\n| DDREccCount | 输出 | uint16 | DDR ECC 错误计数 | — |\n| SupportedRAIDTypes | 输出 | string | 支持的 RAID 级别 | — |\n| HardwareRevision | 输出 | string | 硬件版本 | — |\n| MaintainPDFailHistrory | 输出 | bool | 物理盘故障记忆使能 | — |\n| CryptoEraseSupported | 输出 | bool | 是否支持加密擦除 | — |\n| EpdSupported | 输出 | bool | 是否支持加密 | — |\n| JbodSupported | 输出 | bool | 是否支持 JBOD | — |\n| CachePinnedState | 输出 | bool | Cache Pinned 开关 | — |\n| ConfiguredDriveWriteCachePolicy | 输出 | string | RAID 组成员盘写缓存策略 | Enabled/Disabled/Default |\n| UnconfiguredDriveWriteCachePolicy | 输出 | string | 非 RAID 组成员盘写缓存策略 | Enabled/Disabled/Default |\n| HBADriveWriteCachePolicy | 输出 | string | HBA 模式写缓存策略 | Enabled/Disabled/Default |\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值 | 含义 | 触发条件 | 处理建议 |\n| :----- | :--- | :------- | :------- |\n| 0 | 成功 | 正常执行完成 | 无 |\n| 非 0 | 失败 | 控制器不支持带外或参数非法 | 检查 OOBSupport 和参数 |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- 查询 RAID 控制器基本信息（型号/固件/温度等）\n- 设置控制器工作模式（RAID/HBA/JBOD/Mixed）\n- 配置回拷、JBOD、热备激活模式等高级特性\n- 导入/清除外部配置\n- 收集 RAID 控制器日志\n\n#### 限制条件\n\n- 依赖 OOBSupport=1 的属性在控制器不支持带外管理时无效\n- 工作模式切换可能需要重启生效\n- 恢复出厂设置操作不可逆\n\n#### 调试示例\n\n```bash\n# 查询控制器信息\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller\n\n# 设置控制器工作模式为 RAID\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller SetWorkMode 'a{ss}yy' \\\n    3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator 0 1\n\n# 恢复出厂设置\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller RestoreDefaultSettings 'a{ss}' \\\n    3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator\n```\n\n### 2.4 一致性校验\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.ConsistencyCheck\nNAME             TYPE      SIGNATURE RESULT/VALUE FLAGS\n.Disable         method    a{ss}     -            -\n.Enable          method    a{ss}qyyu -            -\n.SetParameters   method    a{ss}qyy  -            -\n```\n\n#### 功能说明\n\n管理 RAID 控制器一致性校验功能，支持启停校验、设置周期/速率/自动修"}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "RAIDStorage0/Actions/Oem/Public/Storage.RestoreStorageControllerDefaultSettings\",\n          \"@Redfish.ActionInfo\": \"/redfish/v1/Systems/1/Storages/RAIDStorage0/RestoreStorageControllerDefaultSettingsActionInfo\"\n        },\n        \"#Storage.ImportForeignConfig\": {\n          \"target\": \"/redfish/v1/Systems/1/Storages/RAIDStorage0/Actions/Oem/Public/Storage.ImportForeignConfig\",\n          \"@Redfish.ActionInfo\": \"/redfish/v1/Systems/1/Storages/RAIDStorage0/ImportForeignConfigActionInfo\"\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n响应码：200\n\n## POST (ACTION)\n\n### ImportForeignConfig\n\n**命令功能**\n\n导入 Foreign 配置\n\n**命令格式**\n\nURL: https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Systems/system_id/Storages/storage_id/Actions/Oem/Public/Storage.ImportForeignConfig\n\n请求头:\n```\n\nX-Auth-Token: 123456789***********************\nContent-Type: header_type\n```\n\n\n请求消息体:\n```json\n{}\n```\n\n**请求头参数说明**\n\n> 参见 [请求头参数说明](../request_header_param.md#POST-request)\n\n**请求体参数说明**\n\n| 参数 | 参数说明 | 取值 |\n|------|----------|------|\n| system_id | 系统资源的ID | ● 针对机架服务器，取值 为1 <br>● 针对高密服务器，取值 为BladeN（N表示节点 槽位号），例如 “Blade1” <br>● 针对刀片服务器，取值 可以为BladeN（N表示 计算节点槽位号）或 SwiN（N表示交换模块 槽位号），例如 “Swi1” |\n| storage_id | 存储资源的ID | 通过存储集合资源获得。 |\n\n**使用指南**\n\n无\n\n**使用实例**\n\n请求样例：\n```http\nPOST https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Systems/system_id/Storages/storage_id/Actions/Oem/Public/Storage. ImportForeignConfig\n```\n\nX-Auth-Token: 123456789***********************\nContent-Type: header_type\n\n\n请求消息体：\n```json\n{}\n```\n\n响应样例：\n```json\n{\n  \"error\": {\n    \"code\": \"Base.1.0.GeneralError\",\n    \"message\": \"A general error has occurred. See ExtendedInfo for more information.\",\n    \"@Message.ExtendedInfo\": [\n      {\n        \"@odata.type\": \"#Message.v1_0_0.Message\",\n        \"MessageId\": \"Base.1.0.Success\",\n        \"RelatedProperties\": [],\n        \"Message\": \"Successfully Completed Request\",\n        \"MessageArgs\": [],\n        \"Severity\": \"OK\",\n        \"Resolution\": \"None\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n响应码：200\n\n## POST (ACTION)\n\n### ClearForeignConfig\n\n**命令功能**\n\n清除 Foreign 配置\n\n**命令格式**\n\nURL: https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Systems/system_id/Storages/storage_id/Actions/Oem/Public/Storage.ClearForeignConfig\n\n请求头:\n```\n\nX-Auth-Token: 123456789***********************\nContent-Type: header_type\n```\n\n\n请求消息体:\n```json\n{}\n```\n\n**请求头参数说明**\n\n> 参见 [请求头参数说明](../request_header_param.md#POST-request)\n\n**请求体参数说明**\n\n| 参数 | 参数说明 | 取值 |\n|------|----------|------|\n| system_id | 系统资源的ID | ● 针对机架服务器，取值 为1 <br>● 针对高密服务器，取值 为BladeN（N表示节点 槽位号），例如 “Blade1” <br>● 针对刀片服务器，取值 可以为BladeN（N表示 计算节点槽位号）或 SwiN（N表示交换模块 槽位号），例如 “Swi1” <br>● 针对X6800 V5，X6000 V5，G5500，XA320 V2服务器，取值还可以 为Enc，表示计算节点 所在的机框资源 <br>● 针对设备U位信息，取 值可以为UN(N表示设 备U位号)，例如\"U1\" <br>● 针对机柜资源，取值为 Rack |\n| storage_id | 存储资源的ID | 通过存储集合资源获得。 |\n\n**使用指南**\n\n无\n\n**使用实例**\n\n请求样例：\n```http\nPOST https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Systems/system_id/Storages/storage_id/Actions/Oem/Public/Storage.ClearForeignConfig\n```\n\nX-Auth-Token: 123456789***********************\nContent-Type: header_type\n\n\n请求消息体：\n```json\n{}\n```\n\n响应样例：\n```json\n{\n  \"error\": {\n    \"code\": \"Base.1.0.GeneralError\",\n    \"message\": \"A general error has occurred. See ExtendedInfo for more information.\",\n    \"@Message.ExtendedInfo\": [\n      {\n        \"@odata.type\": \"#Message.v1_0_0.Message\",\n        \"MessageId\": \"Base.1.0.Success\",\n        \"RelatedProperties\": [],\n        \"Message\": \"Successfully Completed Request\",\n        \"MessageArgs\": [],\n        \"Severity\": \"OK\",\n        \"Resolution\": \"None\"\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n响应码：200\n\n\n## POST (ACTION)\n\n### RestoreStorageControllerDefaultSettings\n\n**命令功能**\n\n恢复指定控制器的默认配置\n\n**命令格式**\n\nURL: https"}
{"reference_id": "1", "content": "'cachecade=1' is specified, RAID level 0/1 is valid. r0: RAID0 r1: RAID1 r5: RAID5 r6: RAID6 r10: RAID10 r50: RAID50 r60: RAID60 pd=<PD IDs> The physical drives IDs which participate this logical drive. It is mandatory. name=<Logical drive name> Logical drive name, which consists of ASCII characters except the semicolon (;). It is optional. size=<Logical drive size> The size of logical drive and unit can be 'm'(megabytes),'g'(gigabytes), or 't'(terabytes). It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. ss=<Logical drive strip size> The strip size of logical drive. The valid values are 64k,128k,256k,512k,1M. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. sc=<Span count> The span count of logical drive. The default is 1 when RAID level is RAID0/1/5/6 and 2 when RAID level is RAID10/50/60. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. rp=<Read Policy> The read policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. ra: Read Ahead nra: No Read Ahead wp=<Write Policy> The write policy of logical drive. It is optional. wt: Write Through wbwithbbu: Write Back with BBU wb: Write Back iop=<IO Policy> The IO policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. cio: Cached IO dio: Direct IO ap=<Access Policy> The access policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. rw: Read Write ro: Read only blocked: Blocked dcp=<Disk Cache Policy> The disk cache policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. enabled: Enable disk cache disabled: Disable disk cache default: Unchanged(Disk's default) init=<Init Type> The initialization type of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. no: No init quick: Quick init full: Full init cachecade=1 Logical drive is used for secondary cache. It is optional. It must be supported by RAID controller first. Note: Character ';' is not valid for logical drive name string because it is used as separator.\n\n### raidControllerAddLD\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.26`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.26`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`DisplayString`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 26`\n- **描述**：Add logical drive on array on this RAID controller. The arguments are seperated by semicolons; The arguments format is <option1>=<argument>;<option2>=<argument>;...;<optionN>=<argument>; example: array=1;name=example;size=100.375g;ss=512k;rp=ra;wp=wb;iop=cio;ap=rw;dcp=enabled;init=quick;block=1; Options and arguments: array=<Array ID> The array on which the logical drive will be added. It is mandatory. name=<Logical drive name> The name of logical drive and maximum is 15 printable ASCII characters except ';'. It is optional. size=<Logical drive size> The size of logical drive and unit can be 'm'(megabytes),'g'(gigabytes), or 't'(terabytes). It is optional. ss=<Logical drive strip size> The strip size of logical drive. The valid values are 64k,128k,256k,512k,1M. It is optional. rp=<Read Policy> The read policy of logical drive. It is optional. ra: Read Ahead nra: No Read Ahead wp=<Write Policy> The write policy of logical drive. It is optional. wt: Write Through wbwithbbu: Write Back with BBU wb: Write Back iop=<IO Policy> The IO policy of logical drive. It is optional. cio: Cached IO dio: Direct IO ap=<Access Policy> The access policy of logical drive. It is optional. rw: Read Write ro: Read only blocked: Blocked dcp=<Disk Cache Policy> The disk cache policy of logical drive. It is optional. enabled: Enable disk cache disabled: Disable disk cache default: Unchanged(Disk's default) init=<Init Type> The initialization type of logical drive. It is optional. no: No init quick: Quick init full: Full init block=<block index> Continuous space to which a logical drive is to be added. It is optional. Note: Character ';' is not valid for logical drive name string because it is used as separator.\n\n### raidControllerDriverName\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.27`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.27`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`DisplayString`\n- **访问权限"}
{"reference_id": "4", "content": "603): Failed to load lsi sml library /usr/lib64/libsml_lsi.so for MegaRAID SAS Controller. error : /usr/lib64/libsml_lsi.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory\nframework ERROR: adapter.c(918): smlib : Add controller management [Ctrl index 0, Ctrl ID 0] failed, return 0x11d8\n```\n\n**修改方法是在manifest.yaml中，libmgmt_protocol下增加配置：**\n\n```text\n  - conan: libmgmt_protocol\n    options:\n      storelib_enable: true\n```\n\n增加配置后，重新编译，验证，就可以得到正确的流程，查询相关的DBUS 信息，可以得到相关RAID卡信息；\n\n```text\n~ ~ $ busctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/Controller_1_0101010303 | cat\nNAME                                                   TYPE      SIGNATURE            RESULT/VALUE                             FLAGS\nbmc.kepler.Inventory.Hardware                          interface -                    -                                        -\n.AssetName                                             property  s                    \"MegaRAID 9560-8i 4GB\"                   emits-change\n.AssetTag                                              property  s                    \"N/A\"                                    emits-change\n.AssetType                                             property  s                    \"PCIe RAID Card\"                         emits-change\n.FirmwareVersion                                       property  s                    \"5.290.02-3997\"                          emits-change\n.ManufactureDate                                       property  s                    \"N/A\"                                    emits-change\n.Manufacturer                                          property  s                    \"Broadcom\"                               emits-change\n.Model                                                 property  s                    \"SAS3908\"                                emits-change\n.PCBVersion                                            property  s                    \"N/A\"                                    emits-change\n.PartNumber                                            property  s                    \"06030622\"                               emits-change\n.SerialNumber                                          property  s                    \"SPD3511231\"                             emits-change\n.Slot                                                  property  s                    \"0\"                                      emits-change\n.UUID                                                  property  s                    \"N/A\"                                    emits-change\n```\n\n#### 2、获取RAID卡信息\n\n初始化完成后，开始更新RAID卡信息，调用c_controller:start()如下：\n\n```text\nself:start_update_task()\nself:start_update_pd_list_task()\nself:start_update_ld_list_task()\nself:start_update_phy_err_task()\n```\n\n这些任务负责周期性获取RAID卡信息，比如RAID卡的控制卡、逻辑盘、物理盘，物理盘错误信息等\n举例：start_update_task调用get_ctrl_info函数，通过lua和c代码的映射，最终会调用到对应卡库里面的c函数；\n\n获取到信息后，通过on_update:on函数，触发刷新数据；\n\n```text\nself:update_static_controller_info(info)\nself:update_controller_info(info)\nself:update_asset_data_info()\n```\n\n这些update函数负责更新数据到自身对象的属性中，从dbus上可以获取到相关数据；\n\n#### 3、设置RAID卡信息\n\nRAID卡设置命令的入口是rpc_service_controller文件，需要关注这个文件中定义的各种接口\n举例：ctrl_task_operate是一个入口，通过异步的任务方式执行，避免阻塞；\n举例：ClearForeignConfig接口，是直接执行的，并没有异步执行；\n\n## 配置RAID卡需要关注的点\n\n### 如何查找对应的csr\n\n首先看vpd里面是否已经支持了相应的RAID卡，先拿到RAID卡对应的四元组信息，比如\n制造商ID 0x1000 设备ID 0x10e2 子厂商ID 0x1000 子设备ID 0x4010\n对应的csr文件的名称是：14140130_100010e2_10004010.sr\n\n### 当前底层通信只支持了i2c模式和mctp over pcie模式\n\n如果需要增加其他模式，需要另外开发；\n\n博通的RAID板卡，底层使用的i2c，i2c地址为0x02，如果用i2cdetect看是0x1的位置有相应，最新的hba卡9600使用的mctp协议，还未适配；\nPMC的板卡，底层使用的mctp over pcie，首先需要正常建立起MCTP链路后才能正常进行数据更新，可查看busctl --user tree  bmc.kepler.mctpd | cat是否正常；\n华为的卡，底层使用的mctp over pcie，但是提供了一些i2c地址，可以用来单独查询Lm75，eeprom等相关信息；\n\n## 参考文档\n\n* [pcie_device](https://www.openubmc.cn/docs/zh/development/api/app_api/pcie_device.html)\n* [板卡适配指南](https://www.openubmc.cn/docs/zh/development/develop_guide/feature_development/board_integration.html)\n* [RAID卡配置指南](https://discuss.openubmc.cn/t/topic/1677)\n* [硬件自发现](https://www.openubmc.cn/docs/zh/development/design_reference/key_feature/hardware_discovery.html)"}

{"reference_id": "1", "content": "**数据类型**：`INTEGER { unknown(-1) }`\n- **访问权限**：read-only\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 20`\n- **描述**：Information about the maximum strip size that RAID controller support.\n\n### raidControllerCopybackEnable\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.21`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.21`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`INTEGER { unknown(1), disabled(2), enabled(3) }`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 21`\n- **描述**：Information about the copyback state of RAID controller. 1: Unknown (read only) 2: Disabled 3: Enabled\n\n### raidControllerSMARTerCopybackEnable\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.22`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.22`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`INTEGER { unknown(1), disabled(2), enabled(3) }`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 22`\n- **描述**：Information about the copyback state on SMART error of RAID controller. 1: Unknown (read only) 2: Disabled 3: Enabled Note: Set action is available only when raidControllerCopybackEnable = Enabled.\n\n### raidControllerJBODEnable\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.23`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.23`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`INTEGER { unknown(1), disabled(2), enabled(3) }`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 23`\n- **描述**：Information about the JBOD state of RAID controller. 1: Unknown (read only) 2: Disabled 3: Enabled\n\n### raidControllerRestoreSettings\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.24`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.24`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`INTEGER`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 24`\n- **描述**：Restore RAID controller settings (write only). The argument is: 1: Restore RAID controller settings. others: invalid Note: If the RAID controller type are 3508/3516/9440-8i/9460-8i/9460-16i and firmware version is MR7.9 or later, please reboot the OS to take effect.\n\n### raidControllerCreateLD\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.25`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.25`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`DisplayString`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 25`\n- **描述**：Create new logical drive on this RAID controller. The arguments are seperated by semicolons; The arguments format is <option1>=<argument>;<option2>=<argument>;...;<optionN>=<argument>; example: rl=r1;pd=1,2;name=example;size=100.375g;ss=256k;sc=1;rp=ra;wp=wb;iop=cio;ap=rw;dcp=enabled;init=quick; or rl=r50;pd=1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9;name=example;size=500g;ss=1M;sc=3;rp=ra;wp=wb;iop=cio;ap=rw;dcp=enabled;init=quick; Options and arguments: rl=<RAID level> The RAID level of logical drive. It is mandatory. When 'cachecade=1' is specified, RAID level 0/1 is valid. r0: RAID0 r1: RAID1 r5: RAID5 r6: RAID6 r10: RAID10 r50: RAID50 r60: RAID60 pd=<PD IDs> The physical drives IDs which participate this logical drive. It is mandatory. name=<Logical drive name> Logical drive name, which consists of ASCII characters except the semicolon (;). It is optional. size=<Logical"}
{"reference_id": "6", "content": "�盘检测开关模式，0-关闭，1-开启裸盘、成员盘慢盘检测，2-开启裸盘慢盘检测，3-开启成员盘慢盘检测，0xff-默认不支持 |\n | `SupportedBootDeviceCount` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 表示RAID卡支持的启动盘数量 |\n\n**==方法==**\n\n---\n\n`SetBootDevices`\n\n设置控制器的启动盘设备\n\n**参数**\n- `PriorityDriveName`: String \\- 设备1名称\n- `SecondaryDriveName`: String \\- 设备2名称\n\n---\n\n`SetBootDevicesV2`\n\n批量设置启动盘，设备按数组顺序表示优先级\n\n**参数**\n- `BootDevices`: String[] \\- 启动盘设备数组，数组元素为逻辑盘或物理硬盘的设备名。数组长度最大为可支持的启动盘数量\n\n---\n\n`SetJBODState`\n\n设置控制器的JBOD功能状态\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:Disable  1:Enable\n\n---\n\n`SetSmarterCopyBackState`\n\n设置RAID控制器在检测到物理盘SMART错误之后是否自动进行Copyback\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:Disable  1:Enable\n\n---\n\n`RestoreDefaultSettings`\n\n恢复控制器的默认配置\n\n\n---\n\n`SetCopybackState`\n\n设置控制器的回拷功能\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:Disable  1:Enable\n\n---\n\n`SetMaintainPDFailHistoryState`\n\n用于设置RAID卡硬盘故障记忆功能的开启或者关闭\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:关闭  1:开启\n\n---\n\n`SetWorkMode`\n\n设置控制器的工作模式, Mode的取值为0:RAID, 1:HBA, 2:RAID, 3:MIXED; ProfileId的取值为0\n\n**参数**\n- `Mode`: U8 \\- 工作模式: Mode的取值为0:RAID, 1:HBA, 2:RAID, 3:MIXED\n- `ProfileId`: U8 \\- 配置文件的IP, 取值为0\n\n---\n\n`ImportForeignConfig`\n\n一键导入外部配置\n\n\n---\n\n`DumpLog`\n\n收集RAID控制器信息\n\n\n**返回值**\n- `TaskId`: U32 \\- 任务ID\n\n---\n\n`ClearForeignConfig`\n\n一键清除外部配置\n\n\n---\n\n`SetNoBatteryWriteCache`\n\n设置控制器无电池写缓存状态\n\n**参数**\n- `NoBatteryWriteCacheEnabled`: U8 \\- 0-Disable, 1-Enable\n\n---\n\n`SetReadCachePercent`\n\n设置控制器读缓存百分比\n\n**参数**\n- `ReadCachePercent`: U8 \\- 取值范围：0~100\n\n---\n\n`SetWriteCachePolicy`\n\n设置控制器写缓存策略\n\n**参数**\n- `Type`: String \\- RAID卡下的硬盘管理类型\n- `WriteCachePolicy`: String \\- 写缓存策略\n\n---\n\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.BatteryStatus\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `BatteryPresence` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器下挂载的电池在位信息 |\n | `BatteryFault` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器下挂载的电池故障信息 |\n | `BatteryHealth` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器下挂载的电池健康信息 |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.Chip\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `Model` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | raid卡芯片型号 |\n | `ChipManufacturer` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | raid卡芯片厂商 |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.ConsistencyCheck\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `State` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验功能状态 |\n | `PeriodOfHours` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验周期，单位(小时), 取值范围[1:1440] |\n | `Rate` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验速率 |\n | `AutoRepairEnabled` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验自修复开关 |\n | `RunningStatus` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验状态 |\n | `TotalVolumeCounts` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验需要校验的总数量 |\n | `CompletedVolumeCounts` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验运行已经完成的数量 |\n | `DelayToStart` |"}
```

| 0=不支持，1=支持 |\n| FirmwareVersion | 输出 | string | 固件版本 | 依赖 OOB |\n| WorkMode | 输出 | string | 当前工作模式 | RAID/HBA/JBOD/Mixed |\n| SupportedMode | 输出 | string | 支持的工作模式 | — |\n| MemorySizeMiB | 输出 | uint32 | 内存容量 | MiB |\n| SerialNumber | 输出 | string | 序列号 | — |\n| DeviceInterface | 输出 | string | 设备接口速率/协议 | — |\n| SASAddr | 输出 | string | SAS 地址 | — |\n| TemperatureCelsius | 输出 | int32 | 芯片温度 | °C |\n| MaxStripSizeBytes | 输出 | uint32 | 最大条带值 | Bytes |\n| MinStripSizeBytes | 输出 | uint32 | 最小条带值 | Bytes |\n| NVDataVersion | 输出 | string | NVData 版本 | — |\n| PCIeLinkWidth | 输出 | uint8 | PCIe 带宽 | — |\n| ReadCachePercent | 输入/输出 | uint8 | 读缓存比例百分比 | 0~100 |\n| CopyBackState | 输出 | bool | 回拷使能状态 | — |\n| SmarterCopyBackState | 输出 | bool | SMART 回拷使能状态 | — |\n| JBODState | 输出 | bool | JBOD 使能状态 | — |\n| HotSpareActivationMode | 输出 | string | 热备激活模式 | Failure/Predictive/Unknown |\n| NoBatteryWriteCacheEnabled | 输出 | bool | 无电池写缓存使能 | — |\n| BootDevices | 输出 | string | 启动设备列表 | — |\n| DDREccCount | 输出 | uint16 | DDR ECC 错误计数 | — |\n| SupportedRAIDTypes | 输出 | string | 支持的 RAID 级别 | — |\n| HardwareRevision | 输出 | string | 硬件版本 | — |\n| MaintainPDFailHistrory | 输出 | bool | 物理盘故障记忆使能 | — |\n| CryptoEraseSupported | 输出 | bool | 是否支持加密擦除 | — |\n| EpdSupported | 输出 | bool | 是否支持加密 | — |\n| JbodSupported | 输出 | bool | 是否支持 JBOD | — |\n| CachePinnedState | 输出 | bool | Cache Pinned 开关 | — |\n| ConfiguredDriveWriteCachePolicy | 输出 | string | RAID 组成员盘写缓存策略 | Enabled/Disabled/Default |\n| UnconfiguredDriveWriteCachePolicy | 输出 | string | 非 RAID 组成员盘写缓存策略 | Enabled/Disabled/Default |\n| HBADriveWriteCachePolicy | 输出 | string | HBA 模式写缓存策略 | Enabled/Disabled/Default |\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值 | 含义 | 触发条件 | 处理建议 |\n| :----- | :--- | :------- | :------- |\n| 0 | 成功 | 正常执行完成 | 无 |\n| 非 0 | 失败 | 控制器不支持带外或参数非法 | 检查 OOBSupport 和参数 |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- 查询 RAID 控制器基本信息（型号/固件/温度等）\n- 设置控制器工作模式（RAID/HBA/JBOD/Mixed）\n- 配置回拷、JBOD、热备激活模式等高级特性\n- 导入/清除外部配置\n- 收集 RAID 控制器日志\n\n#### 限制条件\n\n- 依赖 OOBSupport=1 的属性在控制器不支持带外管理时无效\n- 工作模式切换可能需要重启生效\n- 恢复出厂设置操作不可逆\n\n#### 调试示例\n\n```bash\n# 查询控制器信息\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller\n\n# 设置控制器工作模式为 RAID\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller SetWorkMode 'a{ss}yy' \\\n    3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator 0 1\n\n# 恢复出厂设置\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller RestoreDefaultSettings 'a{ss}' \\\n    3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator\n```\n\n### 2.4 一致性校验\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.storage /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/Storage/Controllers/0 bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.ConsistencyCheck\nNAME             TYPE      SIGNATURE RESULT/VALUE FLAGS\n.Disable         method    a{ss}     -            -\n.Enable          method    a{ss}qyyu -            -\n.SetParameters   method    a{ss}qyy  -            -\n```\n\n#### 功能说明\n\n管理 RAID 控制器一致性校验功能，支持启停校验、设置周期/速率/自动修"}
{"reference_id": "4", "content": "pmc_*`：初始化走 `pfn_init_ctrl_over_pcie`（与 PMC StorageCore 交互，见 `sc_misc.c` 等对 `libsyscore.so` 的二次加载）。 |\n| `VENDER_HUAWEI` | `register_histore_function` | `BUILD_SML_OPEN` 时 `/usr/lib64/libsml_histore_open.so`，否则 `/usr/lib64/libsml_histore.so` | `histore_*`：带外/升级等走 PCIe 侧管理接口集合。 |\n| 其他 | — | — | 返回 `SML_ERR_CTRL_PARAM_ILLEGAL` |\n\n**流程图：从添加到控制器对象到厂商 SO**\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart LR\n    subgraph smlib[\"adapter.c（smlib）\"]\n        A[smlib_add_ctrl]\n        B[construct_ctrl_id]\n        C[ctrl_manage_object_constructor]\n        D[pfn_add_ctrl]\n    end\n    A --> B\n    B -->|输出 vender_index| C\n    C -->|dlsym 填 pfn_*| D\n```\n\n**时序图：与 4.3 的层次关系**\n\n```mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    participant Add as smlib_add_ctrl\n    participant CID as construct_ctrl_id\n    participant Ctor as ctrl_manage_object_constructor\n    participant Reg as register_*_function\n    participant SO as dlopen libsml_*.so\n    participant Pfn as pfn_add_ctrl 等\n\n    Add->>CID: typeid → controller_id, vender_index\n    Add->>Ctor: vender_index, SML_CTRL_S*\n    Ctor->>Reg: VENDER_LSI / PMC / HUAWEI\n    Reg->>SO: 首次加载对应 libsml_lsi / pmc / histore\n    SO-->>Reg: 句柄\n    Reg->>Pfn: dlsym 绑定函数指针表\n    Note over Reg,Pfn: LSI 时 pfn_init_ctrl_over_i2c → lsi_init_ctrl_manage\n    Add->>Pfn: pfn_add_ctrl(controller_id)\n```\n\n**与 4.3 的关系（两层动态库）**\n\n- **第一层（本节）**：`ctrl_manage_object_constructor` 决定加载 **`libsml_lsi.so` / `libsml_pmc.so` / `libsml_histore*.so`**，完成 **SML 与厂商 SDK 之间的适配层**绑定。\n- **第二层（4.3）**：在 **`VENDER_LSI`** 路径下，`libsml_lsi.so` 内的 `lsi_init_ctrl_manage` 再按 `controller_id` 中的 StoreLib 类型位，**二次 `dlopen`** `libraidblib.so`、`libstorelibir*.so` 等 **Broadcom StoreLib**。\n\n### 4.3 博通（LSI）`lsi_init_ctrl_manage`：不同 StoreLib 分库加载流程\n\n博通 RAID/HBA 在 BMC 侧通过 **Broadcom StoreLib 系列动态库** 做带外管理；SML 在 `adapter.c` 里把控制器上的 `pfn_init_ctrl_over_i2c` 绑定到 `sl.c` 导出的 `lsi_init_ctrl_manage`（该绑定发生在 **`ctrl_manage_object_constructor` → `register_storelib_function`** 路径中），由 `lsi_init_ctrl_manage` 再按**编码在 `controller_id` 中的 StoreLib 类型**决定加载哪一份 StoreLib `.so`，并完成 I2C 注入与库内初始化。\n\n**与上层衔接**\n\n- `register_storelib_function` 将 `lsi_init_ctrl_manage` 注册为 `pfn_init_ctrl_over_i2c`（见 `storage_new/src/lualib-src/sml/sml_base/src/adapter/adapter.c`）。\n- 在此之前，同一路径已通过 `dlopen(LSI_SML_LIB_PATH)` 加载 **`libsml_lsi.so`**，从中 `dlsym` 出包括 `lsi_init_ctrl_manage` 在内的 LSI 适配入口；**真正的 StoreLib（MegaRAID / IR / IT 等）**则在 `lsi_init_ctrl_manage` 内**第二次**按类型 `dlopen`。\n\n**`lsi_init_ctrl_manage` 主流程（`storage_new/src/lualib-src/sml/sml_lsi/src/sl.c`）**\n\n1. 从 `ctrl_id` 解析库类型：`libType = LSI_STORELIB_TYPE_VALID_BIT(ctrl_id)`（同一套 `ctrl_id` 编码里携带“应使用哪类 StoreLib”的信息）。\n2. `lsi_mutex_init()`：按库类型加锁，避免多控制器并发初始化竞态。\n3. `InitCtrlDiagEvent(ctrl_id)`：初始化背板/硬盘 sense 等诊断上下文。\n4. 按 `libType` 分支：**若对应类型的 StoreLib 尚未加载**，则调用对应的 `LoadStorelib*`（内部 `dlopen` + `dlsym`），再 `InitializeStorelib(libType, &ctrlList)` 向库下发 Discover/Init；部分分支在初始化成功后还会做 **OOB 就绪校验**（见下表）。\n\n**各类型对应的动态库与关键符号（文件路径均为 BMC 上典型安装位置）**\n\n| 库类型（`libType`） | 动态库路径 | 加载函数 | 向库注册 I2C | �"}
{"reference_id": "5", "content": "�盘检测开关模式，0-关闭，1-开启裸盘、成员盘慢盘检测，2-开启裸盘慢盘检测，3-开启成员盘慢盘检测，0xff-默认不支持 |\n | `SupportedBootDeviceCount` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 表示RAID卡支持的启动盘数量 |\n\n**==方法==**\n\n---\n\n`SetBootDevices`\n\n设置控制器的启动盘设备\n\n**参数**\n- `PriorityDriveName`: String \\- 设备1名称\n- `SecondaryDriveName`: String \\- 设备2名称\n\n---\n\n`SetBootDevicesV2`\n\n批量设置启动盘，设备按数组顺序表示优先级\n\n**参数**\n- `BootDevices`: String[] \\- 启动盘设备数组，数组元素为逻辑盘或物理硬盘的设备名。数组长度最大为可支持的启动盘数量\n\n---\n\n`SetJBODState`\n\n设置控制器的JBOD功能状态\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:Disable  1:Enable\n\n---\n\n`SetSmarterCopyBackState`\n\n设置RAID控制器在检测到物理盘SMART错误之后是否自动进行Copyback\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:Disable  1:Enable\n\n---\n\n`RestoreDefaultSettings`\n\n恢复控制器的默认配置\n\n\n---\n\n`SetCopybackState`\n\n设置控制器的回拷功能\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:Disable  1:Enable\n\n---\n\n`SetMaintainPDFailHistoryState`\n\n用于设置RAID卡硬盘故障记忆功能的开启或者关闭\n\n**参数**\n- `State`: U8 \\- 状态 0:关闭  1:开启\n\n---\n\n`SetWorkMode`\n\n设置控制器的工作模式, Mode的取值为0:RAID, 1:HBA, 2:RAID, 3:MIXED; ProfileId的取值为0\n\n**参数**\n- `Mode`: U8 \\- 工作模式: Mode的取值为0:RAID, 1:HBA, 2:RAID, 3:MIXED\n- `ProfileId`: U8 \\- 配置文件的IP, 取值为0\n\n---\n\n`ImportForeignConfig`\n\n一键导入外部配置\n\n\n---\n\n`DumpLog`\n\n收集RAID控制器信息\n\n\n**返回值**\n- `TaskId`: U32 \\- 任务ID\n\n---\n\n`ClearForeignConfig`\n\n一键清除外部配置\n\n\n---\n\n`SetNoBatteryWriteCache`\n\n设置控制器无电池写缓存状态\n\n**参数**\n- `NoBatteryWriteCacheEnabled`: U8 \\- 0-Disable, 1-Enable\n\n---\n\n`SetReadCachePercent`\n\n设置控制器读缓存百分比\n\n**参数**\n- `ReadCachePercent`: U8 \\- 取值范围：0~100\n\n---\n\n`SetWriteCachePolicy`\n\n设置控制器写缓存策略\n\n**参数**\n- `Type`: String \\- RAID卡下的硬盘管理类型\n- `WriteCachePolicy`: String \\- 写缓存策略\n\n---\n\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.BatteryStatus\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `BatteryPresence` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器下挂载的电池在位信息 |\n | `BatteryFault` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器下挂载的电池故障信息 |\n | `BatteryHealth` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器下挂载的电池健康信息 |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.Chip\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `Model` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | raid卡芯片型号 |\n | `ChipManufacturer` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | raid卡芯片厂商 |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller.ConsistencyCheck\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `State` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验功能状态 |\n | `PeriodOfHours` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验周期，单位(小时), 取值范围[1:1440] |\n | `Rate` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验速率 |\n | `AutoRepairEnabled` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验自修复开关 |\n | `RunningStatus` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验状态 |\n | `TotalVolumeCounts` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验需要校验的总数量 |\n | `CompletedVolumeCounts` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | RAID控制器一致性校验运行已经完成的数量 |\n | `DelayToStart` |"}

{"reference_id": "1", "content": "'cachecade=1' is specified, RAID level 0/1 is valid. r0: RAID0 r1: RAID1 r5: RAID5 r6: RAID6 r10: RAID10 r50: RAID50 r60: RAID60 pd=<PD IDs> The physical drives IDs which participate this logical drive. It is mandatory. name=<Logical drive name> Logical drive name, which consists of ASCII characters except the semicolon (;). It is optional. size=<Logical drive size> The size of logical drive and unit can be 'm'(megabytes),'g'(gigabytes), or 't'(terabytes). It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. ss=<Logical drive strip size> The strip size of logical drive. The valid values are 64k,128k,256k,512k,1M. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. sc=<Span count> The span count of logical drive. The default is 1 when RAID level is RAID0/1/5/6 and 2 when RAID level is RAID10/50/60. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. rp=<Read Policy> The read policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. ra: Read Ahead nra: No Read Ahead wp=<Write Policy> The write policy of logical drive. It is optional. wt: Write Through wbwithbbu: Write Back with BBU wb: Write Back iop=<IO Policy> The IO policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. cio: Cached IO dio: Direct IO ap=<Access Policy> The access policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. rw: Read Write ro: Read only blocked: Blocked dcp=<Disk Cache Policy> The disk cache policy of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. enabled: Enable disk cache disabled: Disable disk cache default: Unchanged(Disk's default) init=<Init Type> The initialization type of logical drive. It is optional and not necessary when 'cachecade=1' is specified. no: No init quick: Quick init full: Full init cachecade=1 Logical drive is used for secondary cache. It is optional. It must be supported by RAID controller first. Note: Character ';' is not valid for logical drive name string because it is used as separator.\n\n### raidControllerAddLD\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.26`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.26`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`DisplayString`\n- **访问权限**：read-write\n- **状态**：current\n- **MIB 定义**：`raidControllerDescriptionEntry 26`\n- **描述**：Add logical drive on array on this RAID controller. The arguments are seperated by semicolons; The arguments format is <option1>=<argument>;<option2>=<argument>;...;<optionN>=<argument>; example: array=1;name=example;size=100.375g;ss=512k;rp=ra;wp=wb;iop=cio;ap=rw;dcp=enabled;init=quick;block=1; Options and arguments: array=<Array ID> The array on which the logical drive will be added. It is mandatory. name=<Logical drive name> The name of logical drive and maximum is 15 printable ASCII characters except ';'. It is optional. size=<Logical drive size> The size of logical drive and unit can be 'm'(megabytes),'g'(gigabytes), or 't'(terabytes). It is optional. ss=<Logical drive strip size> The strip size of logical drive. The valid values are 64k,128k,256k,512k,1M. It is optional. rp=<Read Policy> The read policy of logical drive. It is optional. ra: Read Ahead nra: No Read Ahead wp=<Write Policy> The write policy of logical drive. It is optional. wt: Write Through wbwithbbu: Write Back with BBU wb: Write Back iop=<IO Policy> The IO policy of logical drive. It is optional. cio: Cached IO dio: Direct IO ap=<Access Policy> The access policy of logical drive. It is optional. rw: Read Write ro: Read only blocked: Blocked dcp=<Disk Cache Policy> The disk cache policy of logical drive. It is optional. enabled: Enable disk cache disabled: Disable disk cache default: Unchanged(Disk's default) init=<Init Type> The initialization type of logical drive. It is optional. no: No init quick: Quick init full: Full init block=<block index> Continuous space to which a logical drive is to be added. It is optional. Note: Character ';' is not valid for logical drive name string because it is used as separator.\n\n### raidControllerDriverName\n\n- **相对 OID**：`2.235.1.1.36.50.1.27`\n- **完整 OID**：`1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.235.1.1.36.50.1.27`\n- **类型**：OBJECT-TYPE\n- **数据类型**：`DisplayString`\n- **访问权限"}
{"reference_id": "7", "content": "---\nresource_type: \"SPRAID\"\n\nparent_resource_type: \"SPService\"\n\nresource_definition : \"oem\"\n\nversion: \"v1_0_0\"\n\ndate: 2026/07/01\n\ntitle: SPRAID\n---\n\n# ResourceDefinition\n\n## uris\n\n- `/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/SPService/SPRAID`\n\n## properties\n\n| 名称 | 类型 | 是否只读 | 取值范围/枚举值 | 说明 |\n| ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- | ---- |\n| @odata.context | string | true |  | RAID卡配置资源模型的OData描述信息 |\n| @odata.id | string | true |  | RAID卡配置资源的访问路径 |\n| @odata.type | string | true |  | RAID卡配置资源的类型 |\n| Id | 字符串(必填选项) | false |  | RAID卡配置资源的ID |\n| Name | 字符串(选填选项) | true |  | RAID卡配置资源的名称 |\n| CardModel | 字符串(必填选项) | false |  | RAID控制器的型号，包括： <br>● SoftwareRAID |\n| ClearConfig | boolean | false |  | 清除外部配置，可选参数包括： <br>● true <br>● false |\n\n## supported_methods\n\n- POST\n\n# HTTP methods\n\n## POST (CREATE)\n\n**命令功能**\n\n创建 SP 服务的 RAID 配置\n\n**命令格式**\n\nURL: https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/SPService/SPRAID\n\n请求头:\n```\nX-Auth-Token: auth_value\nContent-Type: header_type\n```\n\n\n请求消息体:\n```json\n{\n  \"Id\": memberid,\n  \"CardModel\": CardModel_value,\n  \"ClearConfig\": ClearConfig\n}\n```\n\n**请求头参数说明**\n\n> 参见 [请求头参数说明](../request_header_param.md#POST-request)\n\n**请求体参数说明**\n\n| 参数 | 参数说明 | 取值 |\n|------|----------|------|\n| memberid | ID | RAID配置资源ID（取值：数字） |\n| CardModel_value | RAID类型 | RAID类型，可取值： <br>● SoftwareRAID |\n| ClearConfig | 布尔(选填选项) | 删除软RAID，包括： <br>● true <br>● false（默认值） |\n\n**使用指南**\n\nGA140C机型不支持\n参数列表请参考最新的schema文件。\n创建SP服务的RAID配置的流程如下：\n1. 请参阅本章节使用实例，完成任务下发。\n2. 请参阅3.2.76 修改SP服务资源属性，设置从Smart Provisioning启动使能。\n3. 在不影响服务器业务的情况下，请参阅3.3.4 重启服务器，重启完成后服务器自动\n进入Smart Provisioning来执行升级任务。\n4. 请参阅3.2.84 查询SP服务的配置结果资源查询任务结果。\n\n**使用实例**\n\n请求样例：\nPOST https://device_ip/redfish/v1/Managers/manager_id/SPService/SPRAID\n\nX-Auth-Token: auth_value\nContent-Type: header_type\n请求消息体：\n```json\n{\n  \"Id\": memberid,\n  \"CardModel\": CardModel_value,\n  \"ClearConfig\": ClearConfig\n}\n```\n\n响应样例：\n```json\n{\n  \"@odata.context\": \"/redfish/v1/$metadata#Managers/Members/1/SPService/SPRAID/Members/$entity\",\n  \"@odata.id\": \"/redfish/v1/Managers/1/SPService/SPRAID/1\",\n  \"@odata.type\": \"#HwSPRAID.v1_0_0.HwSPRAID\",\n  \"Id\": \"1\",\n  \"Name\": \"1\",\n  \"CardModel\": \"SoftwareRAID\",\n  \"ClearConfig\": true\n}\n```\n\n响应码：201"}

**修改方法是在manifest.yaml中，libmgmt_protocol下增加配置：**

```text
  - conan: libmgmt_protocol
    options:
      storelib_enable: true
```

增加配置后，重新编译，验证，就可以得到正确的流程，查询相关的DBUS 信息，可以得到相关RAID卡信息；

---

`SetJBODState`

{"entity": "openEuler", "type": "organization", "description": "openEuler is an open-source, Linux-based operating system project developed by the OpenEuler Community and hosted under the OpenAtom Foundation. The project emphasizes stability, security, and high performance, with a focus on reproducible builds, open-source software integrity, and system reliability. It supports multiple hardware architectures, including aarch64, x86_64, and RISC-V, and is actively used on physical servers, virtual machines, and containerized environments, including in cloud-native applications and WSL. openEuler provides a rich ecosystem of software packages through repositories managed via tools like DNF and createrepo, supporting diverse applications such as big data, databases, virtualization, container technologies (including Moby), and confidential computing via frameworks like secGear. It integrates with open-source projects like openGauss and supports advanced features such as distributed soft bus systems, system maintenance tools, and hardware compatibility testing through tools like oec-hardware. The project fosters a collaborative development model, with governance structures including Special Interest Groups (SIGs), community contributions, and a commitment to open collaboration. It is hosted on platforms like Gitee and repo.openeuler.openatom.cn, and is supported by a global community focused on innovation, security, and ecosystem growth. Despite its strengths, openEuler has encountered certain challenges, including boot issues after non-graceful shutdowns, startup delays, root account login problems, configuration-specific failures (e.g., SELinux), and incompatibility with certain software such as TDengine and ZeroTier due to unsupported system types. It is also known for different package configurations compared to RHEL, which can affect tool compatibility. The project aims to promote sustainable, architecture-inclusive development and is currently gaining visibility through platforms like DistroWatch and international outreach efforts. openEuler is a key platform for digital infrastructure, digital transformation, and information technology innovation projects, especially in China and increasingly globally."}

{"entity": "BMC", "type": "artifact", "description": "BMC refers to the Baseboard Management Controller, a specialized microcontroller embedded in server motherboards and computer systems to monitor and manage hardware health, configuration, and remote administration. It serves as a dedicated subsystem responsible for overseeing system-level functions such as environmental monitoring, including temperature, fan speed, power supply status, and GPU temperatures. The BMC operates independently of the main system processor, enabling out-of-band management, which allows for remote diagnostics, monitoring, and control even when the primary system is powered off or unresponsive. It supports standardized protocols such as IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) and MCTP (Management Controller Transport Protocol), facilitating commands for hardware discovery, sensor data collection, and event reporting. The BMC is critical in managing system health by generating default sensor numbers, handling data source synchronization, and triggering alarms during fault conditions. It plays an essential role in lifecycle management, including firmware updates, verification, parsing, and coordination of upgrade processes—such as those involving CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) firmware—where it initiates, manages, and validates upgrades. Additionally, the BMC manages network configuration, including IPMI communication, session handling, and gateway connectivity, and supports features like NTP synchronization for system timekeeping. It handles various hardware functions such as monitoring M.2 drive attributes (presence, capacity, health, temperature, remaining life), managing PCIe devices, and supporting remote server installation and firmware provisioning. The BMC also manages system components such as the ASU modul, including handling hot-plug events and configuration synchronization, and communicates via protocols like LocalBus and IPMB (Intelligent Platform Management Bus), typically assigned the slave address 0x20. It manages user access through systems like LDAP and SNMP, enables two-factor authentication through certificate import, and supports storing critical data such as Silkscreen configurations, SR files, CSR (Certificate Signing Request) data, and SilkConfig JSON files. While primarily a hardware component, certain descriptions reference BMC as an organization involved in system management, digital certificate issuance, firmware upgrades, and configuration services. However, the overwhelming majority of descriptions consistently identify BMC as a hardware-based Baseboard Management Controller responsible for hardware monitoring, remote control, system configuration, and inventory reporting in enterprise and rack-mounted server environments."}

{"entity": "x2openeuler", "type": "method", "description": "x2openeuler is a tool or migration system designed to facilitate the transition of operating system environments from CentOS to openEuler, primarily targeting upgrades from CentOS 7 to various versions of openEuler such as 20.03-LTS-SP1, 21.1, and 22.03 LTS. It functions as a structured migration process involving distinct phases, including system checks, execution of the upgrade, and post-upgrade verification, ensuring compatibility and data integrity during the transition. The tool is particularly utilized in the context of moving from older distributions like Red Hat 7.4 to openEuler 21.1. Despite its intended purpose and successful deployment in some cases—including instances following a system downgrade—the tool has encountered technical issues during certain upgrade procedures, particularly when upgrading from CentOS 7.8 to openEuler 20.03-LTS-SP1. While x2openeuler is currently not open source, there are ongoing discussions about potentially releasing it under an open-source license to encourage broader community participation and enhance its utility, especially in migration scenarios from CentOS to openEuler (and, in some references, OpenRuler). {"entity": "System Management", "type": "concept", "description": "System Management refers to the comprehensive processes and functions involved in monitoring, controlling, and maintaining the operational state of computer systems, encompassing both hardware and software components. It plays a critical role in ensuring system reliability, performance, and security by enabling the oversight of configuration, maintenance, and real-time operational status. System Management is commonly facilitated through specialized tools and interfaces, including Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs), which serve as central points for hardware-level oversight and control. The use of protocols such as IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) further enhances capabilities by allowing remote monitoring and management of physical infrastructure. Within the openEuler ecosystem, System Management includes a range of administrative functions such as service control, user access management, and system configuration, all essential for maintaining the integrity and functionality of the operating system. It also extends to the web interface, where users can access detailed system information—including network adapter details—and perform essential maintenance tasks. Overall, System Management functions as a unified and indispensable capability across both hardware and software domains, providing essential tools and processes to support sustainable system operation, particularly in enterprise and server environments.<SEP>System Management refers to the processes and tools used to monitor, control, and maintain system operations.<SEP>System management encompasses the oversight of hardware and firmware components to ensure system functionality and coordination."}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "---\r\ndate: 2026/05/28\r\ntitle: iBMA 2.20.0 服务启动失败问题分析\r\n---\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 问题背景\r\n\r\n- 单板类型：NA；\r\n- 软件版本：iBMA 2.20.0；\r\n- 涉及功能：iBMA 2.20.0 安装；\r\n- 触发条件：iBMA正常静默安装。\r\n- 业务表现：预期iBMA可以安装和启动服务；实际iBMA安装成功，但是服务启动失败。\r\n\r\n# 问题复现步骤\r\n\r\n1. 按照iBMA正常静默安装\r\n2. 启动iBMA服务\r\n\r\n# 关键日志信息\r\n\r\n查看日志，确认报错如下：\r\n\r\n![报错日志](../../images/fault/imba_service_failed-1.png)\r\n\r\n# 定位过程\r\n\r\n1. 检查内核模块是否存在\r\n\r\n    ```bash\r\n    find /opt/huawei/ibma -name \"*.ko\"\r\n    lsmod | grep -i host\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n    查看是否存在 host_cdew_drv.ko 和 host_veth_drv.ko 文件。\r\n2. 确认内核开发环境是否安装\r\n\r\n    ```bash\r\n    rpm -qa | grep kernel-devel\r\n    uname -r\r\n    ls /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n    确保当前运行的内核对应有开发头文件，否则需安装：\r\n\r\n    ```bash\r\n    dnf install kernel-devel-$(uname -r)\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n3. 尝试手动加载模块\r\n\r\n    ```bash\r\n    modprobe veth  # 先确认标准 veth 支持正常\r\n    insmod /opt/huawei/ibma/driver/host_veth_drv.ko\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n    如果失败，使用 dmesg | tail 查看更详细的错误。\r\n\r\n4. 检查 Secure Boot 状态\r\n\r\n    ```bash\r\n    mokutil --sb-state\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n    若显示 Secure Boot 已启用，考虑临时禁用或使用已签名的驱动包。\r\n5. 检查 systemd 服务文件\r\n    - 确认 /usr/lib/systemd/ibMA.service 内容是否正确，尤其是路径和依赖项。\r\n\r\n# 问题原因\r\n\r\n1. iBMA驱动适配Hi1712芯片的版本是0.4.0（已合入openEuler 6.6内核，对应发布版本为openEuler 24.03 LTS SP3），openEuler 22.03 LTS SP4系统自带的iBMA驱动版本为0.3.6，不支持Hi1712。\r\n2. iBMA软件适配Hi1712芯片的版本是2.19.0\r\n\r\n- 在Hi1712场景下，iBMA安装时，会判断系统自带iBMA驱动版本是否小于0.4.0，如果小于，则尝试从iBMA软件包解压后的iBMA2.0/drivers/目录下查找匹配当前操作系统的iBMA驱动包并安装\r\n- iBMA适配Hi1712时对应的服务器兼容的openEuler操作系统版本为openEuler 24.03 LTS SP2，因此iBMA软件包中仅携带了openEuler 24.03 LTS SP2系统的驱动，并没有openEuler 22.03 LTS SP4系统的驱动\r\n\r\n所以最终选择系统自带的0.3.6版本的iBMA驱动，无法正常加载，导致iBMA服务启动失败\r\n\r\n# 解决方案\r\n\r\n- 部署openEuler 24.03 LTS SP3操作系统后，重新安装iBMA\r\n\r\n- 通过iBMA驱动源码包，编译0.4.0版本的适配openEuler 22.03 LTS SP4的iBMA驱动\r\n\r\n  1. 从support网站获取iBMA 0.4.0驱动源码包：iBMA-dkms_0.4.0_Driver_aarch64_src.tar.gz\r\n  2. 将源码包上传至操作系统，参考iBMA用户指南-编译iBMA驱动章节手动编译iBMA驱动\r\n  3. 将编译好的驱动包 kmod-iBMA_driver-xxx.rpm 放到iBMA软件包解压后的 iBMA2.0/drivers/openEuler 目录下，重新安装iBMA，或通过rpm -ivh kmod-iBMA_driver-xxx.rpm 命令手动安装iBMA驱动rpm包后，重启iBMA服务。"}

{"reference_id": "8", "content": "{\n  \"topic_id\": 6405,\n  \"question\": \"如何安装测试分布式软总线(dsoftbus)？ - content: 基于分布式软总线……\\n看此文档，学习分布线软总线在 openEuler 上的部署及应用。\\n第一个问题，文中第一个超链接地址无效。\\n第二个问题，命令 dnf install dsoftbus 需要的源是哪里？\\ndsoftbus 能在服务器版本上安装吗？我把 everything 源也加上，也没有找到。\\n哦，有这么一个说明\\n# 服务端软件包已集成至openEuler22.03-LTS-SP4系统中，所以可直接使用如下命令进行安装：\\n\\n我的系统版本是 24.03-LTS ，会是 22.03 支持，而 24.03 不支持吗？\\nlinks: https://docs.openeuler.org/zh/docs/22.03_LTS_SP4/docs/Distributed/%E5%9F%BA%E4%BA%8E%E5%88%86%E5%B8%83%E5%BC%8F%E8%BD%AF%E6%80%BB%E7%BA%BF%E6%89%A9%E5%B1%95%E7%94%9F%E6%80%81%E4%BA%92%E8%81%94.html\",\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"xiejirong\",\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\n  \"reply_posts\": [\n    {\n      \"user_name\": \"T_xer\",\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\n      \"is_solution\": false,\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6405/2\",\n      \"text\": \"你好想请问一下你这个跑通了吗，是两张欧拉板卡上部署吗\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"user_name\": \"shangbaogen\",\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\n      \"is_solution\": false,\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6405/3\",\n      \"text\": \"应该是改名字了，尝试一下这个包communication_dsoftbus\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"}

{"reference_id": "9", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 1397,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler应用入门 01 - 安装openEuler操作系统 - content: openEuler应用入门目录：\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 - 前言\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 01 - 安装openEuler操作系统\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 02 -  使用FinalShell连接服务器\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 03 - 搭建本地DNF源仓库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 04 - 安装DDE图形界面\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 05 - 搭建FTP服务器\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 06 -  搭建Windows文件共享服务\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 07 - 搭建本地Docker镜像仓\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 08 - 在服务器使用Docker\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 09 - 使用Nginx\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 10 - 使用WPS\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 11- 安装openGuass数据库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 12- 连接openGuass数据库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 13- 使用防火墙\\n\\n注：本节内容大部分来源于官网文档。\\nopenEuler是一款开源操作系统。当前openEuler内核源于Linux，支持X86、鲲鹏及其它多种处理器，能够充分释放计算芯片的潜能，是由全球开源贡献者构建的高效、稳定、安全的开源操作系统，适用于数据库、大数据、云计算、人工智能等应用场景。同时，openEuler是一个面向全球的操作系统开源社区，通过社区合作，打造创新平台，构建支持多处理器架构、统一和开放的操作系统，推动软硬件应用生态繁荣发展。\\n本章主要介绍在XFusion RH2288H V5服务器上安装openEuler操作系统，版本为：openEuler 22.03 LTS SP1。\\n\\n安装前准备\\n\\n获取安装源\\n请按以下步骤获取openEuler的发布包和校验文件。\\n步骤1\\n登录openEuler社区网站，单击“下载”，显示版本列表。在版本列表的“openEuler 22.03 LTS SP1”版本处单击“立即下载”按钮。\\n图1 - openEuler下载界面\\n\\n----结束\\n\\n安装openEuler系统\\n\\n启动安装\\n下载完成后，准备进行openEuler操作系统的安装。\\n步骤1\\n在个人Windows电脑上，使用浏览器登录服务器iBMC Web界面。iBMC的默认IP地址是：192.168.2.100，默认用户名：Administrator，默认密码：Admin@9000\\n步骤2\\n在KVM界面，插入镜像文件“openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP1-x86_64-dvd.iso”，单击“连接”，如图示。\\n图2 - 连接镜像文件\\n\\n步骤3\\n进入Boot Manager界面。重启服务器，当出现图3-3所示界面时，按“F11”进入引导选择启动界面。\\n若在启动过程中出现输入密码对话框，请在对话框中输入密码（默认密码为“Admin@9000”），按“Enter”。\\n图3 - Purley 平台且 BIOS 为 V658 及以上\\n\\nimage681×512 22.6 KB\\n\\n进入安装引导界面，如图 4所示。\\n图4 - 安装引导界面\\n\\n安装引导选项说明如下：\\nInstall openEuler 22.03-LTS-SP1 —— 在您的服务器上使用图形用户界面模式安装。\\nTest this media & install openEuler 22.03-LTS-SP1 —— 默认选项，在您的服务器上使用图形用户界面模式安装，但在启动安装程序前会进行安装介质的完整性检查。\\nTroubleshooting —— 问题定位模式，系统无法正常安装时使用。进入问题定位模式后，有如下几个选项。\\nInstall openEuler 22.03-LTS-SP1 in basic graphics mode —— 简单图形安装模式，该模式下在系统启动并运行之前不启动视频驱动程序。\\nRescue the openEuler system —— 救援模式，用于修复系统。该模式下输出定向到VNC或BMC（Baseboard Management Controller）端，串口不可用。\\nRun a memory test —— 用于测试内存是否正常工作，以确定是否因内存问题导致的系统问题。\\nBoot from local drive —— 该模式下可以选择本地硬盘启动系统。\\n在安装引导界面，按“Enter”，进入默认选项“Test this media & install openEuler22.03-LTS-SP1”的图形化安装界面，这将花费较长时间进行文件校验。也可以选择第一项“install openEuler22.03-LTS-SP1”进行安装，前提是保证源ISO文件的完整性。\\n\\n图形化模式安装\\n步骤1\\n启动安装后，在进入安装程序主界面之前，系统会提示用户设置安装过程中使用的语言。当前默认为英语，用户可根据实际情况进行调整，如图5所示，选择“中文”。\\n图5 - 选择语言\\n\\nimage681×510 32.5 KB\\n\\n完成设置后，单击“继续”，进入安装设置主界面。\\n如果您想退出安装，可以单击“退出”"}

The tool is specifically designed to assist in the transition from CentOS to openEuler, facilitating the collection of critical hardware and system data required for successful migration. It supports both upgrade checks and compatibility assessments, ensuring system readiness before and during the upgrade process.\n\nx2openEuler-client acts as a coordination mechanism between target nodes and a central management system, enabling the execution of upgrade checks, configuration collection, and rollback operations. It is distributed as a client-side RPM package and is intended to be installed on individual nodes to support system integration within an openEuler environment. Despite being referred to as a legacy tool in some contexts, it remains an integral part of the migration workflow, particularly in earlier versions of x2openEuler. The tool is incompatible with x2openEuler-core, indicating a distinct functional and architectural separation between the components.\n\nWhile the name \"x2openEuler-client\" appears in multiple descriptions, the consistency in functionality across sources confirms the existence of a single, unified tool rather than multiple distinct entities. The core purpose of the client remains consistent: to enable system-level data gathering, assess compatibility, manage upgrade tasks, and support configuration management during migration. The software is deployed under the /opt directory, with its internal structure reflecting its role as a dedicated client application for system operations, highlighting its importance in maintaining system integrity during complex upgrade and migration scenarios.<SEP>x2openEuler-client is the client component used in the migration task to collect and manage data."}

{"entity": "OpenEuler", "type": "organization", "description": "OpenEuler is a community-driven, open-source Linux-based operating system project initiated by Huawei and hosted under the OpenAtom Foundation. It is designed primarily for enterprise, server, cloud, and edge computing environments, aiming to deliver a stable, secure, and high-performance platform across diverse hardware architectures, including x86_64, aarch64, RISC-V, and LoongArch64. The project supports a broad spectrum of use cases, such as AI, cloud-native applications, big data, industrial control, and high-performance computing. OpenEuler is developed and maintained by a global community of contributors, including developers, system integrators, and industry partners, promoting collaboration and innovation.\n\nThe operating system is known for its long-term support (LTS) releases, such as OpenEuler 22.03 LTS SP1, SP3, SP4, and OpenEuler 24.03 LTS (including SP2 and SP3), which provide stable foundations for critical enterprise deployments across industries like finance, telecommunications, energy, and logistics. It features standardized package management via RPM and supports official repositories, software centers, and community-driven build systems such as Yocto. Tools like ImageTailor enable customization of ISO images, and OpenEuler integrates seamlessly with modern DevOps workflows, including Docker, Kubernetes, and container runtimes like iSulad.\n\nSecurity and performance are central to OpenEuler’s design, with built-in support for cryptographic algorithms like SM4 and trusted computing features such as IMA (Integrity Measurement Architecture). It also offers advanced capabilities including real-time kernel variants, high availability (HA) features, and dynamic scheduling. The system is compatible with virtualization technologies like KVM and shows strong support for virtio network cards. Notable configuration details include VLAN interface naming in the format \"vlanID,\" while known limitations involve hostname restrictions (e.g., no underscores) and software-specific issues such as problems with lvmlockd, scp, and MySQL installations.\n\nWhile OpenEuler does not have an official desktop version, it is deployed in containerized environments, development systems, and as a runtime platform for applications like Zabbix, GaussDB, Samba, LDAP, and deep learning frameworks. It serves as the base for the DevStation WSL image and is used on various hardware platforms, including Huawei’s Kunpeng servers and the VisionFive RISC-V board. The ecosystem includes projects such as the iSulad container engine, Kernel COW (KCO), SysCare, and public repositories on Gitee hosting tools like Gala-Gopher and the lcr project. The community maintains forums, documentation, and Special Interest Groups (SIGs) covering topics such as RFO and security.\n\nOpenEuler provides migration paths from legacy systems like CentOS and supports multiple deployment methods, including PXE, kickstart, and cloud images on platforms like Aliyun. Tools such as X2openeuler and forklift-like interfaces facilitate system upgrades, though some users have reported issues with SSH configuration changes and compatibility. Although primarily server-focused, the project includes active discussions on building a desktop ecosystem and expanding into embedded and industrial scenarios. Positioned as a key driver in China’s push for domestic IT infrastructure, OpenEuler stands as a leading open-source platform within the global Linux ecosystem."}

{"entity": "neofetch", "type": "artifact", "description": "neofetch is a command-line system information tool used to display system details and specifications in terminal environments. The tool gathers and displays key system data such as the operating system, kernel version, CPU, GPU, memory, uptime, and other hardware and software configurations. Designed for simplicity and efficiency, neofetch runs directly in the terminal and outputs information in a clean, organized format that is easily readable. It is commonly used by developers, system administrators, and Linux enthusiasts to quickly assess system specs or showcase their system setup, especially in screenshots. As an open-source utility, neofetch is widely accessible and supports a variety of Linux distributions and Unix-like systems."}

{"entity": "openEuler", "type": "organization", "description": "openEuler is an open-source, Linux-based operating system project developed by the OpenEuler Community and hosted under the OpenAtom Foundation. Originally incubated by Huawei, it is designed for enterprise, cloud, edge, and server environments, offering long-term support (LTS) releases such as openEuler 22.03-LTS (SP1, SP2, SP3, SP4) and openEuler 24.03-LTS, which are used in production, system upgrades, and migration projects—particularly as a successor to CentOS. The project emphasizes stability, security, and high performance, with a focus on reproducible builds, open-source software integrity, and system reliability. It supports multiple hardware architectures, including aarch64, x86_64, and RISC-V, and is actively used on physical servers, virtual machines, and containerized environments, including in cloud-native applications and WSL. openEuler provides a rich ecosystem of software packages through repositories managed via tools like DNF and createrepo, supporting diverse applications such as big data, databases, virtualization, container technologies (including Moby), and confidential computing via frameworks like secGear. It integrates with open-source projects like openGauss and supports advanced features such as distributed soft bus systems, system maintenance tools, and hardware compatibility testing through tools like oec-hardware. The project fosters a collaborative development model, with governance structures including Special Interest Groups (SIGs), community contributions, and a commitment to open collaboration. It is hosted on platforms like Gitee and repo.openeuler.openatom.cn, and is supported by a global community focused on innovation, security, and ecosystem growth. Despite its strengths, openEuler has encountered certain challenges, including boot issues after non-graceful shutdowns, startup delays, root account login problems, configuration-specific failures (e.g., SELinux), and incompatibility with certain software such as TDengine and ZeroTier due to unsupported system types. It is also known for different package configurations compared to RHEL, which can affect tool compatibility. The project aims to promote sustainable, architecture-inclusive development and is currently gaining visibility through platforms like DistroWatch and international outreach efforts. openEuler is a key platform for digital infrastructure, digital transformation, and information technology innovation projects, especially in China and increasingly globally."}

{"entity": "System Information", "type": "content", "description": "System Information refers to a comprehensive set of real-time metrics and system-level data that reflect the current state and performance of a computer system. The data includes system load, memory usage, swap usage, disk usage, CPU load, and uptime, which collectively provide insights into the system’s resource utilization and operational health. Additional details such as the operating system (OS) version, kernel version, hardware configuration, network configuration, IP address, open ports, and network status are also commonly included. The information may also cover user-related metrics, such as user activity, login details, number of processes, user sessions, and system anomalies detected by sensors or monitoring tools. Some descriptions highlight the relevance of System Information in containerized environments, where data is reported by the host system during runtime, and in specific distributions like Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS. While the primary function of System Information is monitoring and diagnostics, it also serves as a tool for diagnostics and troubleshooting across different system states—whether at startup, during session login, or while actively running. The data is often timestamped, reinforcing its real-time nature, and is generated by system processes or messages, such as a system-generated prompt displayed during SSH login. The collective characterization across the descriptions confirms that System Information is a dynamic, multi-faceted report essential for system administrators, developers, and end-users to assess performance, identify bottlenecks, and ensure system stability."}

{"entity": "Version", "type": "data", "description": "Version is a multifaceted property used across various components, systems, and configurations to identify, track, and manage different types of releases, iterations, or identifiers. It is most commonly a string or numerical field representing the release version of software, firmware, hardware, or configuration files. The term applies to diverse contexts, including the BIOS firmware version, BMC system version (e.g., 5.11.00.01), SOC chip version (e.g., V100), and component-specific versions such as those for plugins, drivers, NPU systems, and network adapters. In some cases, Version is a read-only data field, such as in the TPCM.Measured class or the SmBios version, and is often automatically updated or retrieved from source paths like ProcessingFlow[1]/Destination/Version or via accessors such as Accessor_LogicVerId.Value.\n\nKey instances of Version include its use in configuration and metadata files: it is a mandatory field in update.cfg to specify the internal firmware version, a configuration value in filelist.conf indicating the white-label package version (e.g., \"2.02\"), and a field in version.xml storing the current firmware version (e.g., V1.2). It also appears in system-specific contexts such as the IpmiCore class, where it specifies the IPMI protocol version (defaulting to \"2.0\"), and in the TlsConfig class, where it determines the active TLS version. Additionally, Version serves as an attribute for SNMP protocol version selection (e.g., SNMPv3), IP version identification (e.g., IPv4, IPv6), and SPDM protocol negotiation.\n\nThe data format of Version varies: it may be a string, an 8-byte field stored in little-endian format, or a U8-type attribute. Some implementations treat it as a read-write property (e.g., for SNMP version), while others mark it as read-only, especially when indicating critical system state or firmware integrity. The field is often used in version validation and upgrade verification, helping ensure compatibility and proper system behavior. It plays a role in component integrity reporting, event configuration tracking, and configuration file updates—particularly when new alerts are added or ABI compatibility is managed.\n\nVersion is also used in specialized contexts such as the DftVersion class, which stores a logical version number for a hardware board (currently unused), and the CCR data version represented as \"${DataVersion}\". It appears in structured data formats like response messages, where it may include subfields for major (V) and minor (R) versions, and in CSI forms, dialog XML documents, and other model artifacts. Across these varied domains, Version consistently functions as a version identifier for release tracking, system state, and compatibility assurance. while some descriptions specify a particular version (e.g., 2509.0.166.0), others describe general patterns like a *.*.* format (e.g., 2.0.0). Conflicts or apparent inconsistencies arise primarily from the broad, context-dependent usage of the term rather than contradictory facts about a single entity, indicating that \"Version\" is not a unified concept but a generalized property with system-specific meanings, all centered on identifying and managing release or configuration states.<SEP>Version is a string-type field in the method response indicating the software version of the system."}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 3604,\r\n  \"question\": \"SUSE12 升级过程中升级前检查中断的可能原因及解决方案 - content: 一、问题现象\\n近期，遇到多起 SUSE12 升级过程中升级前检查中断的事件，具体报错现象如下图所示：\\n202403070919201920×787 109 KB\\n202403070919201920×706 199 KB\\n经查看日志，发现是在收集硬件信息时报错，即 x2openEuler-client hardware-collect 命令执行失败：\\n202403070923441492×195 84.2 KB\\n进一步查看升级日志，并且在待升级节点手动执行 x2openEuler-client hardware-collect 命令，均发现以下报错信息：\\n202403070929221589×130 131 KB\\n报错显示：操作系统上没有发现 /usr/sbin/lspci 命令\\n\\n二、原因分析\\n以上报错由一系列原因导致：\\n① SUSE12 实际存在且可以执行 lspci 命令\\nPixPin_2024-03-07_09-47-471854×272 23.3 KB\\n② 通过执行 which lspci 命令发现其位于 /sbin/ 目录中\\nPixPin_2024-03-07_09-47-471854×105 3.87 KB\\n③ SUSE12 系统中 /usr/sbin/ 目录和 /sbin/ 目录并不是软链接关系\\nPixPin_2024-03-07_09-47-471854×162 8.92 KB\\n④ x2openEuler 工具收集硬件信息时执行的 lspci 命令是带绝对路径的 /usr/sbin/lspci\\n最终导致硬件信息收集失败，检查中断\\n\\n三、解决方案\\n此问题并非必现，具体出现原因可能与用户环境配置相关。若遇到此问题可以创建一个软连接 /usr/sbin/lspci 到 /sbin/lspci\\nPixPin_2024-03-07_09-47-471854×130 8.06 KB\\n最终还是建议工具能够注意并修复一下这个问题，避免不必要的麻烦\\nlinks: [图片: 以下是截图中的文字内容，仅提取自图像，未添加任何总结或推测：\\n\\n---\\n\\n**顶部路径导航：**\\nEEM管理 / task-HpcMvWYS / 查看详情-suseceshi\\n\\n**进程步骤：**\\n1. 环境检查       状态：检查通过\\n2. 升级前检查
