{"reference_id": "3", "content": "3.1-3.2 章节完成适配。\\n\\n2.3 硬件兼容性评估\\n此处以分析本地硬件资源信息为例，请根据实际情况选择分析本地硬件资源信息或外部导入硬件信息数据。\\nx2openEuler hardware-analyse\\n\\n根据报告提示，存在不兼容的硬件，请参考本文 3.3 章节完成硬件适配。\\n\\n2.4 配置兼容性评估\\n此处以评估本地配置信息为例，可根据实际情况选择所需参数并替换为需要进行评估的外部导入数据。\\nx2openEuler conf-analyse\\n\\n根据报告提示，存在有变化的配置需要检查，请参考本文 3.4 章节完成配置适配。\\n\\n3.迁移适配\\n迁移适配工作从分析评估报告展开，针对报告里的错误详情实施不同的适配动作。\\n\\n3.1 应用软件移植\\n以 2.2 章节read-os-1.0.0-1.el7.aarch64.rpm评估报告为例，从接口层面可知，调用的接口发生了变化，经过分析后该案例由于依赖了“已移除的接口”，\\n\\n需要联系软件厂家或者自研软件责任方进行适配。\\n对于兼容的软件可直接使用。\\n\\n3.2 OS 软件包适配\\n以 2.2 章节read-os-1.0.0-1.el7.aarch64.rpm评估报告为例，发现依赖软件包中有缺失的包如下，\\n\\n则需要参考软件兼容性适配流程完成包引入。适配完成后，将软件包引入至软件仓库及根据需要刷新软件兼容性清单。\\n对于兼容的软件可直接使用。\\n\\n3.3 硬件适配\\n以 2.3 章节硬件评估报告为例，“是否在兼容清单”存在“待确认”的硬件类型\\n\\n需要参考硬件兼容性测试服务，引导硬件厂家或社区开展适配，适配完成后将适配驱动发布至软件所仓库及刷新兼容性清单。\\n“是否在兼容清单”为“是”的硬件表示已经过兼容性认证，直接执行下一步。\\n\\n3.4 配置适配\\n分析配置评估报告，x2openEuler 工具自动将系统配置分成静态和动态两种，用户仅需结合自身实际业务诉求和调优策略不同，对各项差异进行对比，选择需要修改的配置，编写自动化脚本，实现一键配置同步。\\n\\n4.迁移实施（已有系统替换）\\n迁移实施前，需要提前熟悉软件部署架构及部署组网，针对性输出对应场景的迁移方案。目前 openEuler 提供主流场景的迁移方案，如大数据、分布式存储、虚拟化、容器、数据库软件，成功支撑多个行业用户完成迁移工作，具体迁移项目支撑请联系 openEuler 运维人员提供技术指导。搬迁实施过程主要包括停止业务、备份隔离、系统部署、配置同步、应用部署、业务割接核心步骤。\\n\\n4.1 停止业务\\n进行搬迁实施前需申请停机窗口和准备工作，根据业务场景和割接难度评估停机维护窗口。针对迁移实施中常见的单机、主备、分布式集群场景，不同应用软件可以做到短暂中断业务或完全不中断，具体场景需结合应用软件单独分析，常见的三种场景情况如下：\\n\\n单机软件：业务中断，停机 x 小时\\n主备软件：不停机\\n分布式集群软件：不停机\\n\\n4.2 备份隔离\\n为保障搬迁过程业务应用安全性，防止搬迁过程信息的丢失，建议搬迁前做好备份，隔离是为了防止搬迁过程影响其他正常业务运行。针对不同业务场景执行容灾备份、网络隔离等可结合业务软件具体的特性进行实施，如 Mysql 数据库场景可通过 xtrabackup 等工具进行快速备份还原。\\n\\n4.3 系统部署\\n系统部署可使用系统部署工具进行自动化批量部署，大幅提升部署效率。部署过程可基于 gkit 工具搭建 pxe 服务器，同步配置文件后可快速完成安装过程：\\n\\n配置 pxe 服务器信息[image]\\n导入配置的模板，点击安装，自动配置 pxe 服务器\\n\\n确认 Pxe 服务状态为绿色，表示 pxe 服务器搭建完成\\n\\n进入服务器 kvm，设置服务器从 pxe 启动并重启\\n\\n后续步骤自动完成，同步配置 ip，OS 安装完成\\n\\n4.4 配置同步\\n根据 3.4 章节完成适配动作，基于 x2openEuler 集成的配置工具，实现系统参数配置、服务状态配置等一键同步，确保基础运行环境及状态信息同步移植，保证业务搬迁后系统运行环境状态一致。\\n\\n4.5 应用部署\\n应用部署前可将需要部署的应用打包成 RPM 包形式，通过编写应用部署安装脚本"}

{"reference_id": "7", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 1397,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler应用入门 01 - 安装openEuler操作系统 - content: openEuler应用入门目录：\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 - 前言\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 01 - 安装openEuler操作系统\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 02 -  使用FinalShell连接服务器\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 03 - 搭建本地DNF源仓库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 04 - 安装DDE图形界面\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 05 - 搭建FTP服务器\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 06 -  搭建Windows文件共享服务\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 07 - 搭建本地Docker镜像仓\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 08 - 在服务器使用Docker\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 09 - 使用Nginx\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 10 - 使用WPS\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 11- 安装openGuass数据库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 12- 连接openGuass数据库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 13- 使用防火墙\\n\\n注：本节内容大部分来源于官网文档。\\nopenEuler是一款开源操作系统。当前openEuler内核源于Linux，支持X86、鲲鹏及其它多种处理器，能够充分释放计算芯片的潜能，是由全球开源贡献者构建的高效、稳定、安全的开源操作系统，适用于数据库、大数据、云计算、人工智能等应用场景。同时，openEuler是一个面向全球的操作系统开源社区，通过社区合作，打造创新平台，构建支持多处理器架构、统一和开放的操作系统，推动软硬件应用生态繁荣发展。\\n本章主要介绍在XFusion RH2288H V5服务器上安装openEuler操作系统，版本为：openEuler 22.03 LTS SP1。\\n\\n安装前准备\\n\\n获取安装源\\n请按以下步骤获取openEuler的发布包和校验文件。\\n步骤1\\n登录openEuler社区网站，单击“下载”，显示版本列表。在版本列表的“openEuler 22.03 LTS SP1”版本处单击“立即下载”按钮。\\n图1 - openEuler下载界面\\n\\n----结束\\n\\n安装openEuler系统\\n\\n启动安装\\n下载完成后，准备进行openEuler操作系统的安装。\\n步骤1\\n在个人Windows电脑上，使用浏览器登录服务器iBMC Web界面。iBMC的默认IP地址是：192.168.2.100，默认用户名：Administrator，默认密码：Admin@9000\\n步骤2\\n在KVM界面，插入镜像文件“openEuler-22.03-LTS-SP1-x86_64-dvd.iso”，单击“连接”，如图示。\\n图2 - 连接镜像文件\\n\\n步骤3\\n进入Boot Manager界面。重启服务器，当出现图3-3所示界面时，按“F11”进入引导选择启动界面。\\n若在启动过程中出现输入密码对话框，请在对话框中输入密码（默认密码为“Admin@9000”），按“Enter”。\\n图3 - Purley 平台且 BIOS 为 V658 及以上\\n\\nimage681×512 22.6 KB\\n\\n进入安装引导界面，如图 4所示。\\n图4 - 安装引导界面\\n\\n安装引导选项说明如下：\\nInstall openEuler 22.03-LTS-SP1 —— 在您的服务器上使用图形用户界面模式安装。\\nTest this media & install openEuler 22.03-LTS-SP1 —— 默认选项，在您的服务器上使用图形用户界面模式安装，但在启动安装程序前会进行安装介质的完整性检查。\\nTroubleshooting —— 问题定位模式，系统无法正常安装时使用。进入问题定位模式后，有如下几个选项。\\nInstall openEuler 22.03-LTS-SP1 in basic graphics mode —— 简单图形安装模式，该模式下在系统启动并运行之前不启动视频驱动程序。\\nRescue the openEuler system —— 救援模式，用于修复系统。该模式下输出定向到VNC或BMC（Baseboard Management Controller）端，串口不可用。\\nRun a memory test —— 用于测试内存是否正常工作，以确定是否因内存问题导致的系统问题。\\nBoot from local drive —— 该模式下可以选择本地硬盘启动系统。\\n在安装引导界面，按“Enter”，进入默认选项“Test this media & install openEuler22.03-LTS-SP1”的图形化安装界面，这将花费较长时间进行文件校验。也可以选择第一项“install openEuler22.03-LTS-SP1”进行安装，前提是保证源ISO文件的完整性。\\n\\n图形化模式安装\\n步骤1\\n启动安装后，在进入安装程序主界面之前，系统会提示用户设置安装过程中使用的语言。当前默认为英语，用户可根据实际情况进行调整，如图5所示，选择“中文”。\\n图5 - 选择语言\\n\\nimage681×510 32.5 KB\\n\\n完成设置后，单击“继续”，进入安装设置主界面。\\n如果您想退出安装，可以单击“退出”"}

    find /opt/huawei/ibma -name "*.ko"
    lsmod | grep -i host

2. 确认内核开发环境是否安装

    rpm -qa | grep kernel-devel
    uname -r
    ls /lib/modules/$(u

{"reference_id": "3", "content": "127.0.0.1 5 dzTJZkOsQL 14 65 56 100 50 109 105 110 64 104 119 49 50 35 36 4 7 64 8 16 4 1 128 2\n```\n\n#### 设置用户角色\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/7 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount RoleId y 4\n```\n\n#### 删除会话\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/SessionService/Sessions/{id} bmc.kepler.SessionService.Session SessionDelete a{ss}y 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 0\n```\n\n#### 设置密码\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/2 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount ChangePwd a{ss}ay 3 Interface Web UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx\n```\n\n#### 设置LDAP的UserDomain\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/LDAP/LDAPController/1 bmc.kepler.AccountService.LDAP.LDAPController UserDomain s \"CN=test,DC=huawei,DC=com\"\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/LDAP/LDAPController/1 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount RoleId y 4\n```\n\n#### SNMP相关\n\n**设置长团体名使能（读写团体名使能RwCommunityEnabled）：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity LongCommunityEnabled b false\n```\n\n**查询长团体名使能：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user get-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity LongCommunityEnabled\n```\n\n**获取团体名：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity GetSnmpCommunity a{ss} 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1\n```\n\n**设置团体名：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity SetRoCommunity a{ss}s 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.1.2.1 xxxxxx\n```\n\n**设置SNMP登录规则：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/20 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount LoginRuleIds as 1 Rule2\n```\n\n**设置登录规则使能：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Rules/2 bmc.kepler.AccountService.Rule Enabled b 1\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Rules/2 bmc.kepler.AccountService.Rule IpRule s 12.12.12.12\n```\n\n**校验登录规则：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Authorization bmc.kepler.AccountService.Authorization LoginRuleCheck a{ss}s 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.1.2.1 <snmp_community>\n```\n\n### 6.3 其他组件命令\n\n#### 升级相关\n\n**获取升级状态：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.firmware_mgmt /bmc/kepler/UpdateService bmc.kepler.UpdateService GetUpgradeStatus a{ss}u 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 1\n```\n\n**开始升级（最后一个参数是文件路径）：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.firmware_mgmt /bmc/kepler/UpdateService bmc.kepler.UpdateService StartUpgrade a{ss}is 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 1 /tmp/openUBMC.hpm\n```\n\n**AC重启：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.fructrl /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/FruCtrl/FruCtrl_1_0_0004 bmc.kepler.Systems.FruCtrl PowerCtrl a{ss}ss 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 ACCycle Unknown\n```\n\n**强制复位BMC：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.maca /bmc/kepler/MacaService bmc.kepler.SystemControl ForceReset a{ss} 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0"}

默认为true |\n | `FirewallMode` | `String` |读写 | 变更广播 | veth网口通信黑白名单模式, 取值范围包括[WhiteList, BlackList], 默认值为BlackList |\n | `WhiteListPorts` | `U16[]` |读写 | 变更广播 | veth网口允许访问的端口列表, 每个元素取值范围 1~65535, 最多50个元素 |\n | `BlackListPorts` | `U16[]` |读写 | 变更广播 | veth网口禁止访问的端口列表, 每个元素取值范围 1~65535, 最多50个元素 |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Battery\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `Name` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | BBU名称 |\n | `State` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | BBU在位信息 |\n | `Fault` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | BBU故障标志 |\n | `HealthStatus` | `U32` |只读 | 变更广播 | bit0:电压过低,bit1:需要更换BBU,bit2:电量校准失败,bit3:电量校准超时,bit4:预故障,bit5:剩余容量低,bit6:没有用于缓存卸载的空间,others:resrved |\n | `Health` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | BBU健康状态 |\n | `TemperatureCelsius` | `S16` |只读 | 变更广播 | BBU温度 |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.Storage.Controller\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `Id` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器Id, 由软件生成，默认值0xFF |\n | `Type` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器类型 |\n | `Name` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器名称 |\n | `TemperatureCelsius` | `S16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器芯片温度 |\n | `TemperatureAbnormal` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 温度异常描述，温度获取失败时置1 |\n | `OOBSupport` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 支持带外管理模式，0：不支持带外；1：支持带外 |\n | `FirmwareVersion` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器固件版本 |\n | `SupportedMode` | `String[]` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器工作模式 |\n | `MemorySizeMiB` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器内存大小，单位MB |\n | `DeviceInterface` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 控制器设备接口 |\n | `SASAddr` | `String` |"}

{"entity": "BMC", "type": "artifact", "description": "BMC refers to the Baseboard Management Controller, a specialized microcontroller embedded in server motherboards and computer systems to monitor and manage hardware health, configuration, and remote administration. It serves as a dedicated subsystem responsible for overseeing system-level functions such as environmental monitoring, including temperature, fan speed, power supply status, and GPU temperatures. The BMC operates independently of the main system processor, enabling out-of-band management, which allows for remote diagnostics, monitoring, and control even when the primary system is powered off or unresponsive. It supports standardized protocols such as IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) and MCTP (Management Controller Transport Protocol), facilitating commands for hardware discovery, sensor data collection, and event reporting. The BMC is critical in managing system health by generating default sensor numbers, handling data source synchronization, and triggering alarms during fault conditions. It plays an essential role in lifecycle management, including firmware updates, verification, parsing, and coordination of upgrade processes—such as those involving CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) firmware—where it initiates, manages, and validates upgrades. Additionally, the BMC manages network configuration, including IPMI communication, session handling, and gateway connectivity, and supports features like NTP synchronization for system timekeeping. It handles various hardware functions such as monitoring M.2 drive attributes (presence, capacity, health, temperature, remaining life), managing PCIe devices, and supporting remote server installation and firmware provisioning. The BMC also manages system components such as the ASU modul, including handling hot-plug events and configuration synchronization, and communicates via protocols like LocalBus and IPMB (Intelligent Platform Management Bus), typically assigned the slave address 0x20. It manages user access through systems like LDAP and SNMP, enables two-factor authentication through certificate import, and supports storing critical data such as Silkscreen configurations, SR files, CSR (Certificate Signing Request) data, and SilkConfig JSON files. While primarily a hardware component, certain descriptions reference BMC as an organization involved in system management, digital certificate issuance, firmware upgrades, and configuration services. However, the overwhelming majority of descriptions consistently identify BMC as a hardware-based Baseboard Management Controller responsible for hardware monitoring, remote control, system configuration, and inventory reporting in enterprise and rack-mounted server environments."}

Overall, BCU remains a distinct hardware component type, separate from other units like EXU and SEU, and is integral to both system control and physical connectivity."}

{"reference_id": "3", "content": "// 下级器件类型\n},\n```\n\n通过配置该PCIe设备的Connector，能够实现在Riser卡上加载PCIe卡，对于特殊的板载网卡也可以在BCU中通过如上的Connector配置PCIe卡。在上述的配置中，对`Bom`、`Id`、`AuxId`进行了配置，并把`Presence`置为了`1`，这样在加载PCIe卡时就能够加载`Bom_Id_AuxId.sr`对应的PCIe设备。\n\n## PCIe动态加载\n\n在服务器中，Riser卡能够对接多种PCIe设备，并且对于不同功能的服务器，需要在同一机型上加载不同种类的Riser卡，为此openUBMC提供了一种支持自动获取BDF信息加载不同PCIe设备的加载方式。\n\n通过在Riser卡上配置各个PCIe槽位的CPU管理映射关系，借助带内管理PCIe设备的能力获取PCIe设备的设备BDF信息，以此信息作为PCIe sr文件的索引，实现动态加载不同类型的PCIe设备。\n\n如下图所示，BCU上的CPU通过串行/解串器(SerDes)与UBCDD连接，UBCDD与Riser接口连接，通过在openUBMC中定义这三者之间的关系，就能够实现对PCIe位置的管理。\n\n![图片说明](../../images/pcie_configuration/pcie_device_topo.png)\n\n- `PCIeSlot1/PCIeSlot2`: 对应IEU上的两个PCIe槽位，即在Riser中对应了两个PCIe Connector <br>\n- `UBCDD`: 一种连接器，用于传输PCIe高速信号。\n- `SerDes`: 串行/解串器，用于将并行数据转换为串行数据进行发送，再将接收到的串行数据转换回并行数据。\n\n### CPU资源归属\n\n为了实现CPU对PCIe的资源管理，在配置硬件SR时，openUBMC提出了如下的概念：\n\n`UnitConfiguration`: 其中配置了Riser卡、UBCDD和SerDes之间的关系。该配置在PSR中配置，以Riser的UID作为Key。同一个PSR中能够配置多个UnitConfiguration用于支持多张Riser配置。<br>\n`BusinessConnector`：业务Connector，用于定义Riser对应PCIeSlot的上下行带宽和绑定的PCIeConnector，同时其中定义了UID信息，用于定位PSR中对应的UnitConfiguration。<br>\n`PCIeAddrInfo`:PCIe对应的UnitConfiguration配置，与BusinessConnector绑定。<br>\n`SerDes`:在BCU的sr中配置串行/解串器的硬件信息，包含每条SerDes的对应的RootBDF的Device号。\n\n建立CPU对PCIe的资源管理过程，称为PCIe Topo建立。\n\n### PCIe Topo建立与RootBDF计算\n\nPCIe设备中BDF（Bus, Device, Function）表示设备在PCIe总线上的位置，其中Bus表示设备所连接的PCIe总线编号，Device表示设备在该PCIe总线上的设备号，Function表示设备上具体的功能号。\n\nBDF地址是由三个数字组成的，比如“05:02.1”，表示总线号是5，设备号是2，函数号是1。BDF地址用于唯一标识PCIe设备，并且是PCIe设备通信和访问的依据。\n\n在一个PCIe拓扑结构中，每个PCIe设备都有其独特的BDF位置，而RootBDF位置则是由所连接的PCIe根总线决定的。因此，BDF和RootBDF是不同的两个概念，也就是说，同一个PCIe设备的RootBDF在不同的PCIe拓扑结构下可能不同，但其BDF位置不变。\n\n#### BCU端口和IEU端口映射关系\n\n在获取PCIe设备的BDF之前需要确定PCIe槽位与CPU资源的对应关系，以及计算其RootBDF值。为了计算某个PCIe槽位在哪个SerDes上，即RootBDF是多少，我们采用了`UnitConfiguration`描述了`BCU`和`IEU`之间的连接关系。在`PSR`中描述了多个`UnitConfiguration`的配置，其中配置类产品的线缆配置白名单，例如：\n\n```json\n\"UnitConfiguration_IEU3\": {\n    \"SlotType\": \"IEU\",\n    \"SlotNumber\": 3,\n    \"SlotSilkText\": \"IEUSlot3\",\n    \"Configurations\": [\n        {\n            \"UID\": \"xxxx\",\n            \"Index\": 0,\n            \"BCUIndex\": 1,\n            \"SrcPortName\": [\"B4c\", \"B4a\"],\n            \"TargetPortID\": [ 17, 49],\n            \"Slot\": [7, 8],\n            \"Device\": [8 , 12],\n        }\n    ],\n    \"Port1LinkInfo\": \"\"\n}\n```\n\n- UID: IEU卡的UID，用于匹配对应的PCIeAddrInfo\n- Slot：全局唯一，硬件提供\n- SrcPortName：BCU端UBCDD的B4c端口对应BCU的槽位7,B4a端口对应BCU的槽位8\n- TargetPortID：Riser向上连接的端口号(10进制)\n\n#### BCU配置SerDes\n\n在`BCU`的sr中同理要配置对应`SerDes`的定义，如下所示：\n\n```json\n\"BusinessConnector_CPU2UBCDD2\": {\n    \"Direction\": \"Down"}

{"reference_id": "4", "content": "235个\n  - CPU与内存管理: 14个\n  - PCIe与总线管理: 17个\n  - 散热管理: 19个\n  - 电源管理: 33个\n  - 温度监控: 3个\n  - 存储管理: 3个\n  - 系统管理: 26个\n  - 板卡管理: 5个\n  - 接口与通信: 44个\n  - 指示灯与显示: 2个\n  - 测试与验证: 24个\n  - 产品与配置: 6个\n  - Redfish遥测服务: 3个\n  - BMA和SP: 3个\n  - IPMI和SOL: 21个\n  - 其他组件: 12个\n\n---\n\n# 🗂️ 按功能分类\n\n## 硬件访问层\n\n- **数据读取**: `Scanner`（周期性读取）\n- **数据写入**: `Accessor`（寄存器写入）\n- **通信协议**: `SMC`（系统管理控制器）\n- **芯片访问**: `Chip`（底层芯片访问）\n\n---\n\n## 硬件管理层\n\n- **组件抽象**: `Component`（硬件组件抽象）\n- **固件管理**: `LogicFirmware`（逻辑固件）、MCUFirmware（MCU固件）\n- **标签管理**: `FRU`（电子标签）、`FruData`（FRU数据）\n- **连接管理**: `Connector`（连接器）、`BusinessConnector`（业务连接器）\n\n---\n\n## 监控告警层\n\n- **状态监控**: `Event`（告警事件）\n- **传感器**: `Sensor`（各类传感器）、`Lm75`（温度传感器）\n- **事件处理**: `DiscreteEvent`（离散事件）\n- **信号处理**: `Debounce`（防抖）\n\n---\n\n## 系统功能层\n\n- **处理器管理**: `CPU`（处理器）、`CpuBoard`（CPU板卡）、`NPU`（NPU处理器）、`NPUPort`（NPU端口）\n- **总线管理**: `PCIe`（PCIe总线）、`SerDes`（串行/解串行器）、`OCPCard`（OCP卡）、`NPUCard`（NPU卡）\n- **散热管理**: 风扇、泵、液冷等19个组件\n- **电源管理**: `VRD`、电源策略等10个组件\n- **存储管理**: 硬盘、`M.2`转接卡等3个组件\n- **系统管理**: `BIOS`、`CPLD`、固件等7个组件\n\n---\n\n# 📖 使用指南\n\n## 🚀 快速入门\n\n1. 首先阅读 [CSR配置指导模板](./csr_spec_template.md) 了解文档结构\n2. 查看 [CSR语法汇总](./csr_grammar.md) 了解基本语法\n3. 阅读 [CSR公共配置](./csr_format.md) 了解版本管理\n4. 根据具体需求选择相应的组件配置文档\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 查找配置\n\n- **按组件类型**: 直接查找对应的组件文档\n- **按功能需求**: 参考上述功能分类选择相关文档\n- **按开发阶段**: 从基础配置到高级功能逐步学习\n\n---\n\n## 📝 配置开发流程\n\n1. **需求分析**: 明确硬件配置需求\n2. **语法学习**: 掌握CSR语法规则\n3. **组件选择**: 选择合适的组件类型\n4. **配置编写**: 按照文档指导编写配置\n5. **测试验证**: 验证配置的正确性和功能\n\n---\n\n# 🔧 配置模板\n\n## 基本CSR文件结构\n\n```json\n{\n  \"FormatVersion\": \"3.00\",\n  \"DataVersion\": \"3.00\",\n  \"Components\": {\n    \"Scanner\": {\n      // Scanner配置\n    },\n    \"Accessor\": {\n      // Accessor配置\n    },\n    \"Component\": {\n      // Component配置\n    },\n    \"Event\": {\n      // Event配置\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 配置文件命名规范\n\n- **基础板配置**: `BCU_配置.json`\n- **扩展板配置**: `EXU_配置.json`\n- **IO板配置**: `IEU_配置.json`\n- **存储板配置**: `SEU_配置.json`\n- **产品配置**: `PSR_配置.json`\n\n---\n\n## 📚 相关文档\n\n- [BMC固件开发指南](../../develop_guide/introduction.md)\n- [板卡适配指南](../../tool_guide/board_integration_guide.md)\n- [网卡适配指南](../../develop_guide/feature_development/nic_integration.md)\n- [PCIe配置](../../develop_guide/feature_development/pcie_configuration.md)\n<!-- - [散热管理开发指南](../../develop_guide/feature_development/thermal_management.md) -->\n- [电源管理开发指南](../../develop_guide/feature_development/power_integration.md)"}

{"reference_id": "7", "content": "127.0.0.1 5 dzTJZkOsQL 14 65 56 100 50 109 105 110 64 104 119 49 50 35 36 4 7 64 8 16 4 1 128 2\n```\n\n#### 设置用户角色\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/7 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount RoleId y 4\n```\n\n#### 删除会话\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/SessionService/Sessions/{id} bmc.kepler.SessionService.Session SessionDelete a{ss}y 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 0\n```\n\n#### 设置密码\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/2 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount ChangePwd a{ss}ay 3 Interface Web UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx xx\n```\n\n#### 设置LDAP的UserDomain\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/LDAP/LDAPController/1 bmc.kepler.AccountService.LDAP.LDAPController UserDomain s \"CN=test,DC=huawei,DC=com\"\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/LDAP/LDAPController/1 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount RoleId y 4\n```\n\n#### SNMP相关\n\n**设置长团体名使能（读写团体名使能RwCommunityEnabled）：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity LongCommunityEnabled b false\n```\n\n**查询长团体名使能：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user get-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity LongCommunityEnabled\n```\n\n**获取团体名：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity GetSnmpCommunity a{ss} 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.0.0.1\n```\n\n**设置团体名：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/Managers/1/SnmpService/SnmpCommunity bmc.kepler.Managers.SnmpService.SnmpCommunity SetRoCommunity a{ss}s 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.1.2.1 xxxxxx\n```\n\n**设置SNMP登录规则：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/20 bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount LoginRuleIds as 1 Rule2\n```\n\n**设置登录规则使能：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Rules/2 bmc.kepler.AccountService.Rule Enabled b 1\nbusctl --user set-property bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Rules/2 bmc.kepler.AccountService.Rule IpRule s 12.12.12.12\n```\n\n**校验登录规则：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.iam /bmc/kepler/AccountService/Authorization bmc.kepler.AccountService.Authorization LoginRuleCheck a{ss}s 3 Interface Busctl UserName Administrator ClientAddr 127.1.2.1 <snmp_community>\n```\n\n### 6.3 其他组件命令\n\n#### 升级相关\n\n**获取升级状态：**\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.firmware_mgmt /bmc/kepler/UpdateService 通过配置该PCIe设备的Connector，能够实现在Riser卡上加载PCIe卡，对于特殊的板载网卡也可以在BCU中通过如上的Connector配置PCIe卡。在上述的配置中，对`Bom`、`Id`、`AuxId`进行了配置，并把`Presence`置为了`1`，这样在加载PCIe卡时就能够加载`Bom_Id_AuxId.sr`对应的PCIe设备。

## PCIe动态加载

在服务器中，Riser卡能够对接多种PCIe设备，并且对于不同功能的服务器，需要在同一机型上加载不同种类的Riser卡，为此openUBMC提供了一种支持自动获取BDF信息加载不同PCIe设备的加载方式。

通过在Riser卡上配置各个PCIe槽位的CPU管理映射关系，借助带内管理PCIe设备的能力获取PCIe设备的设备BDF信息，以此信息作为PCIe sr文件的索引，实现动态加载不同类型的PCIe设备。

如下图所示，BCU上的CPU通过串行/解串器(SerDes)与UBCDD连接，UBCDD与Riser接口连接，通过在openUBMC中定义这三者之间的关系，就能够实现对PCIe位置的管理。

![图片说明](../../images/pcie_configuration/pcie_device_topo.png)

# 🗂️ 按功能分类

## 硬件访问层

- **数据读取**: `Scanner`（周期性读取）
- **数据写入**: `Accessor`（寄存器写入）
- **通信协议**: `SMC`（系统管理控制器）
- **芯片访问**: `Chip`（底层芯片访问）

---

## 硬件管理层

- **组件抽象**: `Component`（硬件组件抽象）
- **固件管理**: `LogicFirmware`（逻辑固件）、MCUFirmware（MCU固件）
- **标签管理**: `FRU`（电子标签）、`FruData`（FRU数据）
- **连接管理**: `Connector`（连接器）、`BusinessConnector`（业务连接器）

---

```\n\n 带内Host上报信息实际上反应了BDF和SlotID的关系，每五个数据代表一个设备，分别是`Segment`、`SocketId`、`Bus`、`Device`、`Function`，ssh查看和日志中记录的均为10进制，注意OCPCardBDF和PcieCardBDF的槽位号是从1开始，NVME槽位号从0开始。\n\n### 2.1 多Host场景下BDF上报（新指令）\n\n为支持multihost功能，同一PCIe槽位可能被分成多路供不同CPU访问（例如OCP卡分成两路x8供CPU1和CPU2访问），一张卡存在多个资源归属和多个BDF（如`0000:25:05.0`和`0000:a5:05.0`）。原有的BDF上报指令不支持一个槽位上报多个BDF，因此新增了3个IPMI命令来适配该场景。\n\n**新增命令概览：**\n\n| 子命令号 | 设备类型 | 命令格式 |\n|----------|----------|----------|\n| 68h | PCIeCard | `ipmicmd -k \"0f 00 30 92 db 07 00 68 {card_num} {data_len} {data}\" smi 0` |\n| 69h | PcieDisk | `ipmicmd -k \"0f 00 30 92 db 07 00 69 {disk_num} {data_len} {data}\" smi 0` |\n| 70h | OCPCard | `ipmicmd -k \"0f 00 30 92 db 07 00 70 {ocp_num} {data_len} {data}\" smi 0` |\n\n**命令参数说明：**\n\n| 参数字节 | 域内容 |\n|----------|--------|\n| 1:3 | Manufacturer ID，LS Byte first（如0x0007DB → DBh, 07h, 00h） |\n| 4 | Sub command（68h/69h/70h） |\n| 5 | 本次请求上报的设备BDF信息组数 |\n| 6 | 每组数据的长度，当前固定为7 |\n| 7 | 第1组信息的丝印槽位号 |\n| 8:9 | 第1组信息的Segment Number，低字节在前 |\n| 10 | 第1组信息的归属CPU逻辑Id，从0开始 |\n| 11 | 第1组信息的Bus Number |\n| 12 | 第1组信息的Device Number |\n| 13 | 第1组信息的Function Number |\n| 7N:7N+6 | 第N组设备BDF信息，格式参考第1组 |\n\n与原有指令相比，新指令每条BDF信息增加了`Segment Number`（2字节）和`归属CPU逻辑Id`字段，支持同一槽位上报多个BDF。原有指令保留用于兼容。\n\n**新指"}
{"reference_id": "7", "content": "指令中了（如PCIe卡的BDF作为OCP上报）**\n\nA: 检查是否发生了PortID冲突（对应丝印中的RootPortDeviceId），RootPortDeviceId和SocketId组成的索引应该在丝印的PCIeSilk项目中唯一。\n\n**Q: 我遇到了同槽位的卡只加载上一张**\n\nA: 检查是否SlotID冲突，注意SlotId和DeviceType组成的索引在丝印文件的PCIeSilk项目中才是唯一的，单SlotId不唯一。\n\n**Q: Riser卡的槽位是怎么确定的？**\n\nA: 对于低速线和高速线分开的情况，槽位就是低速线配置的槽位。对于低速线和高速线合一的情况，当低速线在位时，会去PSR中匹配Connector中的源端线缆名称（如Connector_A1a为A1a），找到有A1a的UnitConfiguration，用该UnitConfiguration的SlotNumber作为组件的SlotNumber（注意这种情况下，若两个UnitConfiguration都有A1a，可能会导致SlotNumber不确定）。\n\n**Q: 拓扑建立会使用那种配置进行？**\n\nA：如果当前UnitConfiguration只有一种配置，选择这种；如果有多种配置，会读取一次线缆信息之后使用完全匹配上的；如果没有完全匹配上的，选择default = true的；如果没有配置default，选择第一个。"}
{"reference_id": "1", "content": "Type` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 电源器件类型,枚举值包括:MOS;DrMOS;PSiP |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.NPUFDMService\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `HbmFPCEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM FPC功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认关闭 |\n | `HbmFaultIsolationEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM隔离修复功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认关闭 |\n | `HbmPageOfflineEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM pageoffline功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认关闭 |\n | `HbmRowSparingEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM Row Sparing容错功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认打开 |\n | `HbmPatrolScrubAlarmEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM内存巡检发现不可纠正错误(PS UCE)后，BMC是否产生告警，true - 产生告警，false - 不产生告警 |\n | `HbmFaultPredictionEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | HBM内存UCE故障预测特性开关。取值：true-开启，false-关闭，默认值false。 |\n | `HbmFaultPredictionMode` | `String` |读写 | 变更广播 | HBM内存UCE故障预测模式配置。取值：“Balanced”-均衡模式, “PrecisionFirst”-准确率优先模式, “RecallFirst”-覆盖率优先模式，默认值“PrecisionFirst”。 |\n | `HbmHardFailureDetectionMode` | `String` |读写 | 变更广播 | HBM内存硬失效模式检测方式。PatrolScrub：通过巡检规则检测硬失效；ExpertRule：通过专家规则检测硬失效 |\n\n**==方法==**\n\n---\n\n`ExecuteScrubbing`\n\nNPU侧HBM巡检压测\n\n**参数**\n- `SlotId`: U32 \\- NPU模组所在的物理槽位。\n- `AddressType`: String \\- 地址类型。\n- `Address`: String \\- 巡检地址。\n\n**返回值**\n- `TaskId`: U32 \\- 执行NPU侧HBM巡检压测，创建的任务编号。\n\n---\n\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkAdapter\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `ID` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡ID |\n | `SystemID` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 系统ID |\n | `Name` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡型号名称 |\n | `DisplayName` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡显示名称 |\n | `Manufacturer` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 厂商名称 |\n | `Description` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡描述 |\n | `Position` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡容器信息 |\n | `DeviceLocator` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡丝印信息 |\n | `Type` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡类型 |\n | `NetworkPortCount` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网口个数 |\n | `NetworkDeviceFunctionCount` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡可用的最大物理功能数量 |\n | `Model` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片型号 |\n | `ChipVendor` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片厂商 |\n | `ModelDescription` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片型号描述 |\n | `ChipManufacturer` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片厂商 |\n | `DriverName` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 驱动名称 |\n | `DriverVersion` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 驱动版本 |\n | `SlotNumber` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 槽位号 |\n | `NetDevFuncCapabilities` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡支持的协议，0:Disabled 1:Ethernet 2:FC 4:iSCSI 8:FCoE 16:OPA 32:IB |\n | `RootBDF` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡BDF信息 |\n | `FirmwareVersion` | `String` |只读 | 变"}

{"entity": "BDF", "type": "artifact", "description": "BDF, short for Bus:Device:Function, is a unique hierarchical identifier used to precisely locate and manage PCIe (Peripheral Component Interconnect Express) devices within a computer system's hierarchy. This three-part identifier consists of a Bus number, Device number, and Function number, and is fundamental to PCIe addressing. It serves as a standardized format to represent the physical location of hardware components—such as network adapters, storage controllers, and other peripheral devices—within the system's PCIe topology. The BDF is typically expressed in the notation \"Bus:Device.Function\" (e.g., 0000:02:00.0), where each component represents a layer in the PCIe hierarchy, enabling the operating system and firmware to enumerate, configure, and communicate with specific devices.\n\nThe BDF is assigned during system initialization, primarily by the BIOS or UEFI firmware, and is used to uniquely identify PCIe devices during boot and runtime operations. It plays a critical role in device manipulation, configuration, and monitoring tasks. For instance, it is used as a parameter in low-level commands for managing devices, querying device models, and facilitating technologies such as SR-IOV (Single Root I/O Virtualization). In high-performance or multi-processor systems, the BDF's scope may also be influenced by an additional Segment field, which extends the addressing space to accommodate complex configurations involving multiple PCIe domains.\n\nBDF is not limited to a specific type of device and applies generically across PCIe hardware, including network ports, drives, and controller cards. It is a read-only attribute in many contexts, often retrieved as an output parameter or string field, and may be polled periodically under certain conditions, such as when the main processor is idle. The identifier is essential for system enumeration, OCP (Open Compute Project) reporting, and driver management, ensuring that device location data remains consistent and traceable. Although null is a possible value in some systems, such cases are typically exceptions indicating missing or undetermined device information.\n\nThe BDF's importance is underscored in both hardware and software contexts, where accurate device addressing is required for reliable system operation. It operates across different platform types—from standard servers to edge computing devices—and remains a foundational concept in modern PCIe-based systems. Despite variations in format syntax (e.g., \"Bus:Device.Function\" vs. \"Bus:Device:Function\"), the underlying meaning and purpose remain consistent. The BDF ensures that every PCIe device can be uniquely and unambiguously identified, providing a critical layer of reliability in hardware management and virtualization."}

{"entity": "NetworkAdapters", "type": "category", "description": "NetworkAdapters is a parent resource type in the Redfish standard, defined under version v1_0_0, that represents network interface adapters within server hardware systems. It serves as a logical group or collection of network interface controllers (NICs) and network interface cards (NICs), including components such as mainboardMEZZ2 and HBA cards, installed within a server chassis. The resource is part of the server’s chassis infrastructure and is accessible via the OData ID /redfish/v1/Chassis/1/NetworkAdapters. NetworkAdapters functions as a central container for managing network interface functionalities, acting as a parent resource for NetworkPorts and thereby enabling the organization and enumeration of associated network port resources. It is a system component within the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC), specifically under the BMC Kepler Systems, responsible for managing network adapter information and maintaining the integrity of network connectivity components within the server architecture. Identifiable by a unique ID in API paths, NetworkAdapters lists all installed network adapter devices and supports a collection of hardware components that provide networking capabilities to server blades and systems. These components are integrated within individual ASU modules, where they assist in network interface management. The entity is both a system domain and a resource type that ensures consistent representation of network connectivity across hardware configurations. While some descriptions emphasize its role as a hardware collection, others focus on its standardized software structure within the Redfish framework. Despite variations in phrasing, all descriptions converge on NetworkAdapters being a critical, standardized component for representing, organizing, and managing network interface adapters within modern server systems.<SEP>NetworkAdapters are hardware components that enable network connectivity within the Chassis.<SEP>NetworkAdapters is a category that provides methods for retrieving network adapter and port information across system components."}

{"entity": "EthernetInterfaces", "type": "artifact", "description": "EthernetInterfaces is a Redfish resource type that defines the properties, behaviors, and management methods for Ethernet network interfaces within a system, particularly in the context of a Baseboard Management Controller (BMC). It serves as a collection of Ethernet interface resources, representing network interface controllers available on the system for wired connectivity. These interfaces are linked to PCIe functions and provide networking capabilities, enabling communication through standard Ethernet protocols. As part of the Redfish standard, EthernetInterfaces operates as a navigation object and access path, allowing clients to retrieve and manage network interface configurations via the API endpoint \"/redfish/v1/Managers/1/NICs\". The resource includes key properties such as Id, NetMode, MAC address, VLAN settings, and other configuration attributes relevant to network management.\n\nWithin the BMC system, EthernetInterfaces functions both as a configuration object and a management category, handling network configurations, port settings, and operational state for Ethernet interfaces. It acts as a centralized reference point for network interface information, providing access to host network interface resource nodes and enabling remote management through standardized interfaces. While primarily defined as a Redfish resource type, EthernetInterfaces is also implemented as a D-Bus interface within certain BMC environments, managing Ethernet port configurations and operations directly at the system level. This dual characterization highlights its role across multiple abstraction layers: as a RESTful API endpoint in Redfish and as a low-level communication interface in D-Bus.\n\nThe resource is structured as a collection of network interface components and configurations, serving both data access and system configuration purposes. It supports the management of multiple network interfaces, allowing for dynamic reconfiguration and monitoring. As a fundamental element in BMC-based systems, EthernetInterfaces enables remote out-of-band management, providing essential network capabilities for system administration and monitoring. Overall, EthernetInterfaces represents a comprehensive framework for managing Ethernet interface functionality, integrating hardware-level access with high-level management APIs to ensure consistent, standardized control over network connectivity across diverse platforms.<SEP>EthernetInterfaces manages comprehensive configuration of Ethernet interfaces."}

{"entity": "Function", "type": "data", "description": "Function is a multifaceted concept employed across various technical domains, primarily within computing systems and device configurations. In the context of PCIe (Peripheral Component Interconnect Express), Function refers to a specific sub-component identifier within a device that supports multiple functions, enabling multifunction devices to operate with distinct logical identities. It is a numeric attribute represented as a U8-type value, typically ranging from 0 to 255, and is a key part of the BDF (Bus, Device, Function) addressing scheme used to uniquely identify devices in a PCIe hierarchy. Specifically, Function corresponds to the PCI function number within a device and is integral to the PCI address triplet, where it complements the Bus and Device fields to specify a unique hardware instance.\n\nFunction also plays a critical role in system-level command and configuration protocols, particularly in SMC (System Management Controller) command structures. In this context, Function is a required field in command requests that specifies the operation code, configuration function, or operational mode of the command. The values used for this field are often defined in reference tables (e.g., Table 1), such as for trusted computing configuration or alarm behavior. It may identify specific actions, such as ‘addtoken’ for security token generation, or functions like adding or validating an OEM user, with each value mapped to a defined operation. This usage underscores Function's role in determining the type and purpose of a command, making it essential for system behavior and configuration accuracy.\n\nAdditionally, in software and programming paradigms, Function is a named block of executable code designed to perform a specific task and may accept parameters for input, potentially returning a value. This definition aligns with common programming constructs in many languages, where Functions are invoked with specific arguments to achieve desired outcomes. Similarly, in the context of PCALL (protected callable), Function acts as a required parameter identifying the protected callable being executed, further extending its application in low-level system calls.\n\nIn device modeling, such as within the PCIeDevice or EthDevice classes, Function is often treated as an optional U8 attribute that denotes the root or specific function number of a device. It may be derived from higher-level identifiers such as SocketID and PortID and is used to support complex device addressing in multi-function environments. While Function can be optional in some contexts, such as in alarm configuration where a brief role description may suffice, it is often required for accurate system operation and device identification.\n\nIn sum, the term \"Function\" encompasses several interrelated but context-dependent meanings: as a PCIe address component, a command-specific field, a software code block, and a device-level identifier. While minor discrepancies exist—such as varying required/optional status or attribute types—these likely arise from differing application domains rather than contradictions within a single system. The core consistent theme is that Function serves to designate a specific logical or operational role within a hardware or software system, enabling precise identification, configuration, and execution.<SEP>Function is a read-only attribute describing the component's functional role, broadcasting changes.<SEP>Function is a U8 data field indicating the function number of a PCIe device.<SEP>Function is a U8 read-only data field indicating the root port Function number.<SEP>Function is a read-only attribute identifying the function number within a PCIe device.<SEP>Function is a read-only data field denoting the function number of a network port device."}

{"entity": "PCIe", "type": "artifact", "description": "PCIe, or Peripheral Component Interconnect Express, is a high-speed serial computer expansion bus standard designed for connecting hardware components within a computer system. It serves as a modern, scalable interface that supports high throughput and low latency, making it ideal for demanding peripherals such as GPUs, SSDs, network adapters, and other high-performance devices. The standard enables direct connections through interfaces like M.2, allowing storage drives and other peripherals to interface directly with the CPU or chipset. PCIe supports a range of form factors and lane configurations (e.g., x1, x4, x8, x16), enabling flexible bandwidth allocation based on device needs. It is widely used for connecting NVMe storage devices, where the PCIe bus links the NVMe controller to the system, significantly enhancing I/O performance. The protocol also facilitates hot-plugging and multiplexing, offering greater flexibility and reliability than older parallel bus standards like traditional PCI. Additionally, PCIe functions as a physical layer type with MediumTypeCode 0x0F, supporting various Message-Based Communication protocols such as MCTP Control, PLDM, NCSI, NVMe, and Vendor-Defined-PCI messages, which are essential for system management and device communication. It is referenced in technical contexts including troubleshooting for issues like NA_READING, and is a key enabler for high-speed data transfer in modern computing platforms. The standard is commonly associated with specific hardware configurations, including the NCSI cable and register configurations used in network interface cards. Overall, PCIe is a foundational technology in contemporary computer architecture, providing a robust and efficient interface for a wide array of critical system components.<SEP>PCIe is a high-speed serial computer expansion bus standard used for connecting hardware components.<SEP>PCIe is a high-speed expansion bus used for connecting hardware components."}

{"entity": "RootBDF", "type": "data", "description": "RootBDF refers to the root-level Bus-Device-Function (BDF) identifier used in PCIe topology to uniquely locate and address a hardware component within a system's PCIe hierarchy. It serves as a critical reference point in system initialization and device configuration, representing the path from the PCIe root complex to a specific device. The RootBDF is commonly expressed in the standardized format \"00:1A:00.0\", where the fields correspond to the bus, device, and function numbers, respectively. It is employed across multiple system components and services: as a base device identifier in PCI bus addressing, as a string property in the Oem object for network or storage adapters, and as a key attribute in the PcieAddressInfo object to represent the BDF of a disk or storage drive. The identifier may vary depending on the system's PCIe topology and is computed using parameters such as portId and SocketID, which influence its value during device enumeration. Although typically a derived, computed attribute, it is officially defined as the BDF address of the PCIe root complex from which a device is accessible, ensuring a consistent and unique reference point for device identification. In certain implementations, such as for storage drives, RootBDF may default to \"N/A\" when the address cannot be determined or is not assigned. Collectively, these descriptions confirm that RootBDF is a foundational, system-level identifier in PCIe addressing frameworks, playing a central role in hardware discovery, configuration, and management within modern computing systems.<SEP>A 32-bit identifier for the root port of a PCIe device, composed of bit fields for segment, bus, device, and function, with a default value of 0xFFFFFFFF.<SEP>RootBDF is a read-only 32-bit data field representing the Root Bus, Device, and Function numbers of a PCIe device in a packed format; bit[24:31] are reserved, bit[16:23] for root Bus, bit[8:15] for root Device, bit[0:7] for root Function; defaults to 0xFFFFFFFF after system reset.<SEP>RootBDF is a read-only string property providing the Bus-Device-Function (BDF) identifier of the network adapter.<SEP>RootBDF is a read-only data field providing the BDF (Bus, Device, Function) information of a network card.<SEP>RootBDF refers to the root device identifier in a PCIe hierarchy, representing the top-level device in a BDF chain.<SEP>RootBDF is a read-only attribute that represents the Bus-Device-Function identifier of the drive."}

{"entity": "NetworkPorts", "type": "category", "description": "NetworkPorts is a resource type within the Redfish framework that represents a collection of network port entities associated with a network adapter. It functions as a parent resource type, serving as a container for individual network port objects that exist under the hierarchy of a network adapter. The NetworkPorts resource is specifically located under the network adapter’s path in the device hierarchy, such as /redfish/v1/Chassis/Blade15/NetworkAdapters/mainboardMEZZ2/NetworkPorts, and is accessed as a child resource of NetworkAdapters. Each network port within the collection may be either physical or logical, functioning as an endpoint for network communication and data transmission. These ports are typically identified by a physical port number and are designed to facilitate connectivity and data exchange within the system's networking infrastructure. The collection encompasses both physical and logical port types, reflecting their roles in supporting various network connectivity needs. As a standardized Redfish resource, NetworkPorts encapsulates key properties and metadata associated with individual network ports while providing structured, programmatic access to their configuration and status.<SEP>NetworkPorts are physical or logical interfaces for connecting network cables or devices.<SEP>NetworkPorts is a collection of valid network port objects, maintained during device initialization and management."}

{"entity": "Bus", "type": "directory", "description": "The term \"Bus\" refers to a fundamental component in computer system architecture, primarily serving as a communication pathway that connects various hardware components within a system. In the context of PCIe (Peripheral Component Interconnect Express) topology, the Bus is a critical element of the BDF (Bus-Device-Function) addressing scheme, where it identifies the logical or physical bus number on which a device resides. It plays a central role in the hierarchical organization of PCIe devices by denoting the root port bus number, which is used to specify a device's position within the PCIe hierarchy. The Bus is commonly represented as a U8 (8-bit unsigned integer) data field, with valid values ranging from 0 to 255, and is often treated as a read-only attribute in device classes such as PCIeDevice and EthDevice. \n\nSpecifically, the Bus is defined as a U8 read-only data field or attribute indicating the root port Bus number in a PCIe configuration, and it contributes to the full PCIe address by forming part of the PCI address triplet. It is also derived from system-level identifiers such as SocketID and PortID, and functions as a component of the PCIe address or BDF addressing system. The Bus serves as a logical connection in the CSR (Configuration Space Root) topology, linking Chips and Connectors to the system infrastructure, and must adhere to constraints regarding its placement and duplication within the topology. In management contexts, the Bus is a topology object in the ManagementTopology that must have a valid source and can only contain Chips and Connectors as descendants.\n\nFurthermore, the term \"Bus\" applies broadly to various hardware communication interfaces, including physical and virtual (channel-based) configurations. It supports multiple protocols such as I2C, SPI, JTAG, and others, and functions as a data transmission pathway between components—both in system-level configurations and in management topologies (e.g., I2c_1 or I2c_2). The Bus is also implemented as a subdirectory under Drivers for organizing bus-specific driver implementations, and it acts as a logical connection in the CSR or system topology that enables device interconnectivity. While the primary context for \"Bus\" in the provided descriptions centers on PCIe and BDF addressing, it also overlaps with general system architecture, where it functions as a hardware component or signal channel enabling communication between components. The consistency across descriptions confirms that \"Bus\" is a well-defined, standardized attribute in PCIe systems, representing a key identifier in device addressing and system topology.<SEP>Bus is the directory for various bus protocol drivers such as I2C and its variants.<SEP>Bus refers to the dbus bus, a communication mechanism used in system services.<SEP>Bus is the directory for various bus protocol drivers such as I2C and its variants."}

{"entity": "Network Adapter", "type": "capability", "description": "Network Adapter refers to a multifaceted system component that plays a critical role in enabling network connectivity within computing environments, encompassing both physical and virtual implementations. As a hardware device, it serves as the primary interface between a computer or virtual machine and a network, facilitating data transmission and reception. Physical Network Adapters are commonly installed on systems as expansion cards or integrated into motherboards, supporting various operational parameters and states, including link status, port availability, and firmware version. These components are responsible for managing network connections, handling NCSI (Network Connectivity Status Indicator) communication to verify network accessibility, and generating notifications for events such as link loss to ensure system responsiveness to network changes or failures.\n\nIn virtualized environments, Network Adapter takes on a virtualized form, enabling virtual machines to connect to network resources through hypervisor-managed interfaces. This virtual implementation supports the same fundamental functions as its physical counterpart, including configuration, monitoring, and diagnostics, while also allowing the consolidation and management of multiple virtual network interfaces. The Network Adapter is also a key element within specific system architectures, such as the Hi182x Card, where it manages network communications and interacts with OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) objects to support advanced system integration and control.\n\nBeyond basic connectivity, the Network Adapter functions as a management and monitoring hub, responsible for gathering and reporting on network interface status, including link state, configuration settings, and firmware information. It supports both out-of-band and in-band communication protocols, enabling remote and in-system monitoring and configuration of network devices such as network cards, ports, and optical modules. In the openUBMC system, this role is explicitly defined, with the Network Adapter overseeing device discovery, operation, and policy enforcement across the network infrastructure.\n\nAdditionally, the Network Adapter may act as a repository or software subsystem that maintains and manages network adapter information, supports MCTP (Management Component Transport Protocol) communication via the MCTPD (Management Component Transport Protocol Daemon), and facilitates the registration of Transport objects using a physical address. This integration enables advanced system management, diagnostics, and coordination, particularly in data center and embedded computing environments. Furthermore, the Network Adapter can be modeled as a business object created through automated discovery processes, representing real-world hardware components in management and monitoring systems.\n\nDue to its diverse roles across hardware, virtual, and software layers, the term \"Network Adapter\" must be interpreted contextually—ranging from a standalone physical device to a virtual interface, a management system component, or a software object representing network connectivity. Despite variations in implementation and functionality, the core purpose remains consistent: to ensure reliable, monitored, and configurable network access across a broad spectrum of computing environments.<SEP>Network Adapter is a hardware interface class used in driver implementations for network adapter control.<SEP>Network Adapter defines the functional specifications of the netcard, including vendor, model, firmware version, MAC address count, and supported protocols."}

PCIe设备资源ID | 可通过查询指定资源获取 |\n| functions_id | PCIe功能资源ID | 可通过查询指定PCIe功能 资源获取 |\n| auth_value | 执行该GET请求时，必须 在“Headers”中携带“X- Auth-Token”值用于鉴权 | 可通过/redfish/v1/ SessionService/Sessions 创建会话时获得 {"reference_id": "2", "content": "关系的连续。\n\n自此，我们的`BCU`和`IEU`端口之间的联系已构建完成（即Topo关系）。接下来就是pcie_device组件仓中对`RootBDF`的计算。\n\n### 计算RootBDF\n\n在pcie_device中会利用`portId`和`SocketID`完成`RootBDF`的计算。\n\n```text\n1. pcie_biz_connectors_init函数:根据IEU/SEU上行连接器(Upstream+Ports)的第一个ID，即construct_biz_topo函数中的first_target_port_id\n2. match_src_connector函数:通过first_target_port_id找到对应unitconfiguration中的SrcPortName，通过SrcPortName得到BCU上的src_connector(is_src_biz_connector函数判断)\n3. 通过src_connector和偏移得到Serdes对象中的SocketID和Device，Device即为portId，SocketID为cpuid\n4. 得到portId后通过override_root_bdf+SocketID+portId可以计算得到RootBDF\n```\n\n对于以上的案例，可知`SocketID`和`portId`分别为`1`和`14`，随后可以在root_bdf表中查询对应的`RootBDF`。最终找到对应的`RootBDF`为`[0xAA, 0x2, 0]`。\n\n### PCIe卡的加载\n\n由于PCIe卡在业务场景下会出现热插拔的情况，为此设计了基于BDF的方案，即BIOS启动阶段主动上报每个PCIe槽位的BDF信息。BMC再通过BDF信息去PMU查询对应BDF的四元组信息，再加载对应的PCIe设备CSR。如下图所示：\n\n![image.png](../../images/pcie_configuration/pcie_device_load.svg)\n\nPCIe Device组件在初始化的时候会向Bios发送ipmi命令，通过带内拿到PCIe卡的四元组(`DeviceID`, `VendorID`, `SubDeviceID`, `SubVendorID`)，并用四元组拼接成`AuxID`和`ID`，以完成`sr`文件名的拼接，即`Bom_{DeviceID+VendorID}_{SubDeviceID+SubVendorID}.sr`。最后完成`sr`的加载\n\n### 天池PCIe卡的加载\n\n与非天池PCIe卡不一样的地方在于，天池PCIe卡的SR加载来自于Eeprom。例如：\n\n```json\n\"Connector_PCIE_SLOT2TianChi\": {\n  \"Id\": \"\", // 下级器件对应的id\n  \"AuxId\": \"\", // 下级器件对应的AuxId\n  \"Bom\": \"14140130\",  // 下级器件对应的Bom_ID\n  \"Slot\": 2,  // 下级器件对应的卡槽号\n  \"Position\": 5,  // 下级器件对应的Position\n  \"Presence\": \"<=/Scanner_Slot2Presence.Value|>expr($1 == 1? 0 : 1)\",  // 天池组件的在位信号由Scanner获取\n  \"Buses\": [\n    \"I2cMux_Pca9545_PCA9545_2\"\n  ],\n  \"SystemId\": 1,\n  \"SilkText\": \"RiserCard${Slot}\",\n  \"IdentifyMode\": 3,  // 加载方式：天池加载模式\n  \"Container\": \"Component_RiserCard\",\n  \"Type\": \"PCIe\",  // 下级器件类型\n  \"IdChipAddr\": 160\n}\n```\n\n其余配置与非天池PCIe设备相同。\n\n## PCIe CSR配置\n\n在PCIe的拓扑建立中介绍了`BCU`和`IEU`之间的端口映射关系，因此对于新增PCIe卡的CSR配置，您必须在执行前确定如下配置是否正确：\n\n- PSR仓中是否添加UnitConfiguration_IEU的配置，其UID和SrcPortName等配置项是否正确配置？\n- `BCU`的CSR中是否正确配置SerDes与Riser卡的端口映射\n- Riser卡的`Connector`和`\"BusinessConnector`是否正确配置\n\n在完成如上配置之后，才能够开始PCIe卡的CSR配置。对于PCIe卡对象而言，必须配置`PCIeDevice`和`PCIeCard`对象。其余对象需要根据PCIe卡的能力进行额外配置。例如对于PCIe网卡，需要额外配置`NetworkAdapter`、`NetworkPort`等等，对于GPU卡，需要配置`GPU`对象。在此，我们简要介绍PCIe卡的基础CSR配置：\n\n```json\n{\n    \"FormatVersion\": \"x.xx\",\n    \"DataVersion\": \"x.xx\",\n    \"Unit\": {\n        \"Type\": \"PCIeCard\",\n        \"Name\": \"PCIeCard_1\"\n    },\n    \"ManagementTopology\": {\n        ...\n    },\n    \"Objects\": {\n        \"PCIeDevice_1\": {\n            \"DeviceName\": \"PCIe Card $ (name)\",  // PCIe卡的名称\n            \"FunctionClass\": x,  //功能分类（0:未知、1:RAID、2:网卡、3:GPU卡...)\n            \"Position\": \"\",  // 下级器件对应的Position\n            \"DiagnosticFault\": 0,  // 故障标志位\n            \"PredictiveFault\": 0,  // 预故障标志位\n            \"BandwidthReduction\": 0,  // 降带宽属性"}
{"reference_id": "1", "content": "Type` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 电源器件类型,枚举值包括:MOS;DrMOS;PSiP |\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.NPUFDMService\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `HbmFPCEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM FPC功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认关闭 |\n | `HbmFaultIsolationEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM隔离修复功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认关闭 |\n | `HbmPageOfflineEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM pageoffline功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认关闭 |\n | `HbmRowSparingEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM Row Sparing容错功能使能状态，true表示功能使能，false表示未使能；csr未配置时功能默认打开 |\n | `HbmPatrolScrubAlarmEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | NPU HBM内存巡检发现不可纠正错误(PS UCE)后，BMC是否产生告警，true - 产生告警，false - 不产生告警 |\n | `HbmFaultPredictionEnabled` | `Boolean` |读写 | 变更广播 | HBM内存UCE故障预测特性开关。取值：true-开启，false-关闭，默认值false。 |\n | `HbmFaultPredictionMode` | `String` |读写 | 变更广播 | HBM内存UCE故障预测模式配置。取值：“Balanced”-均衡模式, “PrecisionFirst”-准确率优先模式, “RecallFirst”-覆盖率优先模式，默认值“PrecisionFirst”。 |\n | `HbmHardFailureDetectionMode` | `String` |读写 | 变更广播 | HBM内存硬失效模式检测方式。PatrolScrub：通过巡检规则检测硬失效；ExpertRule：通过专家规则检测硬失效 |\n\n**==方法==**\n\n---\n\n`ExecuteScrubbing`\n\nNPU侧HBM巡检压测\n\n**参数**\n- `SlotId`: U32 \\- NPU模组所在的物理槽位。\n- `AddressType`: String \\- 地址类型。\n- `Address`: String \\- 巡检地址。\n\n**返回值**\n- `TaskId`: U32 \\- 执行NPU侧HBM巡检压测，创建的任务编号。\n\n---\n\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkAdapter\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `ID` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡ID |\n | `SystemID` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 系统ID |\n | `Name` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡型号名称 |\n | `DisplayName` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡显示名称 |\n | `Manufacturer` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 厂商名称 |\n | `Description` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡描述 |\n | `Position` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡容器信息 |\n | `DeviceLocator` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡丝印信息 |\n | `Type` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡类型 |\n | `NetworkPortCount` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网口个数 |\n | `NetworkDeviceFunctionCount` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡可用的最大物理功能数量 |\n | `Model` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片型号 |\n | `ChipVendor` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片厂商 |\n | `ModelDescription` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片型号描述 |\n | `ChipManufacturer` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片厂商 |\n | `DriverName` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 驱动名称 |\n | `DriverVersion` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 驱动版本 |\n | `SlotNumber` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 槽位号 |\n | `NetDevFuncCapabilities` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡支持的协议，0:Disabled 1:Ethernet 2:FC 4:iSCSI 8:FCoE 16:OPA 32:IB |\n | `RootBDF` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡BDF信息 |\n | `FirmwareVersion` | `String` |只读 | 变"}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "预故障告警标志位\t|入参：<br>a{ss}: 额要信息，预留 <br> y: Segment <br> y: SocketID <br> y: Bus <br> y: Device <br> y: Function <br> y: Value，预故障告警标志位值 <br>出参：<br> y: Status，设置状态|\n|SetFaultByBios\t|a{ss}yyyyy\t|y\t|设置PCIERAID卡BIOS上报故障状态\t|入参：<br>a{ss}: 额要信息，预留 <br> y: Bus <br> y: Device <br> y: Function <br> y: FaultStatus，PCIe卡故障状态 <br>出参：<br> y: Status，设置状态|\n|SetLinkSpeedReduced\t|a{ss}yyyyy\t|y\t|设置PCIe设备降速率事件属性\t|入参：<br>a{ss}: 额要信息，预留 <br> y: Segment <br> y: Bus <br> y: Device <br> y: Function <br> y: Value，降速率事件属性值 <br>出参：<br> y: Status，设置状态|\n|SetPCIeSlots\t|a{ss}a{sy}\t|-\t|批量设置PCIe设备槽位号\t|入参：<br>a{ss}: 额要信息，预留 <br> a{sy}: SlotSettings字典，键为PcieAddrInfo对象Path，值为槽位ID[0-254] <br>出参：无|\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值类型    | 含义         | 触发条件     | 处理建议                 |\n| :------------ | :----------- | :----------- | :----------------------- |\n| Status=0 (成功) | 操作成功     | 正常执行    | 无   |\n| Status!=0 (失败) | 操作失败     | BDF不匹配/设备不存在    | 检查BDF参数   |\n| DeviceName    | 设备丝印名称 | 获取成功    | 无   |\n| PCIeCardNum   | PCIe卡数量   | 获取成功    | 无   |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- 通过BDF查询PCIe设备丝印名称（BIOS通过IPMI GetPcieSilkName调用）\n- 获取当前System下PCIe卡数量\n- 设置PCIe设备错误事件状态（FDM告警框架调用）\n- 设置降带宽、降速率、UCE等故障标识\n- 批量设置PCIe槽位号（配置导入导出场景）\n\n#### 限制条件\n\n- GetDeviceName的Segment/SocketID/Bus/Device/Function必须与实际PCIe设备匹配\n- SetPCIeSlots需要BasicSetting权限\n\n#### 调试示例\n\n##### 命令行调试\n\n```bash\n# 通过BDF获取PCIe设备丝印名\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.pcie_device \\\n /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/PCIeDevices/PCIeDevices bmc.kepler.Systems.PCIeDevices \\\n GetDeviceName a{ss}yyyy 0 0 0 5 0 0\n\n响应：y 0 s \"Slot1\"\n\n# 获取PCIe卡数量\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.pcie_device \\\n /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/PCIeDevices/PCIeDevices bmc.kepler.Systems.PCIeDevices \\\n GetPCIeCardNum a{ss} 0\n\n响应：u 2\n\n# 通过BDF设置PCIe设备错误状态\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.pcie_device \\\n /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/PCIeDevices/PCIeDevices bmc.kepler.Systems.PCIeDevices \\\n SetPcieErrorStatus a{ss}yyyysy 0 0 0 5 0 0 \"FatalError\" 1\n\n响应：y 0\n\n# 通过BDF设置降带宽事件属性\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.pcie_device \\\n /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/PCIeDevices/PCIeDevices bmc.kepler.Systems.PCIeDevices \\\n SetBandwidthReduction a{ss}yyyyy 0 0 5 0 0 1\n\n响应：y 0\n\n# 通过BDF设置诊断故障标志位\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.pcie_device \\\n /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/PCIeDevices/PCIeDevices bmc.kepler.Systems.PCIeDevices \\\n SetDiagnosticFault a{ss}yyyyyy 0 0 0 5 0 0 1\n\n响应：y 0\n\n# 通过BDF设置BIOS上报的UCE故障\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.pcie_device \\\n /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/PCIeDevices/PCIeDevices bmc.kepler.Systems.PCIeDevices \\\n SetUCEByBIOS a{ss}yyyyy 0 0 5 0 0 1\n\n响应：y 0\n```\n\n### 2.2 IPMI命令\n\npcie_device组件注册了以下IPMI命令，用于与带内Host交互：\n\n| 方法 | NetFn | Cmd | 描述 |\n| :--- | :"}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "BCU端UBCDD的B4c端口对应BCU的槽位7,B4a端口对应BCU的槽位8\n- TargetPortID：Riser向上连接的端口号(10进制)\n\n#### BCU配置SerDes\n\n在`BCU`的sr中同理要配置对应`SerDes`的定义，如下所示：\n\n```json\n\"BusinessConnector_CPU2UBCDD2\": {\n    \"Direction\": \"Downstream\",\n    \"BCUIndex\": \"${Slot}\",\n    \"Slot\": 8,\n    \"LinkWidth\": \"X16\",  // 带宽为X16\n    \"MaxLinkRate\": \"PCIe 4.0\",\n    \"ConnectorType\": \"UBCDD\",\n    \"SilkText\": \"CPU2 UBCDD2\",\n    \"UpstreamResources\": [\n        {\"Name\": \"SerDes_1_8\",\"ID\": 8,\"Offset\": 0,\"Width\": 8},\n        {\"Name\": \"SerDes_1_7\",\"ID\": 7,\"Offset\": 0,\"Width\": 4},\n        {\"Name\": \"SerDes_1_10\",\"ID\": 10,\"Offset\": 0,\"Width\": 4}\n    ],\n    \"ActualResourceOrder\": [\"SerDes_1_10\",\"SerDes_1_7\",\"SerDes_1_8\"],\n    \"Ports\": [\n        {\"Name\": \"B4a\",\"ID\": 13,\"Offset\": 0,\"Width\": 8},\n        {\"Name\": \"B4c\",\"ID\": 15,\"Offset\": 8,\"Width\": 8}\n    ],\n    \"Port1LinkInfo\": \"\",\n    \"Port2LinkInfo\": \"\"\n},\n```\n\n- LinkWidth: 对应PCIe卡槽连接的带宽\n- UpstreamResources: 一个PCIe卡槽会对应多个SerDes，上行配置多个SerDes对应的带宽\n- ActualResourceOrder和Ports共同决定了实际连接中SerDes与UBCDD上端口的对应关系。上述配置中X8带宽的SerDes_1_8对应B4c(B4d)，X4带宽的SerDes_1_7和SerDes_1_10对应B4a(B4b)\n\n以`SerDes_1_10`为例，其在`BCU`中定义了该线路的属性：\n\n```json\n\"SerDes_1_10\": {\n    \"Name\": \"SerDes_1_10\",\n    \"ID\": 10,\n    \"SocketID\": 1,\n    \"LinkWidth\": 4,\n    \"WorkMode\": 1,\n    \"ModeConfigs\": [\n        {\n            \"Mode\": 1,\n            \"Device\": [14,14,15,15],\n            \"ControllerIndex\": [1,1,1,1]\n        }\n    ]\n}\n```\n\n- Device：代表SerDes对应的设备Device为14/14/15/15，这个Device就是之后索引RootBDF时用到的portId\n- Socket：代表SerDes连着哪个CPU\n\n#### IEU配置SerDes\n\n在`IEU`侧的sr中同样需要定义与`BCU`相连的端口配置。此处配置是对`BusinessConnector`的定义。\n\n```json\n\"BusinessConnector_1\": {\n    \"Name\": \"Up_1\",\n    \"Direction\": \"Upstream\",\n    \"Slot\": 1,\n    \"LinkWidth\": \"X16\",\n    \"MaxLinkRate\": \"PCIe 4.0\",\n    \"ConnectorType\": \"UBCDD\",\n    \"Ports\": [\n        {\"Name\": \"Down_1\",\"ID\": 49,\"Offset\": 0,\"Width\": 8},\n        {\"Name\": \"Down_2\",\"ID\": 17,\"Offset\": 8,\"Width\": 8}\n    ]\n},\n\"BusinessConnector_2\": {\n    \"Name\": \"Down_1\",\n    \"Direction\": \"Downstream\",\n    \"Slot\": 1,\n    \"LinkWidth\": \"X8\",\n    \"MaxLinkRate\": \"PCIe 4.0\",\n    \"ConnectorType\": \"PCIe CEM\",\n    \"UpstreamResources\": [\n        {\"Name\": \"Up_1\",\"ID\": 1,\"Offset\": 0,\"Width\": 8 }\n    ],\n    \"RefMgmtConnector\": \"#/Connector_PCIE_1\",\n    \"RefPCIeAddrInfo\": \"#/PcieAddrInfo_1\"\n},\n\"PcieAddrInfo_1\": {\n    \"Location\": \"RiserCard${Slot}\",\n    \"ComponentType\": 8,\n    \"ContainerSlot\": \"${Slot}\",\n    \"ContainerUID\": \"xxx\",  // 与UnitConfiguration_IEU3中的UID对应\n    \"ContainerUnitType\": \"IEU\",\n    \"GroupPosition\": \"PcieAddrInfo_1_${GroupPosition}\"\n},\n```\n\n在BusinessConnector_1中配置Ports，定义其下行路线，其中定义的`ID`能够与对应的UnitConfiguration中的`TargetPortID`对应，从而对应\"B4a\"。在`PcieAddrInfo`中通过配置`ContainerUnitType`与UnitConfiguration中的UID对应，从而完成映射关系的连续。\n\n自此，我们的`BCU`和`IEU`端口之间的联系已构建完成（即Topo关系）。接下来就是pcie_device组件仓中对`RootBDF`的计算。\n\n### 计算RootBDF\n\n在pcie_device中会利用`portId`和`SocketID`完成`RootBDF`的计算。\n\n```text\n1. pcie_biz_connectors_init函数:根据IEU/SE"}

"255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255]\n\nPcieDiskBDF=[0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,0,255,255,255,0,0,255,255,255,0,0,255,255,255,0,0,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255,0,255,255,255,255]\n ```\n\n 带内Host上报信息实际上反应了BDF和SlotID的关系，每五个数据代表一个设备，分别是`Segment`、`SocketId`、`Bus`、`Device`、`Function`，ssh查看和日志中记录的均为10进制，注意OCPCardBDF和PcieCardBDF的槽位号是从1开始，NVME槽位号从0开始。\n\n### 2.1 多Host场景下BDF上报（新指令）\n\n为支持multihost功能，同一PCIe槽位可能被分成多路供不同CPU访问（例如OCP卡分成两路x8供CPU1和CPU2访问），一张卡存在多个资源归属和多个BDF（如`0000:25:05.0`和`0000:a5:05.0`）。原有的BDF上报指令不支持一个槽位上报多个BDF，因此新增了3个IPMI命令来适配该场景。\n\n**新增命令概览：**\n\n| 子命令号 | 设备类型 | 命令格式 |\n|----------|----------|----------|\n| 68h | PCIeCard | `ipmicmd -k \"0f 00 30 92 db 07 00 68 {card_num} {data_len} {data}\" smi 0` |\n| 69h | PcieDisk | `ipmicmd -k \"0f 00 30 92 db 07 00 69 {disk_num} {data_len} {data}\" smi 0` |\n| 70h | OCPCard | `ipmicmd -k \"0f 00 30 92 db 07 00 70 {ocp_num} {data_len} {data}\" smi 0` |\n\n**命令参数说明：**\n\n| 参数字节 | 域内容 |\n|----------|--------|\n| 1:3 | Manufacturer ID，LS Byte first（如0x0007DB → DBh, 07h, 00h） |\n| 4 | Sub command（68h/69h/70h） |\n| 5 | 本次请求上报的设备BDF信息组数 |\n| 6 | 每组数据的长度，当前固定为7 |\n| 7 | 第1组信息的丝印槽位号 |\n| 8:9 | 第1组信息的Segment Number，低字节在前 |\n| 10 | 第1组信息的归属CPU逻辑Id，从0开始 |\n| 11 | 第1组信息的Bus Number |\n| 12 | 第1组信息的Device Number |\n| 13 | 第1组信息的Function Number |\n| 7N:7N+6 | 第N组设备BDF信息，格式参考第1组 |\n\n与原有指令相比，新指令每条BDF信息增加了`Segment Number`（2字节）和`归属CPU逻辑Id`字段，支持同一槽位上报多个BDF。原有指令保留用于兼容。\n\n**新指"}

A: 检查是否发生了PortID冲突（对应丝印中的RootPortDeviceId），RootPortDeviceId和SocketId组成的索引应该在丝印的PCIeSilk项目中唯一。

**Q: 我遇到了同槽位的卡只加载上一张**

A: 检查是否SlotID冲突，注意SlotId和DeviceType组成的索引在丝印文件的PCIeSilk项目中才是唯一的，单SlotId不唯一。

**Q: Riser卡的槽位是怎么确定的？**

A: 对于低速线和高速线分开的情况，槽位就是低速线配置的槽位。对于低速线和高速线合一的情况，当低速线在位时，会去PSR中匹配Connector中的源端线缆名称（如Connector_A1a为A1a），找到有A1a的UnitConfiguration，用该UnitConfiguration的SlotNumber作为组件的SlotNumber（注意这种情况下，若两个UnitConfiguration都有A1a，可能会导致SlotNumber不确定）。

**Q: 拓扑建立会使用那种配置进行？**

A：如果当前UnitConfiguration只有一种配置，选择这种；如果有多种配置，会读取一次线缆信息之后使用完全匹配上的；如果没有完全匹配上的，选择default = true的；如果没有配置defau

  关系的连续。

自此，我们的`BCU`和`IEU`端口之间的联系已构建完成（即Topo关系）。接下来就是pcie_device组件仓中对`RootBDF`的计算。

### 计算RootBDF

在pcie_device中会利用`portId`和`SocketID`完成`RootBDF`的计算。

```text
1. pcie_biz_connectors_init函数:根据IEU/SEU上行连接器(Upstream+Ports)的第一个ID，即construct_biz_topo函数中的first_target_port_id
2. match_src_connector函数:通过first_target_port_id找到对应unitconfiguration中的SrcPortName，通过SrcPortName得到BCU上的src_connector(is_src_biz_connector函数判断)
3. 通过src_connector和偏移得到Serdes对象中的SocketID和Device，Device即为portId，SocketID为cpuid
4. 得到portId后通过override_root_bdf+SocketID+portId可以计算得到RootBDF
```

<1字节的mode>\n```\n\n#### 2.2.2 设置IPv6信息\n\n资源树接口：`bmc.kepler.Managers.EthernetInterfaces.Ipv6`<br>\n\ncli设置IPv6静态IP、前缀、网关，-v后面依次传入IP、掩码、网关（网关可以不传）：\n\n```bash\nipmcset -d ipaddr6 -v <ipaddr> <prefix> [gateway]\n```\n\ncli设置IPv6静态网关：\n\n```bash\nipmcset -d gateway6 -v <gateway>\n```\n\ncli设置IPv6模式为DHCPv6/Static：\n\n```bash\nipmcset -d ipmode6 -v <dhcp|static>\n```\n\nipmi设置IPv6地址（IP地址按小端方式传入）：\n\n```bash\nipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x01 0x01 0xcc <3字节的厂商ID> <16字节的IPv6地址>\n```\n\nipmi设置IPv6前缀：\n\n```bash\nipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x01 0x01 0xcd <3字节的厂商ID> <1字节的前缀>\n```\n\nipmi设置IPv6网关（网关地址按小端方式传入）：\n\n```bash\nipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x01 0x01 0xce <3字节的厂商ID> <16字节的网关>\n```\n\nipmi设置IPv6模式，mode位置传1表示Static，传2表示DHCP：\n\n```bash\nipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x01 0x01 0xd0 <3字节的厂商ID> <1字节的mode>\n```\n\n#### 2.2.3 外网网口切换\n\ncli设置网络模式，传1表示固定网口，传2表示自适应模式：\n\n```bash\nipmcset -d netmode -v <网络模式>\n```\n\ncli切换网口（网络模式为固定模式才能切换网口）：\n\n```bash\nipmcset -d activeport -v <网口类型> <port id>\n参数说明：\n网口类型：0-专用网口 1-LOM 2-PCIe\nport id: 切换到该类型网口的第几个port（port id从0开始，网口类型传0时，该参数可不传）\n```\n\nipmi设置网络模式：\n\n```bash\nipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x01 0x01 <3字节的厂商ID> <1字节的网络模式>\n参数说明：\n网络模式：1-专用网口 3-自适应模式 4-PCIe (默认切换到该类型网口的第一个port)\n```\n\n#### 2.2.4 外网VLAN配置\n\ncli设置VLAN:\n\n```bash\nipmcset -d vlan -v <off | id(1~4094)> [port type]\n参数说明：\nVLAN使能：关闭VLAN时传off，开启VLAN时传1~4094的数字;\nport type：0表示设置NCSI的VLAN，1表示设置专用网口的VLAN，可以不传，不传时默认设置NCSI的VLAN；\n```\n\nipmi设置VLAN：\n\n```bash\nipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x30 0x93 <3字节的厂商ID> 0x5a 0x1a 0x00 0x04 0x00 <1字节的port type> <1字节的VLAN使能> <2字节的VLAN id>\n参数说明：\nport type：0表示设置NCSI的VLAN，1表示设置专用网口的VLAN;\nVLAN使能：0表示关闭，1表示使能；\nVLAN id：由两个字节组成，由前一个字节的低四位和后一个字节组成12位数字\n```\n\n## 3. 组件扩展案例\n\n### 3.1 扩展能力概述\n\n不适用。\n\n## 4 配置介绍\n\n### 4.1 配置导入导出"}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "---\ndate: 2026/05/29\ntitle: network_adapter\n---\n---\n# Network Adapter 网卡管理服务\n\n## 版本信息\n\n| 项目     | 内容           |\n| :------- | :------------- |\n| 组件版本 | 1.100.33       |\n| 首发版本 | openUBMC 1.0.0 |\n| 文档作者 | openUBMC       |\n| 最后更新 | 2026-05-29     |\n\n## 1. 组件概述\n\n### 1.1 组件简介\n\nNetwork Adapter（网卡管理服务）是 openUBMC 系统中的网卡组件管理模块，负责网卡、网口、光模块等网络设备的信息获取与管理，以及网口 NCSI 通道的配置与维护。支持通过 NCSI/PLDM over MCTP、SMBus 等带外协议获取网卡信息，同时支持通过 BMA（Board Management Agent）获取带内信息。\n\n### 1.2 解决什么问题\n\nNetwork Adapter 组件为用户提供了完整的网卡管理能力，包括网卡/网口/光模块状态监控、链路信息采集、带宽占用率统计、NCSI 带外通信通道管理、VLAN/Bond 配置、网卡热插拔、固件升级、日志收集等功能。通过 Network Adapter 组件，用户可以在不依赖主机操作系统的情况下完成网络设备的全生命周期管理。\n\n### 1.3 核心功能\n\n- 网卡管理：支持网卡基本信息获取、健康状态监控、热插拔管理、带宽门限设置、固件升级\n- 网口管理：支持网口链路状态、MAC 地址、速率、统计信息、LLDP 信息获取与配置\n- 光模块管理：支持光模块温度、功率、偏置电流、电压等诊断信息采集与告警\n- 带外协议：支持 NCSI over MCTP、PLDM over MCTP、SMBus、LLDP 等多种协议\n- 带内数据：支持通过 BMA 获取主机侧网口、光模块、VLAN、Bond、Bridge 等信息\n- NCSI 功能：支持 NCSI 通道初始化、Tx 使能、VLAN Filter 配置，与 bmc_network 协同实现 BMC 带外通信\n- VLAN/Bond 管理：支持网口 VLAN 创建/修改/删除，Bond 网口创建/删除\n- IPMI 命令：支持 15 个 OEM IPMI 命令，覆盖 MAC 地址读写、NCSI 配置、网口信息查询等\n- 日志与诊断：支持网卡日志收集、光模块历史信息采集、SDI 卡黑匣子日志收集、PRBS 压测\n\n### 1.4 关键术语表\n\n| 术语       | 解释                                                                 |\n| :--------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| NCSI       | Network Controller Sideband Interface，网络控制器边带接口，BMC 通过网卡实现带外通信的协议 |\n| MCTP       | Management Component Transport Protocol，管理组件传输协议，用于 BMC 与网卡芯片通信 |\n| BMA        | Baseboard  Management Agent，主机侧代理，将主机端信息通过带内通道推送给 BMC |\n| LLDP       | Link Layer Discovery Protocol，链路层发现协议，用于获取交换机端口信息 |\n| SMBus      | System Management Bus，系统管理总线，用于 Hi182x 等网卡的带外管理 |\n| SDI 卡     | SmartNIC/DPU 智能网卡，具备独立计算能力的特殊网卡 |\n| OCP 卡     | Open Compute Project 推出的服务器网络接口卡 |\n| FC 卡      | Fibre Channel 光纤通道网卡 |\n| Lom 卡     | LAN on Motherboard，板载网卡 |\n| 光模块     | Optical Module，光纤网口上可热插拔的光电转换模块 |\n\n### 1.5 外部交互边界图\n\n```mermaid\ngraph TB\n    subgraph 北向接口\n        Redfish[Redfish接口]\n        WEB[WEB-REST接口]\n        CLI[CLI命令行]\n        SNMP[SNMP接口]\n        IPMI[IPMI接口]\n    end\n\n    subgraph Rackmount仓\n        Rackmount[Rackmount<br/>北向接口映射]\n    end\n\n    subgraph NetworkAdapter仓\n        NetworkAdapter[NetworkAdapter组件<br/>网卡管理服务]\n    end\n\n    subgraph 南向依赖\n        mctpd[mctpd<br/>MCTP通道管理]\n        bmc_network[bmc_network<br/>BMC网络管理]\n        component_drivers[component_drivers<br/>网卡驱动]\n        hwproxy[hwproxy<br/>I2C/SMBus通道]\n    end\n\n    subgraph 网卡设备\n        PCIeNIC[PCIe网卡<br/>CX4/CX5/CX6/Hi182x等]\n        OCPNIC[OCP网卡]\n        SDINIC[SDI智能网卡]\n        FCNIC[FC光纤网卡]\n    end\n\n    Redfish -->|HTTP/HTTPS| Rackmount\n    WEB -->|HTTP/HTTPS| Rackmount\n    CLI -->|命令调用| Rackmount\n    SNMP -->|SNMP协议| Rackmount\n    IPMI -->|IPMI协议| ipmi_core[ipmi_core组件<br/>IPMI命令路由]"}
{"reference_id": "1", "content": "# bmc_network\n\n## 版本信息\n\n| 项目     | 内容                          |\n| :------- | :--------------------------- |\n| 组件版本 | 1.120.38                       |\n| 首发版本 | openUBMC 25.3.0                 |\n| 文档作者 | mkdlf                  |\n| 最后更新 | 2026-06-23                    |\n\n## 1. 组件概述\n\n### 1.1 组件简介\n\nbmc_network主要负责bmc的网络通信，从两个角度保障BMC的正常网络通信：<br>\n1、配置对外网络，用户可以通过BMC配置的管理IP带外访问BMC；<br>\n2、配置对内网络，主要用于管理板与BMC节点之间，同一机框内多个BMC之间，BMC与服务器内部其他固件的网络通信。<br>\n\n### 1.2 解决什么问题\n\nbmc_network组件主要解决网络连通性、协议兼容性、故障恢复效率等问题，致力于提升服务可用性、优化运维效率、保障安全合规以及支撑未来扩展性等。\n\n### 1.3 核心功能\n\n- 配置IPv4\n\nIPv4有两种方式设置 <br>\n1、设置静态IPv4信息：IP、掩码、网关； <br>\n2、设置DHCP模式由DHCP服务器动态分发IPv4信息，配置成DHCP时，还可配置备份IPv4地址、掩码，当DHCP未获取到IP地址时，还可以通过备份IP访问，详情见[DHCP介绍](https://www.51cto.com/article/760008.html)。\n\n- 配置IPv6\n\nIPv6地址有三种方式设置 <br>\n1、设置静态IPv6信息：IP、前缀、网关；<br>\n2、设置DHCPv6模式动态分发IPv6信息，详情见[DHCPv6介绍](https://blog.csdn.net/m0_49864110/article/details/131076144)；<br>\n3、通过[SLAAC](https://blog.csdn.net/ThinPikachu/article/details/106212233)自动配置无状态地址。\n\n- 外网网口切换\n\nBMC的网络设备通常分为两种（专用网口、NCSI网口），专用网口是BMC自身的管理网口（通常对应eth2），NCSI网口指BMC通过[NCSI技术](https://blog.csdn.net/qq_38583464/article/details/109329348)与服务器内其他网络设备实现共享的网口（通常对应eth0）；这里的网口切换指的是对外网络的配置在专用网口、NCSI网口之间切换，例如从专用网口切换到NCSI网口时，eth2上的对外IP会被清除，eth0上会重新配置对外IP，外网网口切换有两种模式：<br>\n1、手动切换到指定网口；<br>\n2、设置自适应模式，自动选择优先级高且是连接状态的网口（通常专用网口优先级最高）。\n\n- NCSI网口添加、删除\n\nBMC支持NCSI能力，bmc_network提供了NCSI网口的添加和删除接口，该接口由network_adapter组件调用，初始化时network_adapter识别到NCSI网口的信息后来添加NCSI网口，如果该网口通信出现异常，network_adapter再调用删除接口将网口删除。\n\n- 外网VLAN配置\n\n[VLAN](https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/1412795)配置分为专用网口VLAN和NCSI网口VLAN两种配置，当配置了VLAN后，BMC的网口只会处理带了对应VLAN tag的报文，相当于划分了虚拟的局域网。\n\n- 内网配置\n\nBMC除了配置对外IP，还需要配置内网与服务器内部的固件网络通信，内网的配置通常是在已有的网口上划分不同的VLAN用于和不同的固件进行通信；内网相对外网配置来说，要稳定许多，可供修改的接口较少，每种机型的内网配置在对应机型的CSR中，初始化时将网口、VLAN、IP等信息设置即可。\n\n- 节点与管理板链路检测\n\n在机柜环境中，BMC的节点与管理板之间还有心跳检测，若链路检测失败，外网会切换到另一条通信正常的链路保障正常通信。\n\n- iptables配置\n\n1、BMC想要通过web、ssh等服务被访问，不只是需要配置基本的网口和IP，还需要配置[iptables](https://blog.csdn.net/shujuliu818/article/details/125649998)的nat转发规则实现对不同服务报文的转发，才能让服务正常工作；<br>\n2、BMC配置filter表过滤规则，只接收对应网口收到的指定IP的报文，对报文的接收来源和速率进行限制，预防泛洪攻击。\n\n- LLDP\n\n1、通过接收[LLDP](https://blog.csdn.net/chen1415886044/article/details/131366824)报文，获取对端交换机的端口描述，常用于解析节点槽位号，生成节点的内网IP等；<br>\n2、支持BMC"}
