登...  \\nHDM HDM-4950G6-23  \\n百度一下，你就知道  \\nHDM  \\nBC  \\n\\n**界面顶部菜单栏图标（部分）：**  \\n（图标无法识别，但包含电源、B、网格、问号等）  \\n\\n**界面标题栏：**\\nAdvanced  \\n\\n**主窗口标题：**\\nPerformance Config  \\n\\n**配置选项列表：**\\nPower Policy                  <Efficiency>  \\nDEMT                         <Disabled>  \\nCache Mode                   <in:partition  \\n                            out:share>  \\nStream Write                 <allocate share LLC>  \\nStream Write VALUE           <threshold: 12 lines>  \\nHHA SpecConfig Mode          <Enabled>  \\nPerformance Profile          <Custom>  \\n\\n**底部功能键说明：**\\nF1  Help  \\nEsc Exit  \\n↑↓  Select Item  \\n←→  Select Menu  \\n-/+ Change Value  \\nEnter Select▶Sub-Menu  \\nF9  \\nF10  \\n\\n**底部状态栏信息：**\\nIP:172.17.10.14  \\nSN:21023145KV10NA100029  \\nRecv:44030  \\n\\n**屏幕右上角：**\\n流畅  \\n（蓝色进度条）  \\n\\n---], #h-24-disk-12, #h-241-oec-hardware-disk-13, #h-25-ethernetinfiniband-14, #h-251-oec-hardware-15, [图片: # 网卡测试配置信息，指定测试的端口设备号、测试RDMA、服务端IP\\n# device为网卡端口设备号，可通过oech或ip a查看\\n# if_rdma表示是否测试网卡RDMA，默认是N，表示不测试RDMA\\n# client_ip为客户端测试网卡配置的IP\\n# server_ip为服务端测试网卡配置的IP\\n# 服务端的端口默认是80，如果有修改，需要添加上修改后的端口号，如下面的eth2示例。\\nethernet:\\n    # 已手动配置客户端和服务端测试网卡的IP，这里需要添加上服务端的IP地址。\\n    eth1:\\n        device: enp125s0f0\\n        if_rdma: N\\n        client_ip:\\n        server_ip: 2.2.2.4\\n    # 未手动配置IP，使用这里提供的IP进行客户端和服务端配置。\\n    eth2:\\n        device: enp125s0f1\\n        if_rdma: N\\n        client_ip: 2.2.2.3\\n        server_ip: 2.2.2.4:8090\\n    # 前面两种情况都没有满足"}
{"reference_id": "7", "content": "管理\n\n#### 3. MC_REFLECT反射机制\n\nMC_REFLECT是一个编译期反射系统，实现属性的自动序列化和动态访问：\n\n**工作原理**：\n\n```cpp\n// 1. 定义接口类\nclass PCIeDevice {\npublic:\n    std::string DeviceName;\n    std::string VendorId;\n    std::string DeviceId;\n    uint8_t Bus;\n    uint8_t Device;\n    uint8_t Function;\n};\n\n// 2. 注册反射信息\nMC_REFLECT(PCIeDevice, (),\n    ((DeviceName, \"DeviceName\"))\n    ((VendorId, \"VendorId\"))\n    ((DeviceId, \"DeviceId\"))\n    ((Bus, \"Bus\"))\n    ((Device, \"Device\"))\n    ((Function, \"Function\"))\n)\n\n// 3. 运行时动态访问\nmc::dict properties;\nmc::reflect::to_variant(pcie_device, properties);  // 对象 -> JSON\nmc::reflect::from_variant(properties, pcie_device); // JSON -> 对象\n```\n\n**核心特性**：\n- **编译期元数据生成**: 零运行时开销\n- **类型安全**: 编译期类型检查\n- **双向映射**: C++对象 ↔ JSON/配置文件\n- **属性查询**: 运行时枚举对象属性\n- **序列化支持**: 自动生成序列化代码\n\n#### 4. 插件化架构\n\nComponent Drivers采用分层插件架构：\n\n```\ndrivers/\n├── pcie_nic_card/          # PCIe网卡驱动\n│   ├── hisi/               # 海思厂商实现\n│   │   ├── hi182x/         # Hi182x系列驱动\n│   │   │   ├── hi182x_card.h/cpp           # 设备对象\n│   │   │   ├── hi182x_port.h/cpp           # 端口对象\n│   │   │   ├── hi182x_om.h/cpp             # 光模块对象\n│   │   │   ├── hi182x_abi.cpp              # ABI导出\n│   │   │   └── meson.build                 # 构建配置\n│   │   ├── hi182x_high/    # Hi182x-High系列驱动（同结构）\n│   │   ├── hi1822_fc/      # Hi1822 FC系列驱动（同结构）\n│   │   ├── hi1825_board/   # 1825大板驱动（同结构）\n│   │   ├── interface/      # 接口实现\n│   │   │   ├── board.h/cpp            # Board接口\n│   │   │   ├── cooling.h/cpp          # Cooling接口\n│   │   │   ├── fru.h/cpp              # Fru接口\n│   │   │   ├── network_adapter.h/cpp  # 网络适配器接口\n│   │   │   ├── network_port.h/cpp     # 网络端口接口\n│   │   │   ├── optical_module.h/cpp   # 光模块接口\n│   │   │   ├── pcie_card.h/cpp        # PCIe卡接口\n│   │   │   ├── pcie_device.h/cpp      # PCIe设备接口\n│   │   │   └── upgrade.h/cpp          # 固件升级接口\n│   │   └── meson.build\n│   ├── wangxun/            # 网迅厂商实现（含 rp1000、ff50xx、sfx00ht 等型号，以及 interface/ 与 interface_pldm/）\n│   ├── mellanox/           # 迈络思厂商实现\n│   ├── boardcom/           # 博通厂商实现\n│   ├── grt/                # grt厂商实现\n│   └── mucse/              # mucse厂商实现\n└── pcie_gpu_card/          # PCIe GPU驱动\n    ├── innosilicon/        # 芯动科技（awm_m11p）\n    ├── jingjia/            # 景嘉微（jm1100）\n    ├── moorethreads/       # 摩尔线程（mtt_s4000）\n    ├── nvidia/             # NVIDIA（nv_common）\n    └── vastai/             # 瀚博（vg1000）\n```\n\n**层次关系**：\n\n| 层次 | 目录位置 | 职责 | 代码来源 |\n|------|---------|------|---------|\n| 接口定义层 | mds/ | JSON 模型契约定义 | 手工编写 |\n| 生成接口层 | gen/device_tree/interface/ | C++接口基类（dev::gen 命名空间） | 代码生成 |\n| 实现接口层 | drivers/.../interface/ | 厂商接口实现（dev 命名空间） | 手工编写 |\n| 设备对象层 | drivers/.../{model}/ | 设备对象类 | 手工编写 |\n| ABI导出层 | drivers/.../{model}/{model}_abi.cpp | 驱动导出 | 手工编写 |\n\n## 板卡驱动与管理协议关系\n\n### 🔗 驱动-协议绑定架构\n\n板卡驱动与管理协议采用**分层协作**模式，实现硬件抽象与远程管理的完美结合："}
{"reference_id": "8", "content": "---\ndate: 2024/11/30\ntitle: 接口定制\n---\n---\nInterface，用户接口层，处于BMC架构层次的最上层，属于直接与用户交互的模块。提供对外的接口，涉及的主要有`Redfish、Web-Rest、CLI、SNMP、IPMI`接口。\n# Redfish、Web-Rest、CLI、SNMP接口定制\n当前openUBMC接口使用接口映射配置实现，通过配置json文件的方式实现接口，框架解析配置，将接口请求转发到资源协作接口，拼装返回对应格式的数据。该方案有效减少代码开发量，大大提高开发效率。\n\n下面以Redfish接口的配置为例说明如何进行接口定制，更多的配置需求可以参考[《接口映射配置》](../../design_reference/key_feature/interface_mapping.md)。\n## 配置文件位置\n使用接口映射配置定制接口的配置文件统一放在rackmount代码仓，根据接口类型不同`(Redfish、Web-Rest、CLI、SNMP)`，配置文件位于`interface_config`目录下不同的接口的文件夹中的`mapping_config`目录下，本例示范的Redfish接口配置文件在`rackmount/interface_config/redfish/mapping_config`中。实际环境上配置文件的路径为`/opt/bmc/apps/redfish/interface_config/mapping_config`。\n## 配置示例\n如下接口配置其文件路径为`rackmount/interface_config/redfish/mapping_config/AccountService/AccountLockout.json`将实现一个Redfish接口用于查询系统的登录失败锁定(失败次数)和锁定时长(分钟)\n``` json\n{\n    \"Resources\": [\n        {\n            \"Uri\": \"/redfish/v1/AccountService/AccountLockout\",\n            \"Interfaces\": [\n                {\n                    \"Type\": \"GET\",\n                    \"RspBody\": {\n                        \"AccountLockoutThreshold\": \"${ProcessingFlow[1]/Destination/AccountLockoutThreshold}\",\n                        \"AccountLockoutDuration\": \"${Statements/GetDurationMinutes()}\"\n                    },\n                    \"Statements\": {\n                        \"GetDurationMinutes\": {\n                            \"Steps\": [\n                                {\n                                    \"Type\": \"Script\",\n                                    \"Formula\": \"return ProcessingFlow[1].Destination.AccountLockoutDuration // 60\"\n                                }\n                            ]\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"ProcessingFlow\": [\n                        {\n                            \"Type\": \"Property\",\n                            \"Path\": \"/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Authentication\",\n                            \"Interface\": \"bmc.kepler.AccountService.Authentication\",\n                            \"Destination\": {\n                                \"AccountLockoutThreshold\": \"AccountLockoutThreshold\",\n                                \"AccountLockoutDuration\": \"AccountLockoutDuration\"\n                            }\n                        }\n                    ]\n                }\n            ]\n        }\n    ]\n}\n```\n## 字段说明\n- Resources\n接口映射配置的通用字段，Uri配置对象数组\n- Uri\n用于指定接口，外部将通过Uri访问对应接口，此例中外部可通过访问\n    >https://*{IP}*/redfish/v1/AccountService/AccountLockout\n\n    获取系统的登录失败锁定(失败次数)和锁定时长(分钟)\n- Interfaces\nUri所对应的接口配置，由于存在多种Type的请求(支持`GET、PATCH、POST、DELETE`)，所以是个对象数组\n- RspBody\n响应体配置，作为外部访问接口时的回显，`${ProcessingFlow[1]/Destination/AccountLockoutThreshold}`表示数据需要从资源协作接口获取，详细规则可见[《接口映射配置》](../../design_reference/key_feature/interface_mapping.md)。\n- Statements\n数据处理：拿到数据之后，需要做一些加工操作，才能使用，本例中在资源协作接口中得到了系统锁定时长，但单位为秒，为了将单位转化为分钟，需要进行数据处理。数据处理可以分成多步，对应`Steps`字段表示的数组。接口映射配置机制设置了多种通用机制，例如类型转换，计数，增加前缀和后缀等处理逻辑，对应数组每个元素的`Type`字段，本例中的`Script`表示自定义处理方式，`Formula`的内容是一段Lua脚本，可实现复杂逻辑的处理。\n- ProcessingFlow\n数据来源，资源协作接口数据映射配置，`Type`字段表示映射类型，当前支持`Property/Method/List/Task/Paging`。`Path`字段表示具体资源协作接口中的对象。`Interface`字段表示具体对象的接口。`Destination`表示返回值配置\n\n## 接口测试\n可以使用`curl`进行Redfish接口的访问和调试，可在Ubuntu环境中运行`sudo apt-get install curl`进行`curl`的安装\n对于如上配置示例中新增的接口，可以使用如下命令验证其配置\n```shell\n> curl -u *{Account}*:*{Password}* https://*{IP}*/redfish/v1/AccountService/AccountLockout -k\n```\n注：此处的`-k`选项为跳过SSL 检测，防止因证书过期等原因导致接口访问失败\n接口访问正确回显为\n```shell\n{\"AccountLockoutThreshold\": 5, \"AccountLockoutDuration\": 5}\n```\n# IPMI接口定制\n## 配置文件位置\nOpenUBMC的IPMI接口在各个业务组件内配置实现并实现资源协作接口对象创建。\n\n## 配置示例\nIPMI接口的开发流程为如下三个步骤\n1."}

{"entity1": "PATCH", "entity2": "Redfish", "description": "PATCH-Redfish refers to the use of the PATCH HTTP method within the Redfish protocol to perform partial updates on specific attributes of various system resources without replacing the entire resource payload. While the exact fields updated vary by resource, the underlying mechanism remains standardized across the Redfish API. {"entity1": "Content-Type", "entity2": "Redfish", "description": "The (Content-Type, Redfish) relation refers to the use of the Content-Type header in Redfish API requests to designate the media type of the request body. This header is mandatory in all Redfish interactions to ensure that the server correctly interprets and processes the payload. The Content-Type header serves to define the format of data being sent, specifically indicating the media type of the request body. In the context of Redfish, the standard and required value for this header is application/json, which must be explicitly set for all JSON-based API requests. This ensures proper parsing and validation of the request body by the Redfish service. Failure to include the Content-Type header or setting it to an incorrect value may result in request rejection or malformed data processing. The consistent use of application/json as the Content-Type is fundamental to the interoperability and reliability of Redfish API communication."}

{"reference_id": "3", "content": "| 出参 | 描述 |\n| :----- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| Configure | Request(Dictionary) | TaskId(U32) | 配置网口，参数含连接状态、地址、掩码等 |\n\n##### 属性参数说明\n\n| 参数名 | 方向 | 类型 | 描述 | 取值范围 |\n| :----- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| SystemID | 输出 | uint8 | 系统 ID | — |\n| NodeId | 输出 | string | 网口 NodeId | 全局唯一 |\n| Name | 输出 | string | 网口名称 | — |\n| PortID | 输出 | uint8 | 网口 ID | — |\n| PermanentMACAddress | 输出 | string | 永久 MAC 地址 | — |\n| MACAddress | 输出 | string | MAC 地址 | — |\n| LinkStatus | 输出 | string | 链路状态 | LinkUp/NoLink/LinkDown/Connected/Disconnected |\n| LinkStatusNumeric | 输出 | uint8 | 链路状态数值 | — |\n| SpeedMbps | 输出 | uint32 | 链路速率 | Mbps |\n| FullDuplex | 输出 | uint8 | 全双工状态 | 0=关闭，1=开启，255=未知 |\n| AutoSpeedNegotiation | 输出 | uint8 | 自协商状态 | 0=关闭，1=开启，255=未知 |\n| LinkMonitorPeriodMS | 输出 | uint32 | 链路监测周期 | 毫秒 |\n| MTUSize | 输出 | uint16 | 最大传输单元 | 默认1500 |\n| MediumType | 输出 | string | 网口介质类型 | Copper/FiberOptic |\n| FunctionType | 输出 | string | 网口功能类型 | Virtual/Physical |\n| Type | 输出 | uint8 | 网口类型（网卡形态，与所属网卡 Type 取值一致） | 1=Lom, 3=PCIe, 5=Lom2, 6=虚拟, 7=Team, 8=Bridge, 9=Mezz, 10=OCP1, 11=OCP2 |\n| BDF | 输出 | string | 网口 BDF | — |\n| LLDPEnabled | 输入/输出 | bool | LLDP 使能 | true/false |\n| NetworkAdapterId | 输出 | string | 关联网卡 ID | — |\n| DriverName | 输出 | string | 驱动名称 | 依赖 BMA |\n| DriverVersion | 输出 | string | 驱动版本 | 依赖 BMA |\n| FirmwareVersion | 输出 | string | 固件版本 | — |\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值 | 含义 | 触发条件 | 处理建议 |\n| :----- | :--- | :------- | :------- |\n| 0 | 成功 | 正常执行完成 | 无 |\n| 非 0 | 失败 | 网口不存在或操作不支持 | 检查网口状态 |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- 查询网口链路状态和速率\n- 获取网口 MAC 地址\n- 配置网口 LLDP 使能\n- 监控网口流量统计\n\n#### 调试示例\n\n```bash\n# 查询网口链路状态\nbusctl --user get-property bmc.kepler.network_adapter \\\n    /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/NetworkAdapters/0/Ports/0 \\\n    bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkPort LinkStatus\n```\n\n### 2.5 网口统计与 LLDP 子接口\n\n#### bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkPort.Metrics\n\n| 参数名 | 方向 | 类型 | 描述 | 取值范围 |\n| :----- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| RXFrames | 输出 | string | 收到的帧数量 | — |\n| TXFrames | 输出 | string | 发送的帧数量 | — |\n| PacketsDropped | 输出 | uint64 | 丢包总数 | — |\n| RXUnicastFrames | 输出 | string | 收到的单播帧数量 | — |\n| TXUnicastFrames | 输出 | string | 发送的单播帧数量 | — |\n| RXFCSErrors | 输出 | string | 接收校验错误帧数量 | — |\n| BandwidthUsagePercent | 输出 | double | 网络带宽占用率 | % |\n\n#### bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkPort.LLDPReceive\n\n| 参数名 | 方向 | 类型 | 描述 | 取值范围 |\n| :----- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| ChassisId | 输出 | string | 从交换机接收的 Chassis ID | — |\n| ChassisIdSubtype | 输出 | string | Chassis ID 类型 | — |\n| PortId | 输出 | string | 从交换机接收的端口 ID | — |\n| PortIdSubtype | 输出 | string | 端口 ID 类型 | — |\n| SystemName | 输出 | string | 网络交换机名称 | — |\n| ManagementVlanId | 输出 | uint16 | 从交换机接收的 VLAN ID | — |\n\n#### bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkPort.FibreChannel\n\n| 参数名 | 方向 | 类型 | 描述 | 取值范围 |\n| :----- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| FCId | 输出 | string | FC ID 信息 | — |\n| WWNN | 输出 | string | 当前生效 WWNN 号 | — |\n| WWPN | 输出 | string | 当前生效 WWPN 号 | — |\n| SpeedGbps | 输出 | uint"}

ipmi设置IPv4模式，mode位置传1表示Static，传2表示DHCP：

```bash
ipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x01 0x01 0x04 <1字节的mode>
```

#### 2.2.2 设置IPv6信息

资源树接口：`bmc.kepler.Managers.EthernetInterfaces.Ipv6`<br>

cli设置IPv6静态IP、前缀、网关，-v后面依次传入IP、掩码、网关（网关可以不传）：

```bash
ipmcset -d ipaddr6 -v <ipaddr> <prefix> [gateway]
```

cli设置IPv6静态网关：

```bash
ipmcset -d gateway6 -v <gateway>
```

cli设置IPv6模式为DHCPv6/Static：

```bash
ipmcset -d ipmode6 -v <dhcp|static>
```

ipmi设置IPv6地址（IP地址按小端方式传入）：

```bash
ipmitool -H <BMC的IP> -I lanplus -p 623 -U <用户名> -P <密码> -C 17 raw 0x0c 0x

# Network Adapter 网卡管理服务

## 版本信息

| 项目     | 内容           |
| :------- | :------------- |
| 组件版本 | 1.100.33       |
| 首发版本 | openUBMC 1.0.0 |
| 文档作者 | openUBMC       |
| 最后更新 | 2026-05-29     |

## 1. 组件概述

### 1.1 组件简介

Network Adapter（网卡管理服务）是 openUBMC 系统中的网卡组件管理模块，负责网卡、网口、光模块等网络设备的信息获取与管理，以及网口 NCSI 通道的配置与维护。支持通过 NCSI/PLDM over MCTP、SMBus 等带外协议获取网卡信息，同时支持通过 BMA（Board Management Agent）获取带内信息。

### 1.2 解决什么问题

Network Adapter 组件为用户提供了完整的网卡管理能力，包括网卡/网口/光模块状态监控、链路信息采集、带宽占用率统计、NCSI 带外通信通道管理、VLAN/Bond 配置、网卡热插拔、固件升级、日志收集等功能。通过 Network Adapter 组件，

## 1. 组件概述

### 1.1 组件简介

bmc_network主要负责bmc的网络通信，从两个角度保障BMC的正常网络通信：<br>
1、配置对外网络，用户可以通过BMC配置的管理IP带外访问BMC；<br>
2、配置对内网络，主要用于管理板与BMC节点之间，同一机框内多个BMC之间，BMC与服务器内部其他固件的网络通信。<br>

### 1.2 解决什么问题

bmc_network组件主要解决网络连通性、协议兼容性、故障恢复效率等问题，致力于提升服务可用性、优化运维效率、保障安全合规以及支撑未来扩展性等。

### 1.3 核心功能

- 配置IPv4

1、设置静态IPv4信息：IP、掩码、网关；

#### 3. MC_REFLECT反射机制

MC_REFLECT是一个编译期反射系统，实现属性的自动序列化和动态访问：

**工作原理**：

```cpp
// 1. 定义接口类
class PCIeDevice {
public:
    std::string DeviceName;
    std::string VendorId;
    std::string DeviceId;
    uint8_t Bus;
    uint8_t Device;
    uint8_t Function;
};

// 2. 注册反射信息
MC_REFLECT(PCIeDevice, (),
    ((DeviceName, "DeviceName"))
    ((VendorId, "VendorId"))
    ((DeviceId, "DeviceId"))
    ((Bus, "Bus"))
    ((Device, "Device"))
    ((Function, "Function"))
)

// 3. 运行时动态访问
mc::dict properties;
mc::reflect::to_variant(pcie_device, properties);  // 对象 -> JSON
mc::reflect::from_variant(

# Redfish、Web-Rest、CLI、SNMP接口定制
当前openUBMC接口使用接口映射配置实现，通过配置json文件的方式实现接口，框架解析配置，将接口请求转发到资源协作接口，拼装返回对应格式的数据。该方案有效减少代码开发量，大大提高开发效率。

下面以Redfish接口的配置为例说明如何进行接口定制，更多的配置需求可以参考[《接口映射配置》](../../design_reference/key_feature/interface_mapping.md)。

## 1. 组件概述

### 1.1 组件简介

General Hardware（通用硬件管理服务）是 openUBMC 系统中的硬件组件管理模块，负责管理天池板卡、固件升级、DPU/GPU/NPU设备、VRD电源、安全模块等通用硬件资源。支持通过 I2C、SMC、SMBUS 等多种通信协议实现硬件管理，同时支持制造测试接口为生产环境提供硬件验证功能。

### 1.2 解决什么问题

General Hardware 组件为用户提供了完整的硬件管理能力，包括天池板卡属性监控与版本管理、MCU/CPLD/FPGA/VRD/Retimer 固件升级、DPU智能网卡管理、GPU/NPU 设备监控、VRD电源信息采集、安全模块（TPM）状态管理等功能。通过 General Hardware 组件，用户可以在不依赖主机操

Temperature is typically measured in degrees Celsius and functions as a real-time, numeric parameter essential for system-level health assessment, performance monitoring, and reliability evaluation. The metric is captured through dedicated thermal sensors and reported via standardized interfaces such as VPD (Vital Product Data) or system management protocols, with readings often indexed as 0x1 in the SDR (Sensor Data Record) type field and represented using S16 or U16 data types depending on the system specification.\n\nBeyond real-time monitoring, Temperature serves as a core parameter in automated system control mechanisms. It is a key input for fan speed control, enabling dynamic adjustment of cooling subsystems in response to thermal loads. Additionally, temperature data informs power management decisions and supports chassis thermal strategies, particularly for non-NVIDIA GPUs, where high temperatures can lead to instability or system restarts. Temperature readings are used to trigger alarm conditions when thresholds are exceeded and are integral to SwitchRule configurations that initiate automated responses based on thermal events. Specific temperature values, such as 40°C, are contextually relevant and reflect normal operational states under defined conditions.\n\nTemperature also encompasses the management of historical acquisition data and temperature point types, functioning as a configuration parameter that enables tracking of thermal trends over time. This configuration aspect supports long-term reliability analysis and predictive maintenance by allowing the system to record and analyze temperature curves across different system states and durations. This historical data, combined with real-time monitoring, contributes to comprehensive system diagnostics and environmental assessment. Temperature is thus not only a physical measure of thermal energy but also a foundational metric in power supply system monitoring and broader component health management.\n\nDespite its significance, temperature data—especially CPU temperature—may be masked from event reporting in certain contexts due to frequent fluctuations, in order to prevent an excessive volume of alerts. However, this does not diminish its importance, as it remains a vital component of system diagnostics, thermal compliance verification, and preventive maintenance. Overall, Temperature is a multifaceted concept: a physical quantity, a real-time metric, a control input, and a configurable data management parameter, all essential to sustaining safe, efficient, and stable system operation.<SEP>Temperature is a physical quantity used to measure thermal state, and is a key input for fan speed control in the system.<SEP>Temperature is a metric used to monitor thermal conditions within a power supply system."}

{"entity": "Sensor", "type": "artifact", "description": "Sensor is a hardware component designed to detect and respond to physical inputs from the environment or system, including temperature, voltage, power status, pressure, motion, and other measurable parameters. These devices are fundamental to hardware monitoring and management systems, providing real-time data on the operational state of computing systems such as servers, embedded platforms, and data center infrastructure. Commonly deployed to track environmental conditions like board-level temperature, sensors are integrated across various subsystems to ensure system stability, reliability, and proactive fault detection. When predefined thresholds are exceeded, sensors can trigger alerts or initiate automated responses, contributing to efficient and continuous system health management.\n\nSensor functionality is formalized within the Redfish API specification as a standardized resource, enabling consistent and interoperable access to sensor data across diverse hardware platforms. This standardization supports centralized management and facilitates integration into broader system monitoring frameworks. Sensor data is typically collected via low-level system mechanisms such as the System Management Controller (SMC) and Design for eXtensibility (DFX), ensuring direct and reliable communication with physical hardware. The data gathered includes both continuous measurements and status indicators critical to assessing system performance, health, and integrity.\n\nIn software architecture, the Sensor entity is structured within a hierarchical framework, notably under the SensorSelInfo class as part of a larger sensor system. It also functions as a key component within the alarm subsystem, responsible for gathering hardware sensor data and supporting system-wide event detection. Sensor initialization is included in the subsys startup components list, ensuring that monitoring capabilities are active from the earliest stages of system boot-up. The Sensor entity is recognized in configuration systems as a business object representing a monitoring or input device, used to configure and manage data related to environmental and operational parameters such as temperature and voltage.\n\nSensors are integral to monitoring a wide array of computer system components, including CPUs, memory, hard drives, fans, and power supplies. They play a critical role in recording IPMI System Event Log (SEL) events, thereby contributing to diagnostic and maintenance workflows. As a general category, sensors encompass any device capable of measuring physical properties relevant to system operation. Their broad applicability and essential role in maintaining system integrity underscore their importance in modern computing infrastructures, from embedded devices to large-scale data centers."}

{"entity": "BMC", "type": "artifact", "description": "BMC refers to the Baseboard Management Controller, a specialized microcontroller embedded in server motherboards and computer systems to monitor and manage hardware health, configuration, and remote administration. It serves as a dedicated subsystem responsible for overseeing system-level functions such as environmental monitoring, including temperature, fan speed, power supply status, and GPU temperatures. The BMC operates independently of the main system processor, enabling out-of-band management, which allows for remote diagnostics, monitoring, and control even when the primary system is powered off or unresponsive. It supports standardized protocols such as IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) and MCTP (Management Controller Transport Protocol), facilitating commands for hardware discovery, sensor data collection, and event reporting. The BMC is critical in managing system health by generating default sensor numbers, handling data source synchronization, and triggering alarms during fault conditions. It plays an essential role in lifecycle management, including firmware updates, verification, parsing, and coordination of upgrade processes—such as those involving CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) firmware—where it initiates, manages, and validates upgrades. Additionally, the BMC manages network configuration, including IPMI communication, session handling, and gateway connectivity, and supports features like NTP synchronization for system timekeeping. It handles various hardware functions such as monitoring M.2 drive attributes (presence, capacity, health, temperature, remaining life), managing PCIe devices, and supporting remote server installation and firmware provisioning. The BMC also manages system components such as the ASU modul, including handling hot-plug events and configuration synchronization, and communicates via protocols like LocalBus and IPMB (Intelligent Platform Management Bus), typically assigned the slave address 0x20. It manages user access through systems like LDAP and SNMP, enables two-factor authentication through certificate import, and supports storing critical data such as Silkscreen configurations, SR files, CSR (Certificate Signing Request) data, and SilkConfig JSON files. While primarily a hardware component, certain descriptions reference BMC as an organization involved in system management, digital certificate issuance, firmware upgrades, and configuration services. However, the overwhelming majority of descriptions consistently identify BMC as a hardware-based Baseboard Management Controller responsible for hardware monitoring, remote control, system configuration, and inventory reporting in enterprise and rack-mounted server environments."}

{"entity": "TemperatureCelsius", "type": "concept", "description": "TemperatureCelsius is a data attribute used to represent temperature values in degrees Celsius across a wide range of hardware components within digital system monitoring frameworks. It functions as a read-only metric in most cases, though it may also serve as a read-write field in specific contexts such as processor temperature control. The attribute is primarily employed for real-time thermal monitoring, enabling system stability and optimal performance by tracking thermal conditions of critical components. It is commonly implemented as an 8-bit unsigned integer (U8) with a value of 255 indicating an invalid or unsupported reading, while also being represented as a 16-bit signed integer (S16) in certain configurations, where 0x7FFF denotes an unsupported reading and 0x7FFE signifies a failure in temperature acquisition. In some contexts, such as the Memory Class configuration dictionary (v1.1) and the MyCSRModel class, TemperatureCelsius specifically refers to the temperature of memory modules, though it is also applied to central processing units (CPUs), graphics processing units (GPUs), optical modules, network adapters, power supplies, battery backup units (BBUs), storage drives (including HDDs and PCIe SSDs), controller chips, retimers, and replicated drives. \n\nThe value is typically measured via standardized communication protocols such as SMBUS, NCSI_HUAWEI, IPMI, and smbios, with data collection occurring at fixed intervals—e.g., every 5 seconds for network adapters—or on demand depending on system requirements. The attribute may also be used as an input parameter in various system methods and is vital for alarm triggering, particularly in cases involving overheating risks. Notably, although the primary use case is real-time monitoring, one context suggests it may represent a target temperature for cooling systems constrained within a defined operational range—indicating a divergent functional role. Despite variations in usage, TemperatureCelsius remains a dynamic, system-specific indicator integral to thermal management strategies. Conflicts in description—such as conflicting data types or component associations—are not indicative of distinct entities but rather reflect the attribute's versatility across different hardware subsystems and implementation contexts. Therefore, the meaning of TemperatureCelsius is highly context-dependent, contingent upon the specific component and configuration within the system. Overall, the attribute plays a critical role in ensuring safe and efficient operation of modern computing infrastructure.<SEP>TemperatureCelsius is a metric that measures the temperature of the OpticalModule in degrees Celsius."}

{"entity": "NetworkAdapter", "type": "interface", "description": "NetworkAdapter is a core hardware component representing a network interface card (NIC) within server systems, serving as the primary interface for communication between the server and external networks. It is a multifaceted element integral to server chassis architectures, particularly in systems such as BMC Kepler, where it enables reliable network connectivity and supports advanced management functions. The component is identifiable by the unique identifier \"mainboardMEZZ2\" in specific contexts and is part of a structured management hierarchy, accessible via the Redfish path /redfish/v1/Chassis/Blade15/NetworkAdapters/mainboardMEZZ2. It is defined in the Management Data Structure (MDS) and recognized as a foundational system component responsible for managing network adapter operations, processing commands through protocols such as NCSI, PLDM over MCTP, SMBus, I2C, and D-Bus, and facilitating firmware updates and event reporting.\n\nNetworkAdapter supports network virtualization and segmentation by hosting multiple NetworkDeviceFunctions and managing associated NetworkPorts, thereby enhancing the flexibility and scalability of network infrastructure. It plays a central role in both physical and virtual environments, functioning as both a hardware device and a software artifact within system management frameworks. The component is characterized by key properties such as Model, MAC address, and communication speed, and it enables protocol-based access to band-out information via the network_adapter community component. Configurations may involve slot numbers and names, especially in BMC systems, with particular requirements for PCIe network cards.\n\nFunctionally, NetworkAdapter serves as an interface object within the device tree, managing core network adapter capabilities including status monitoring, fault detection, log collection, and OEM extensions. It is used in conjunction with PCIeDevice and acts as a critical interface for managing network adapter functionality across various device objects. Its integration with system-level interfaces enables comprehensive monitoring, diagnostics, and operational control. Within system management, it is consistently described as a class or interface responsible for maintaining network communication integrity, supporting event reporting, and enabling remote management. Overall, the NetworkAdapter is a pivotal, versatile component in modern server infrastructure, combining hardware reliability with robust software-managed functionality to ensure seamless network performance, advanced diagnostics, and scalable networking capabilities.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is an interface used for network communication, with implementations based on the gen::NetworkAdapter class.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is an interface object representing the network capabilities of a PCIe card, including port count and protocol support.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is a required interface in the device model, providing network adapter functionality and managing network interfaces.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is a C++ class that inherits from a base interface and manages network device operations via NCSI protocol."}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "---\r\ndate: 2026/05/28\r\ntitle: NPU卡Chip 1温度传感器显示异常问题分析\r\n---\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 问题背景\r\n\r\n- 单板类型：NA；\r\n- 软件版本：NA；\r\n- 涉及功能：传感器；\r\n- 触发条件：更改在位状态和电源状态概率触发；注册阶段概率触发。\r\n- 业务表现：预期传感器正常显示；实际部分传感器概率显示no reading。\r\n\r\n# 问题复现步骤\r\n\r\n设备持续做power cycle的操作，跑到105圈的时候，发现PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值，PCIe5 设备为Atlas 300 IDUO的NPU卡。\r\n\r\n# 关键日志信息\r\n\r\n传感器异常截图：\r\n![PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-1.png)\r\n\r\n# 定位过程\r\n\r\n1. 通过查看文件vpd\\vendor\\Huawei\\Gpu\\14140130_19e5d500_02000110.sr，NPU的CHIP温度传感器定义，温度从NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius获取。\r\n\r\n    ```json\r\n    \"ThresholdSensor_GPUAICore1Temp\": {\r\n        \"OwnerId\": 32,\r\n        \"OwnerLun\": 0,\r\n        \"EntityId\": \"<=/Entity_GPUCard.Id\",\r\n        \"EntityInstance\": \"<=/Entity_GPUCard.Instance\",\r\n        \"Initialization\": 127,\r\n        \"Capabilities\": 104,\r\n        \"SensorType\": 1,\r\n        \"ReadingType\": 1,\r\n        \"SensorName\": \"PCIe${Slot} Chip1 Temp\",\r\n        \"AssertMask\": 0,\r\n        \"DeassertMask\": 0,\r\n        \"ReadingMask\": 2056,\r\n        \"UpperNoncritical\": 105,\r\n        \"PositiveHysteresis\": 2,\r\n        \"NegativeHysteresis\": 2,\r\n        \"Unit\": 128,\r\n        \"BaseUnit\": 1,\r\n        \"ModifierUnit\": 0,\r\n        \"Linearization\": 0,\r\n        \"M\": 1,\r\n        \"RBExp\": 0,\r\n        \"Analog\": 1,\r\n        \"NominalReading\": 25,\r\n        \"NormalMaximum\": 0,\r\n        \"NormalMinimum\": 0,\r\n        \"MaximumReading\": 127,\r\n        \"MinimumReading\": 128,\r\n        \"Reading\": \"<=/NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius\",\r\n        \"ReadingStatus\": \"<=/NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius |> expr($1 >= 255 ? 1 : 0)\"\r\n    },\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n2. 查看NPUCard的信息，Core0TemperatureCelsius和Core1TemperatureCelsius的读值都是存在的。\r\n![Core0TemperatureCelsius和Core1TemperatureCelsius的读值](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-2.png)\r\n3. 查看传感器的读值，Reading值也是存在的，但是 ReadingDisplay值为-1.存在异常。\r\n![ReadingDisplay值为-1](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-3.png)\r\n4. 尝试修改PCIe5 Chip1 的ReadingDisplay的值为80，PCIe5 Chip1 Temp传感器的值在WEB上还是无显示。\r\n5. 尝试修改PCIe5 Chip0 的ReadingDisplay的值为80，PCIe5 Chip0 Temp传感器的值在WEB上可以更新。\r\n\r\n# 问题原因\r\n\r\n1. Entity的下电和不在位都会导致传感器禁用，但在此基础上，进行上电会导致传感器又使能，因为没有检测是否在位，所以导致查询预期是禁用，结果变成了NoReading。\r\n2. 传感器与Entity的注册存在时序问题，也会导致传感器的匹配概率出现问题。\r\n\r\n# 解决方案\r\n\r\n1. 修改成，Entity上电或者在位时，要检测另一个值，因为上电和在位同时满足才应该使能。\r\n2. 优化为Entity的一个Position注册完再注册对应的Sensor。"}

{"reference_id": "3", "content": "---\ndate: 2025/10/11\ntitle: 适配一款硬件\n---\n---\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> 为了保证该章节学习的完整性，请确保您已经完成了[《扩展对外接口》](./extend_bmc_api.md)\n\nBMC作为一款服务器带外管理软件，差异性的硬件适配是BMC最常见的业务场景。openUBMC SDK基于自身多年经验，提供了一系列的硬件适配能力，简化硬件适配的开发流程。\n\n本章节将介绍如何在已有的硬件适配上进行**增量开发**，用于帮助您理解硬件适配流程。具体的各类硬件适配细节，请参考[《开发指南》](../develop_guide/feature_development/board_integration.md)。\n\n# 新增一个IPMI Sensor\n\n一个常见的场景便是需要将硬件上的某一个器件的读值，通过IPMI协议中定义的门限传感器呈现给用户。在本章节中，我们将配置一个LM75温度器件，同时配置一个对应的IPMI门限传感器，并呈现至对外接口。\n\n## CSR配置\nopenUBMC采用一种软件描述性语言描述一个硬件的具体信息，这种描述性语言被称之为Component Self-description Record(CSR)。\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> 关于CSR的具体介绍，请参考[《硬件自描述文件(CSR)》](../design_reference/key_feature/CSR.md)\n\n首先我们先获取CSR仓库：\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://gitcode.com/openUBMC/vpd.git\n```\n\n打开服务机型(vendor/Huawei/Server/Kunpeng/openUBMC)的`root.sr`\n\n打开后可以发现一系列配置。首先我们需要在硬件拓扑链路中声明一个LM75器件。\n\n在实际的硬件链路拓扑中，I2c_8总线下地址为`0x90`处有一个LM75温感芯片。\n\n在CSR的`ManagementTopology`中找到对应的`I2c_8`的配置，如果没有`I2c_8`，请在`ManagementTopology`中粘贴下面的配置（可参考`I2c_2`的配置）。\n\n```json\n\"ManagementTopology\": {\n    ...\n    \"I2c_8\": {\n        \"Chip\": [\n            \"Lm75_DemoSensor\"\n        ]\n    }\n    ...\n}\n```\n\n这样CSR中便完成了实际的硬件链路拓扑配置。\n\n同时，在与`ManagementTopology`同级的`objects`下面定义Lm75器件的具体信息，和两个业务对象：\n\n```json\n\"Objects\": {\n    ...\n    \"Lm75_DemoSensor\": {\n        \"OffsetWidth\": 1,\n        \"AddrWidth\": 1,\n        \"Address\": 144\n    },\n    \"Scanner_GetTemperature\": {\n        \"Chip\": \"#/Lm75_DemoSensor\",\n        \"Size\": 1,\n        \"Offset\": 0,\n        \"Mask\": 255,\n        \"Period\": 1000\n    },\n    \"ThresholdSensor_DemoSensor\": {\n        \"AssertMask\": 29312,\n        \"DeassertMask\": 29312,\n        \"ReadingMask\": 6168,\n        \"Linearization\": 0,\n        \"M\": 100,\n        \"RBExp\": 224,\n        \"UpperCritical\": 48,\n        \"UpperNoncritical\": 46,\n        \"PositiveHysteresis\": 2,\n        \"NegativeHysteresis\": 2,\n        \"OwnerId\": 32,\n        \"OwnerLun\": 0,\n        \"EntityId\": \"<=/Entity_DemoSensor.Id\",\n        \"EntityInstance\": \"<=/Entity_DemoSensor.Instance\",\n        \"Initialization\": 127,\n        \"Capabilities\": 104,\n        \"SensorType\": 1,\n        \"ReadingType\": 1,\n        \"SensorName\": \"Demo Temperature Sensor\",\n        \"Unit\": 128,\n        \"BaseUnit\": 1,\n        \"ModifierUnit\": 0,\n        \"Analog\": 1,\n        \"MaximumReading\": 127,\n        \"MinimumReading\": 128,\n        \"Reading\": \"<=/Scanner_GetTemperature.Value\"\n    },\n    \"Entity_DemoSensor\":{\n        \"Id\": 99,\n        \"Name\": \"Demo Temperature Sensor\",\n        \"PowerState\": 1,\n        \"Presence\": 1,\n        \"Instance\": 96\n    },\n    ...\n}\n```\n\n此处我们定义了两个对象，一个是Lm75器件，一个是定期扫描任务`Scanner`，一个是IPMI门限传感器的软件对象。\n我们通过`引用`语法将Scanner和Lm75器件关联起来；通过`同步`语法将Scanner的读值同步至ThresholdSensor的读值。\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> 具体IPMI传感器的配置，请参考[《IPMI Sensor & SEL》](../design_reference/key_feature/sensor.md)\n\n## 组件构建\n\n由于修改了vpd仓库，因此我们需要对vpd仓库进行重新构建。\n\n为了和之前版本进行区分，我们需要将`service.json`中的`version`字段进行更新\n\n```bash\nbingo build --stage=stable\n```\n\n## 整包构建\n\n找到vpd声明位置，将版本改至对应的构建版本，然后在manifest中再次进行整包构建\n\n```bash\nbingo build\n```\n\n## 整包测试\n\n整包升级后，我们可以通过ipmitool进行传感器查询。\n\n```bash\n>"}

不可操作；1 - 可拔出；2 - 可插入；其他 - 未知 |\n | `SerialNumber` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 序列号 |\n | `PreviousSerialNumber` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 更换前的序列号 |\n | `TemperatureCelsius` | `S16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片温度 |\n | `TemperatureStatus` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片温度状态：0 - 正常；1 - 失效 |\n | `MaxOperatingTemperatureCelsius` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡在稳态下支持的最大温度 |\n | `LLDPSupported` | `Boolean` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡是否支持LLDP |\n | `FruId` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡电子标签 |\n | `PredictiveFault` | `U8` |读写 | 变更广播 | 预测故障标志位 |\n | `DiagnosticFault` | `U8` |读写 | 变更广播 | 故障诊断定位标志位 |\n | `ReplacedFlag` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡更换标志位 |\n | `SupportedLLDP` | `Boolean` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡是否支持LLDP |\n | `ParentCardSlotId` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 关联上一级卡的槽位号 |\n | `PfMacInfo` | `Array` |只读 | 变更广播 | Physical Function Mac信息 |\n | `BandwidthThresholdPercent` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网络带宽占用率门限 |\n | `NodeId` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡NodeId |\n\n**==方法==**\n\n---\n\n`StartRemovingDevice`\n\n启动设备热拔\n\n**参数**\n- `ID`: String \\- 设备号\n\n---\n\n`DumpBlackBox`\n\n收集黑匣子日志,当前仅SDI 5.1的网络卡支持\n\n**参数**\n- `Path`: String \\- 日志保存路径\n\n**返回值**\n- `TaskId`: U32 \\- 任务ID\n\n---\n\n`Reset`\n\n复位或上下电设备\n\n**参数**\n- `ResetType`: String \\- 需要执行的复位或上下电动作：GracefulRestart - 优雅复位；ForceOff - 强制下电；ForceOn - 强制上电\n\n---\n\n\n**==自定义类型==**\n\n---\n`PfMacInfoItem`: 结构体类型\n- `Port`: U16 \\- Physical Function Port信息\n- `PfId`: U16 \\- Physical Function Id信息\n- `PermanentMac`: String \\- 永久物理地址信息\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkAdapter.NetworkAdapterMetrics\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `LinkWidthCapability` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡支持的最大带宽能力 |\n | `LinkSpeedCapability` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡支持的最大速"}
{"reference_id": "6", "content": "to 8A91502511B0084973\n```\n\n若以上打印出现前，未进行内存的更换，则为误告警。内存对象的SN来源于BIOS基于BMC发送的丝印文件提供的SMBIOS文件。若出现以上情况，可以判定为BIOS上报的SNBIOS文件中的SN发生了变动。首先确认我们发送给带内的丝印文件是否有误，丝印文件位于一键收集日志的 `dump_info\\AppDump\\bios\\1\\silkconfig.json` 下，其中一个内存的丝印文件如下，并标注了其对应的内存对象的属性\n\n```[auto]\n{\n    \"DimmId\": 1,                 内存对象 bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory 接口下的 DimmId 属性\n    \"LogicalChannelId\": 5,       内存对象 bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory 接口下的 LogicalChannelId 属性\n    \"PhysicalChannelId\": 3,      内存对象 bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory 接口下的 ChannelId 属性\n    \"SocketId\": 0,               内存对象 bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory 接口下的 CpuId 属性\n    \"Silk\": \"DIMM031\"            内存对象 bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory 接口下的 DimmName 属性\n}\n```\n\n通过查询日志文件 `dump_info\\AppDump\\compute\\mdb_info.log`，可以发现不存在符合该条件的内存，即可判定为发送的丝印文件有误。一般而言丝印文件的传输是由BIOS在带内os起来后，主动要求BMC发送的，因此当BIOS在请求丝印文件时，若相关信息没有上树，则会出现发送的丝印文件错误的情况。更具体的流程可以参考这篇社区文档：[丝印上报总结分享](https://discuss.openubmc.cn/t/topic/2097)，该文档讲解得非常详细。\n\n## 【Q】内存不加载\n\n内存的加载流程整体分为两部分\n\n1. 硬件自发现的对象分发\n2. 依据丝印文件中的信息将对应内存对象 `bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory` 接口下的 `Presence` 置为 `0/1`\n\n第一部分的相关流程，社区中有详细的文档介绍，此处不重复介绍。第二部分则依赖于BIOS提供的SMBIOS文件。具体的计算方式如下：\n\n```[auto]\n(Memory.Manufacturer ~= 'NO DIMM' and Memory.Manufacturer ~= 'empty') and 1 or 0\n```\n\n其中 `Memory.Manufacturer` 为该内存对象 `bmc.kepler.Systems.Memory`接口下的 `Manufacturer` 属性。\n\n## 【Q】NPU卡支持哪些属性？如何获取？\n\nNPU卡通过标准SMBUS协议与MCU通信，获取各类属性信息。以下是各属性分类的详细说明：\n\n| 属性名称 | 命令字(opcode) | 查询间隔 | 响应转换方法 | 数据类型 |\n|---------|--------------|---------|-------------|---------|\n| McuFirmwareVersion | 0x0005 | 30s | `string.format('%s.%s.%s', string.unpack('BBB', data))` | 版本字符串 |\n| FirmwareVersion | 0x0607 | 30s | 直接返回字符串 | 版本字符串 |\n| PowerWatts | 0x0004 | 2s | `bs.new([[<<power:16>>]]):unpack(data, true).power` | 整型(瓦特) |\n| DeviceTemperature | 0x001D | 2s | 按传感器名称映射为 AiCoreTemp/HBMTemp/NimBusTemp/VRDChipTemp | 温度对象 |\n| ChipTemperature | 0x0003 | 2s | `bs.new([[<<chip_temp:16>>]]):unpack(data, true).chip_temp` | 整型(摄氏度) |\n| MemoryCapacityKiB | 未在配置中定义 | 30s | 每个芯片容量累加后除以1024转为MB | 整型(MiB) |\n| MemoryBandWidth | 未在配置中定义 | 30s | 直接返回 | 整型 |\n| SerialNumber | 通过Elabel获取 | 按需 | 来自Elabel的BoardSerialNumber | 字符串 |\n| BoardID | 0x0F | 10s | {"entity": "NetworkAdapter", "type": "interface", "description": "NetworkAdapter is a core hardware component representing a network interface card (NIC) within server systems, serving as the primary interface for communication between the server and external networks. It is a multifaceted element integral to server chassis architectures, particularly in systems such as BMC Kepler, where it enables reliable network connectivity and supports advanced management functions. The component is identifiable by the unique identifier \"mainboardMEZZ2\" in specific contexts and is part of a structured management hierarchy, accessible via the Redfish path /redfish/v1/Chassis/Blade15/NetworkAdapters/mainboardMEZZ2. It is defined in the Management Data Structure (MDS) and recognized as a foundational system component responsible for managing network adapter operations, processing commands through protocols such as NCSI, PLDM over MCTP, SMBus, I2C, and D-Bus, and facilitating firmware updates and event reporting.\n\nNetworkAdapter supports network virtualization and segmentation by hosting multiple NetworkDeviceFunctions and managing associated NetworkPorts, thereby enhancing the flexibility and scalability of network infrastructure. It plays a central role in both physical and virtual environments, functioning as both a hardware device and a software artifact within system management frameworks. The component is characterized by key properties such as Model, MAC address, and communication speed, and it enables protocol-based access to band-out information via the network_adapter community component. Configurations may involve slot numbers and names, especially in BMC systems, with particular requirements for PCIe network cards.\n\nFunctionally, NetworkAdapter serves as an interface object within the device tree, managing core network adapter capabilities including status monitoring, fault detection, log collection, and OEM extensions. It is used in conjunction with PCIeDevice and acts as a critical interface for managing network adapter functionality across various device objects. Its integration with system-level interfaces enables comprehensive monitoring, diagnostics, and operational control. Within system management, it is consistently described as a class or interface responsible for maintaining network communication integrity, supporting event reporting, and enabling remote management. Overall, the NetworkAdapter is a pivotal, versatile component in modern server infrastructure, combining hardware reliability with robust software-managed functionality to ensure seamless network performance, advanced diagnostics, and scalable networking capabilities.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is an interface used for network communication, with implementations based on the gen::NetworkAdapter class.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is an interface object representing the network capabilities of a PCIe card, including port count and protocol support.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is a required interface in the device model, providing network adapter functionality and managing network interfaces.<SEP>NetworkAdapter is a C++ class that inherits from a base interface and manages network device operations via NCSI protocol."}

{"entity": "TemperatureCelsius", "type": "concept", "description": "TemperatureCelsius is a data attribute used to represent temperature values in degrees Celsius across a wide range of hardware components within digital system monitoring frameworks. It functions as a read-only metric in most cases, though it may also serve as a read-write field in specific contexts such as processor temperature control. The attribute is primarily employed for real-time thermal monitoring, enabling system stability and optimal performance by tracking thermal conditions of critical components. It is commonly implemented as an 8-bit unsigned integer (U8) with a value of 255 indicating an invalid or unsupported reading, while also being represented as a 16-bit signed integer (S16) in certain configurations, where 0x7FFF denotes an unsupported reading and 0x7FFE signifies a failure in temperature acquisition. In some contexts, such as the Memory Class configuration dictionary (v1.1) and the MyCSRModel class, TemperatureCelsius specifically refers to the temperature of memory modules, though it is also applied to central processing units (CPUs), graphics processing units (GPUs), optical modules, network adapters, power supplies, battery backup units (BBUs), storage drives (including HDDs and PCIe SSDs), controller chips, retimers, and replicated drives. \n\nThe value is typically measured via standardized communication protocols such as SMBUS, NCSI_HUAWEI, IPMI, and smbios, with data collection occurring at fixed intervals—e.g., every 5 seconds for network adapters—or on demand depending on system requirements. The attribute may also be used as an input parameter in various system methods and is vital for alarm triggering, particularly in cases involving overheating risks. Notably, although the primary use case is real-time monitoring, one context suggests it may represent a target temperature for cooling systems constrained within a defined operational range—indicating a divergent functional role. Despite variations in usage, TemperatureCelsius remains a dynamic, system-specific indicator integral to thermal management strategies. Conflicts in description—such as conflicting data types or component associations—are not indicative of distinct entities but rather reflect the attribute's versatility across different hardware subsystems and implementation contexts. Therefore, the meaning of TemperatureCelsius is highly context-dependent, contingent upon the specific component and configuration within the system. Overall, the attribute plays a critical role in ensuring safe and efficient operation of modern computing infrastructure.<SEP>TemperatureCelsius is a metric that measures the temperature of the OpticalModule in degrees Celsius."}

{"entity": "Sensor", "type": "artifact", "description": "Sensor is a hardware component designed to detect and respond to physical inputs from the environment or system, including temperature, voltage, power status, pressure, motion, and other measurable parameters. These devices are fundamental to hardware monitoring and management systems, providing real-time data on the operational state of computing systems such as servers, embedded platforms, and data center infrastructure. Commonly deployed to track environmental conditions like board-level temperature, sensors are integrated across various subsystems to ensure system stability, reliability, and proactive fault detection. When predefined thresholds are exceeded, sensors can trigger alerts or initiate automated responses, contributing to efficient and continuous system health management.\n\nSensor functionality is formalized within the Redfish API specification as a standardized resource, enabling consistent and interoperable access to sensor data across diverse hardware platforms. This standardization supports centralized management and facilitates integration into broader system monitoring frameworks. Sensor data is typically collected via low-level system mechanisms such as the System Management Controller (SMC) and Design for eXtensibility (DFX), ensuring direct and reliable communication with physical hardware. The data gathered includes both continuous measurements and status indicators critical to assessing system performance, health, and integrity.\n\nIn software architecture, the Sensor entity is structured within a hierarchical framework, notably under the SensorSelInfo class as part of a larger sensor system. It also functions as a key component within the alarm subsystem, responsible for gathering hardware sensor data and supporting system-wide event detection. Sensor initialization is included in the subsys startup components list, ensuring that monitoring capabilities are active from the earliest stages of system boot-up. The Sensor entity is recognized in configuration systems as a business object representing a monitoring or input device, used to configure and manage data related to environmental and operational parameters such as temperature and voltage.\n\nSensors are integral to monitoring a wide array of computer system components, including CPUs, memory, hard drives, fans, and power supplies. They play a critical role in recording IPMI System Event Log (SEL) events, thereby contributing to diagnostic and maintenance workflows. As a general category, sensors encompass any device capable of measuring physical properties relevant to system operation. Their broad applicability and essential role in maintaining system integrity underscore their importance in modern computing infrastructures, from embedded devices to large-scale data centers."}

{"entity": "BMC", "type": "artifact", "description": "BMC refers to the Baseboard Management Controller, a specialized microcontroller embedded in server motherboards and computer systems to monitor and manage hardware health, configuration, and remote administration. It serves as a dedicated subsystem responsible for overseeing system-level functions such as environmental monitoring, including temperature, fan speed, power supply status, and GPU temperatures. The BMC operates independently of the main system processor, enabling out-of-band management, which allows for remote diagnostics, monitoring, and control even when the primary system is powered off or unresponsive. It supports standardized protocols such as IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) and MCTP (Management Controller Transport Protocol), facilitating commands for hardware discovery, sensor data collection, and event reporting. The BMC is critical in managing system health by generating default sensor numbers, handling data source synchronization, and triggering alarms during fault conditions. It plays an essential role in lifecycle management, including firmware updates, verification, parsing, and coordination of upgrade processes—such as those involving CPLD (Complex Programmable Logic Device) firmware—where it initiates, manages, and validates upgrades. Additionally, the BMC manages network configuration, including IPMI communication, session handling, and gateway connectivity, and supports features like NTP synchronization for system timekeeping. It handles various hardware functions such as monitoring M.2 drive attributes (presence, capacity, health, temperature, remaining life), managing PCIe devices, and supporting remote server installation and firmware provisioning. The BMC also manages system components such as the ASU modul, including handling hot-plug events and configuration synchronization, and communicates via protocols like LocalBus and IPMB (Intelligent Platform Management Bus), typically assigned the slave address 0x20. It manages user access through systems like LDAP and SNMP, enables two-factor authentication through certificate import, and supports storing critical data such as Silkscreen configurations, SR files, CSR (Certificate Signing Request) data, and SilkConfig JSON files. While primarily a hardware component, certain descriptions reference BMC as an organization involved in system management, digital certificate issuance, firmware upgrades, and configuration services. However, the overwhelming majority of descriptions consistently identify BMC as a hardware-based Baseboard Management Controller responsible for hardware monitoring, remote control, system configuration, and inventory reporting in enterprise and rack-mounted server environments."}

{"entity": "sdrType", "type": "data", "description": "sdrType is a byte-level parameter located at byte 5 within the IPMI command request packet, serving as a categorization field that specifies the type of Sensor Data Record (SDR) being accessed or processed. It is consistently described as a field in the command request that defines the type of SDR or System Device Record, depending on the context. The most widely supported and universally recognized value for sdrType is 0x00, which is explicitly documented as the default, fixed, and required setting for general sensor data record retrieval. This value is repeatedly affirmed across multiple sources as correct and necessary for standard operations, including specific requests such as Get-Power-Supply-Manufacturer-Name, reinforcing its foundational role in standard IPMI behavior. Some sources treat sdrType as a reserved field with a value of 0, aligning with the hexadecimal 0x00 representation.\n\nHowever, conflicting descriptions exist regarding permissible values. While 0x00 is consistently validated, other sources report alternative values such as 0x01, 0x02, 0x08, 0x3b, 0x45, 0x51, 0x58, and 0x74, each associated with distinct or specialized SDR types. For example, 0x01 is cited as the value used to specify a particular sensor data record type, and 0x02 is noted as the required value for motherboard CPLD-specific data. Similarly, 0x58 and 0x74 are listed as valid values without clear contextual explanation, indicating potential vendor-specific or platform-dependent interpretations. These inconsistencies suggest that while 0x00 is broadly applicable for general SDR access, the full valid range of sdrType is not standardized across all systems. The meaning and validity of sdrType values are therefore implementation-dependent, varying significantly across hardware platforms, firmware versions, and vendor implementations.\n\nConsequently, accurate usage of sdrType requires careful contextual awareness and reliance on platform-specific documentation, especially when handling specialized or vendor-extended sensor data records. The presence of multiple values and divergent labeling—such as confusion between Sensor Data Record and System Device Record types—further underscores the need for technical precision. In summary, while sdrType is a critical parameter in the IPMI command request, its interpretation and correct configuration cannot be assumed universally and must be verified within the specific system environment."}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "---\r\ndate: 2026/05/28\r\ntitle: NPU卡Chip 1温度传感器显示异常问题分析\r\n---\r\n---\r\n\r\n# 问题背景\r\n\r\n- 单板类型：NA；\r\n- 软件版本：NA；\r\n- 涉及功能：传感器；\r\n- 触发条件：更改在位状态和电源状态概率触发；注册阶段概率触发。\r\n- 业务表现：预期传感器正常显示；实际部分传感器概率显示no reading。\r\n\r\n# 问题复现步骤\r\n\r\n设备持续做power cycle的操作，跑到105圈的时候，发现PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值，PCIe5 设备为Atlas 300 IDUO的NPU卡。\r\n\r\n# 关键日志信息\r\n\r\n传感器异常截图：\r\n![PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-1.png)\r\n\r\n# 定位过程\r\n\r\n1. 通过查看文件vpd\\vendor\\Huawei\\Gpu\\14140130_19e5d500_02000110.sr，NPU的CHIP温度传感器定义，温度从NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius获取。\r\n\r\n    ```json\r\n    \"ThresholdSensor_GPUAICore1Temp\": {\r\n        \"OwnerId\": 32,\r\n        \"OwnerLun\": 0,\r\n        \"EntityId\": \"<=/Entity_GPUCard.Id\",\r\n        \"EntityInstance\": \"<=/Entity_GPUCard.Instance\",\r\n        \"Initialization\": 127,\r\n        \"Capabilities\": 104,\r\n        \"SensorType\": 1,\r\n        \"ReadingType\": 1,\r\n        \"SensorName\": \"PCIe${Slot} Chip1 Temp\",\r\n        \"AssertMask\": 0,\r\n        \"DeassertMask\": 0,\r\n        \"ReadingMask\": 2056,\r\n        \"UpperNoncritical\": 105,\r\n        \"PositiveHysteresis\": 2,\r\n        \"NegativeHysteresis\": 2,\r\n        \"Unit\": 128,\r\n        \"BaseUnit\": 1,\r\n        \"ModifierUnit\": 0,\r\n        \"Linearization\": 0,\r\n        \"M\": 1,\r\n        \"RBExp\": 0,\r\n        \"Analog\": 1,\r\n        \"NominalReading\": 25,\r\n        \"NormalMaximum\": 0,\r\n        \"NormalMinimum\": 0,\r\n        \"MaximumReading\": 127,\r\n        \"MinimumReading\": 128,\r\n        \"Reading\": \"<=/NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius\",\r\n        \"ReadingStatus\": \"<=/NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius |> expr($1 >= 255 ? 1 : 0)\"\r\n    },\r\n    ```\r\n\r\n2. 查看NPUCard的信息，Core0TemperatureCelsius和Core1TemperatureCelsius的读值都是存在的。\r\n![Core0TemperatureCelsius和Core1TemperatureCelsius的读值](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-2.png)\r\n3. 查看传感器的读值，Reading值也是存在的，但是 ReadingDisplay值为-1.存在异常。\r\n![ReadingDisplay值为-1](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-3.png)\r\n4. 尝试修改PCIe5 Chip1 的ReadingDisplay的值为80，PCIe5 Chip1 Temp传感器的值在WEB上还是无显示。\r\n5. 尝试修改PCIe5 Chip0 的ReadingDisplay的值为80，PCIe5 Chip0 Temp传感器的值在WEB上可以更新。\r\n\r\n# 问题原因\r\n\r\n1. Entity的下电和不在位都会导致传感器禁用，但在此基础上，进行上电会导致传感器又使能，因为没有检测是否在位，所以导致查询预期是禁用，结果变成了NoReading。\r\n2. 传感器与Entity的注册存在时序问题，也会导致传感器的匹配概率出现问题。\r\n\r\n# 解决方案\r\n\r\n1. 修改成，Entity上电或者在位时，要检测另一个值，因为上电和在位同时满足才应该使能。\r\n2. 优化为Entity的一个Position注册完再注册对应的Sensor。"}

{"reference_id": "3", "content": "1：主控芯片内部自检项<br>2：MCU管理的PCIe卡主控芯片外围设备自检<br>3：MCU管理的PCIe卡面板按钮测试<br>4：MCU管理的PCIe卡面板指示灯测试<br>5：MCU日志清除测试<br>6：MCU自愈功能测试（由按钮触发）<br>7：MCU触发降频中断测试<br>8：MCU控制芯片下电测试 |\n| - | - | - | 0xAD | 173 | 漏液检测卡电磁阀测试 | Magnetic Valve Test | - | 写PCA9555寄存器开/关电磁阀，然后读另一个PCA9555寄存器检测电磁阀开/关状态 |\n| - | - | - | 0xAE | 174 | 漏液检测卡漏液检测告警测试 | Leak Alarm Test | - | 写PCA9555寄存器模拟漏液告警产生/消除，然后读另外一个PCA9555寄存器检测漏液告警状态 |\n| - | - | - | 0xAF | 175 | NPU过温保护测试 | Npu High Temp Protect Test | atlas800 | 装备从带内注入故障触发cpld信号，然后从带外查询cpld寄存器获取过温状态 |\n| 6：机型自定义<br>dft id<br>`<C1h-FFh>`<br><br>备注：同一个机型的dft id定义不允许冲突 | 公共 | - | 0xC3 | 195 | 机箱盖开盖检测、测试 | Chassis Cover Open Test | - | 用于开箱测试中检测机箱盖开关状态 |\n| - | - | - | 0xC6 | 198 | SECURITY PANEL TEST | SECURITY PANEL TEST | - | 用于安全面板测试项装备测试 |\n| - | TianGong | - | 0xC1 | 193 | CAN通道测试 | - | - | 用于CAN通道环回测试，CAN通道发出测试数据，在BMC串口读取对应的数据。 |\n| - | TCE | - | 0xC1 | 193 | 计算板CDR测试 | - | TCE计算板 | - |\n| - | 废弃 | - | 0xC1 | 193 | SOL串口 | SOL UART | - | - |\n| - | - | - | 0xC2 | 194 | 风扇 | Fan | - | - |\n| - | TaiShan | - | 0xC4 | 196 | 60盘硬盘抽屉拉出测试 | 60-disk drawer pull out Test | - | 用于TaiShan 5290 60盘硬盘抽屉拉出测试 |\n| - | 存储 | - | 0xC5 | 197 | PENGEA FT TEST | PENGEA FT TEST | 盘古V6R5 | 用于盘古V6R5产品（太平洋、北冰洋、大西洋）装备测试<br>IPMI命令中的Device ID具体定义如下：<br>1：风扇板点灯测试<br>2：光模块上下电测试 |\n| - | E9000 | - | 0xC2 | 194 | 管理板网口装备自检 | - | MM920<br>MM921<br>TCE管理板 | - |"}

不可操作；1 - 可拔出；2 - 可插入；其他 - 未知 |\n | `SerialNumber` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 序列号 |\n | `PreviousSerialNumber` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 更换前的序列号 |\n | `TemperatureCelsius` | `S16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片温度 |\n | `TemperatureStatus` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 芯片温度状态：0 - 正常；1 - 失效 |\n | `MaxOperatingTemperatureCelsius` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡在稳态下支持的最大温度 |\n | `LLDPSupported` | `Boolean` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡是否支持LLDP |\n | `FruId` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡电子标签 |\n | `PredictiveFault` | `U8` |读写 | 变更广播 | 预测故障标志位 |\n | `DiagnosticFault` | `U8` |读写 | 变更广播 | 故障诊断定位标志位 |\n | `ReplacedFlag` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡更换标志位 |\n | `SupportedLLDP` | `Boolean` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡是否支持LLDP |\n | `ParentCardSlotId` | `U8` |只读 | 变更广播 | 关联上一级卡的槽位号 |\n | `PfMacInfo` | `Array` |只读 | 变更广播 | Physical Function Mac信息 |\n | `BandwidthThresholdPercent` | `U16` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网络带宽占用率门限 |\n | `NodeId` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡NodeId |\n\n**==方法==**\n\n---\n\n`StartRemovingDevice`\n\n启动设备热拔\n\n**参数**\n- `ID`: String \\- 设备号\n\n---\n\n`DumpBlackBox`\n\n收集黑匣子日志,当前仅SDI 5.1的网络卡支持\n\n**参数**\n- `Path`: String \\- 日志保存路径\n\n**返回值**\n- `TaskId`: U32 \\- 任务ID\n\n---\n\n`Reset`\n\n复位或上下电设备\n\n**参数**\n- `ResetType`: String \\- 需要执行的复位或上下电动作：GracefulRestart - 优雅复位；ForceOff - 强制下电；ForceOn - 强制上电\n\n---\n\n\n**==自定义类型==**\n\n---\n`PfMacInfoItem`: 结构体类型\n- `Port`: U16 \\- Physical Function Port信息\n- `PfId`: U16 \\- Physical Function Id信息\n- `PermanentMac`: String \\- 永久物理地址信息\n\n# bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkAdapter.NetworkAdapterMetrics\n\n**==属性==**\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 可读写 | 信号通知 | 描述 |\n|-------|------|-------|---------|------|\n | `LinkWidthCapability` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡支持的最大带宽能力 |\n | `LinkSpeedCapability` | `String` |只读 | 变更广播 | 网卡支持的最大速"}
{"reference_id": "6", "content": "内存的丝印 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `\"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 2 - 2) |> string.format('DIMM%s50', $1)\"` | CSR配置 | 软件 |\n| `Health` | U8 | 0 | U8 | Component_Memory | 内存健康状态 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `\"<=/Component_Memory6.Health\"` | CSR配置 | 硬件 |\n\n---\n\n## 可选属性\n\n| 属性名 | 类型 | 默认值 | 取值范围 | 动态关联 | 描述 | 使用场景 | 举例 | 来源 | 分类 |\n|--------|------|--------|----------|----------|------|----------|------|------|------|\n| `Presence` | U8 | 0 | U8 | - | 内存在位状态，默认不在位 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `255` | CSR配置 | 软件 |\n| `MemoryDeviceType` | String | Unknown | String | - | 内存设备类型，只有HBM需要配置 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `\"DRAM\"` | CSR配置 | 软件 |\n| `LogicTemperatureCelsius` | Double | 0 | Double | - | HBM Logic区域温度 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `0` | 软件刷新 | 硬件 |\n| `DRAMTemperatureCelsius` | Double | 0 | Double | - | HBM DRAM区域温度 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `0` | 软件刷新 | 硬件 |\n| `PredictiveFault` | U8 | 0 | U8 | - | 预故障告警状态 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `0` | CSR配置 | 软件 |\n| `PartNumber` | String | '' | String | - | 内存的原厂部件号 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `\"N/A\"` | CSR配置 | 软件 |\n| `SerialNumber` | String | '' | String | - | 内存序列号 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `\"\"` | 软件更新 | 软件 |\n| `DiagnosticFault` | U8 | 0 | U8 | - | 严重故障诊断告警状态 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `0` | CSR配置 | 软件 |\n| `Manufacturer` | String | '' | String | - | 内存制造商 | 内存信息加载、显示 | `\"Huawei\"` | smbios上报 | 软件 |\n| `TemperatureCelsius` | Double | 0 | Double | - | 内存温度（摄氏度） | 内存温度显示、告警配置 | `0` | 软件刷新 | 硬件 |\n| `TSensorTemperatureCelsius` | S16 | 0 | S16 | - | 内存TSensor温度（摄氏度） | 内存温度显示 | `0` | 软件刷新 | 硬件 |\n\n---\n\n# 🔗 动态关联机制\n\n## 语法规范\n\n使用表达式和变量替换语法实现动态关联：\n\n```yaml\n# 系统ID变量替换\nSystemId: \"${SystemId}\"\n\n# 表达式计算\nDimmNum: \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 16 - 8)\"\nCpuId: \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 2 - 2)\"\n\n# 字符串格式化\nName: \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 2 - 2) |> string.format('Memory%s40', $1)\"\nDimmName: \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 2 - 2) |> string.format('DIMM%s40', $1)\"\n\n# 健康状态关联\nHealth: \"<=/Component_Memory6.Health\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## 关联说明\n\n- **SystemId**: 使用系统ID变量标识内存所在的Host\n- **表达式计算**: 通过槽位计算相关ID和通道号\n- **字符串格式化**: 动态生成内存名称和DIMM名称\n- **Health**: 关联Component对象获取健康状态\n\n---\n\n# 📂 分类标准\n\n## 硬件属性\n\n- **定义**：与硬件内存设备直接相关的参数\n- **特点**：反映内存硬件的物理状态和温度\n- **示例**：`Health`, `LogicTemperatureCelsius`, `DRAMTemperatureCelsius`, `TemperatureCelsius`, `TSensorTemperatureCelsius`\n\n---\n\n## 软件属性\n\n- **定义**：用于软件逻辑控制和信息管理的参数\n- **特点**：由CSR配置或软件更新管理\n- **示例**：`SystemId`, `DimmNum`, `Name`, `DimmName`, `Presence`, `CpuId`, `NodeId`, `ChannelId`, `LogicalChannelId`, `DimmId`, `Position`, `SilkText`, `DeviceLocator`, `MemoryDeviceType`, `PredictiveFault`, `OriginalPartNumber`, `SerialNumber`, `DiagnosticFault`, `Manufacturer`, `PartNumber`\n\n---\n\n# 📝 配置示例\n\n## 标准DIMM内存配置\n\n```json\n{\n  \"Memory\": {\n    \"SystemId\": \"${SystemId}\",\n    \"DimmNum\": \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 16 - 8)\",\n    \"Name\": \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 2 - 2) |> string.format('Memory%s40', $1)\",\n    \"DimmName\": \"${Slot} |> expr($1 * 2 - 2) |> string.format('DIMM%s40', $1)\",\n    \"Presence\": 255,\n    \""}
{"reference_id": "7", "content": "卡管理\n\n```bash\nbusctl --user introspect bmc.kepler.network_adapter /bmc/kepler/Systems/1/NetworkAdapters/0 bmc.kepler.Systems.NetworkAdapter\nNAME                    TYPE      SIGNATURE RESULT/VALUE FLAGS\n.StartRemovingDevice    method    a{ss}s    -            -\n.DumpBlackBox           method    a{ss}s    u            -\n.Reset                  method    a{ss}s    -            -\n.ID                     property  s         \"0\"          emits-change\n.Name                   property  s         \"SP580\"        emits-change\n.Model                  property  s         \"Hi1822\"       emits-change\n.TemperatureCelsius     property  n         45             emits-change\n...\n```\n\n#### 功能说明\n\n管理单个网卡的属性和操作，包括基本信息获取、健康状态监控、热插拔管理、黑匣子日志收集等。\n\n| 属性     | 内容 date: 2026/05/28
title: NPU卡Chip 1温度传感器显示异常问题分析
---
---

# 问题背景

- 单板类型：NA；
- 软件版本：NA；
- 涉及功能：传感器；
- 触发条件：更改在位状态和电源状态概率触发；注册阶段概率触发。
- 业务表现：预期传感器正常显示；实际部分传感器概率显示no reading。

# 问题复现步骤

设备持续做power cycle的操作，跑到105圈的时候，发现PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值，PCIe5 设备为Atlas 300 IDUO的NPU卡。

# 关键日志信息

传感器异常截图：
![PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值](../../images/fault/NPU_sensor_no_reading-1.png)

# 定位过程

1. 通过查看文件vpd\vendor\Huawei\Gpu\14140130_19e5d500_02000110.sr，NPU的CHIP温度传感器定义，温度从NPUCard_1.Core1TemperatureCelsius获取。

  ---
date: 2025/10/11
title: 适配一款硬件

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 为了保证该章节学习的完整性，请确保您已经完成了[《扩展对外接口》](./extend_bmc_api.md)

BMC作为一款服务器带外管理软件，差异性的硬件适配是BMC最常见的业务场景。openUBMC SDK基于自身多年经验，提供了一系列的硬件适配能力，简化硬件适配的开发流程。

本章节将介绍如何在已有的硬件适配上进行**增量开发**，用于帮助您理解硬件适配流程。具体的各类硬件适配细节，请参考[《开发指南》](../develop_guide/feature_development/board_integration.md)。

# 新增一个IPMI Sensor

一个常见的场景便是需要将硬件上的某一个器件的读值，通过IPMI协议中定义的门限传感器呈现给用户。在本章节中，我们将配置一个LM75温度器件，同时配置一个对应的IPMI门限传感器，并呈现至对外接口。

## CSR配置
openUBMC采用一种软件描述性语言描述一个硬件的具体信息，这种描述性语言被称之为Component Self-description Record(CSR)。

> [!NOTE]

title: NPU卡Chip 1温度传感器显示异常问题分析

# 问题背景

- 单板类型：NA；
- 软件版本：NA；
- 涉及功能：传感器；
- 触发条件：更改在位状态和电源状态概率触发；注册阶段概率触发。
- 业务表现：预期传感器正常显示；实际部分传感器概率显示no reading。

# 问题复现步骤

设备持续做power cycle的操作，跑到105圈的时候，发现PCIe5 Chip 1的温度传感器无读值，PCIe5 设备为Atlas 300 IDUO的NPU卡。

{"entity": "OpenSSH", "type": "artifact", "description": "OpenSSH is a widely used open-source software suite that implements the SSH (Secure Shell) protocol, providing secure remote login, file transfer, and encrypted communication over computer networks. As a free and open-source implementation of the SSH protocol, OpenSSH serves as a foundational tool for system administrators and users requiring secure access to remote systems. The suite includes a variety of utilities such as ssh (for remote login), scp and sftp (for secure file transfer), ssh-copy-id (to copy public keys), and sshd (the SSH daemon that listens for incoming connections). These tools collectively enable encrypted communication sessions between systems, preventing eavesdropping, connection hijacking, and other network-based attacks.\n\nOpenSSH is built upon cryptographic standards and relies on external libraries such as OpenSSL for underlying encryption functions. The software is maintained by the OpenBSD project and is available across various operating systems, including Linux, macOS, and Windows (via the Windows Subsystem for Linux or open-source ports). Multiple versions of OpenSSH have been released over time, with specific version numbers frequently cited in technical discussions—such as versions 8.2, 8.5p1, 8.8, 9.1, 9.5, 9.6, and 9.6p1—often in connection with security vulnerabilities and compatibility concerns. For instance, known vulnerabilities have been identified in versions ranging from 8.5p1 to 9.8p1 and in versions below 9.1, prompting users to upgrade to fixed releases like 9.6p1. The release of newer versions, including 9.5 and 9.6, reflects ongoing development and security hardening efforts, with particular attention to addressing exploits and ensuring forward compatibility.\n\nDespite its widespread adoption and strong security reputation, OpenSSH has been subject to version-specific issues, including compatibility problems on newer systems. The evolving nature of the software means that users must carefully manage versioning and updates to maintain security and functionality. OpenSSH's role as a critical component in modern cybersecurity infrastructure underscores its importance in securing networked communications, from personal remote access to enterprise-scale deployments.<SEP>OpenSSH is a standard protocol and software suite for secure remote login and file transfer, used to generate SSH public keys.<SEP>OpenSSH is an open-source implementation of the SSH protocol used for secure remote access and data transfer."}

{"entity": "sshd_config", "type": "artifact", "description": "sshd_config is the main configuration file for the SSH daemon (sshd) and the OpenSSH server, responsible for defining and controlling server-side SSH settings. Located at /etc/ssh/sshd_config, this file is essential for the proper operation of the SSH service. It governs a wide range of server behaviors, including security policies, connectivity parameters, and remote access rules. Key configurations managed through sshd_config include the ability to permit or disable root login, define allowed authentication methods, specify listening ports, and control access based on user or host. The file is used to manage runtime parameters and enforce remote login permissions, thereby playing a critical role in securing remote administrative access. As the central point of configuration for the SSH daemon, modifications to sshd_config directly influence how the server handles incoming connections and user authentication, making it a foundational element in the deployment and hardening of SSH services on Unix-like systems.<SEP>sshd_config is the primary configuration file for the SSH server, used to customize server behavior."}

{"entity": "x2openEuler", "type": "organization", "description": "x2openEuler is an open-source system migration and upgrade platform designed to facilitate the transition of operating systems, primarily from CentOS to openEuler, though it also supports upgrades from other Linux distributions including Red Hat, Oracle Linux, BCLinux, and potentially Ubuntu. It functions as a comprehensive tool suite enabling batch in-place upgrades, with specific support for versions such as CentOS 7.5, 7.6, 7.9, and 8.6, and target openEuler releases including 20.03 LTS-SP1, 22.03-SP4, and 22.03-LTS. The platform integrates environment validation, repository configuration, and hardware compatibility assessment, incorporating white list verification and system checks to ensure successful migration. It is structured around a web-based interface accessible via a portal (e.g., located at /usr/local/x2openEuler/portal), offering users task management, deployment monitoring, and upgrade logging capabilities.\n\nx2openEuler includes a dedicated backend system with database components for tracking nodes, tasks, and configurations, supporting integration with system services, SSH connectivity testing, and remote deployment. It is used in enterprise server environments and is associated with specific directories and service files, such as those under /usr/local/x2openEuler/portal/service. The platform has undergone multiple version updates, with reported versions including 2.0.0, 3.0.0 (released September 30, 2024), 3.0.0-20231230, and 20240818, all involving software package management via RPM and execution of upgrade scripts. It supports automated processes such as repository creation, dependency resolution, configuration synchronization, and service status updates during migration.\n\nDespite its functionality, x2openEuler has faced reported issues including installation failures due to conflicts with MySQL and MariaDB, dependency problems (e.g., glibc-header), SSHD service interruptions post-upgrade, and problems with repository metadata detection. Some deployments have encountered network interruptions, directory mounting errors, and connectivity issues during node import. Additionally, certain versions have exhibited instability in initialization, with challenges in startup of frontend services and API accessibility. The platform has also been associated with user accounts (e.g., for SSH operations), system environments, and specific configurations that, if mismanaged, lead to upgrade failures.\n\nx2openEuler is developed as part of the openEuler ecosystem and is linked to initiatives by Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. It serves both as a migration assessment tool, analyzing software, hardware, and configuration compatibility, and as a full deployment system for managing node connectivity, upgrade workflows, and system upgrades. While primarily focused on upgrading CentOS-based systems to openEuler, some descriptions reference it as a broader system framework applicable to various Linux distributions and environments. The platform is thus understood as a multifaceted open-source project combining tools, services, and infrastructure to enable efficient, large-scale operating system transitions within enterprise and server contexts.<SEP>x2openEuler is an environment or system used for managing node configurations and upgrades, with specific check mechanisms to validate system integrity."}

It also supports advanced system management functions, including configuration of user accounts, session parameters, and security-related settings like password complexity, trap users, and security banners. Additionally, Ipmcset can be employed to adjust system-specific operational modes, such as the cooling mode, allowing administrators to fine-tune device performance and environmental control. While some descriptions emphasize its role in network and IP configuration, others highlight its broader capabilities in system management and user security. {"entity": "OpenEuler", "type": "organization", "description": "OpenEuler is a community-driven, open-source Linux-based operating system project initiated by Huawei and hosted under the OpenAtom Foundation. It is designed primarily for enterprise, server, cloud, and edge computing environments, aiming to deliver a stable, secure, and high-performance platform across diverse hardware architectures, including x86_64, aarch64, RISC-V, and LoongArch64. The project supports a broad spectrum of use cases, such as AI, cloud-native applications, big data, industrial control, and high-performance computing. OpenEuler is developed and maintained by a global community of contributors, including developers, system integrators, and industry partners, promoting collaboration and innovation.\n\nThe operating system is known for its long-term support (LTS) releases, such as OpenEuler 22.03 LTS SP1, SP3, SP4, and OpenEuler 24.03 LTS (including SP2 and SP3), which provide stable foundations for critical enterprise deployments across industries like finance, telecommunications, energy, and logistics. It features standardized package management via RPM and supports official repositories, software centers, and community-driven build systems such as Yocto. Tools like ImageTailor enable customization of ISO images, and OpenEuler integrates seamlessly with modern DevOps workflows, including Docker, Kubernetes, and container runtimes like iSulad.\n\nSecurity and performance are central to OpenEuler’s design, with built-in support for cryptographic algorithms like SM4 and trusted computing features such as IMA (Integrity Measurement Architecture). It also offers advanced capabilities including real-time kernel variants, high availability (HA) features, and dynamic scheduling. The system is compatible with virtualization technologies like KVM and shows strong support for virtio network cards. Notable configuration details include VLAN interface naming in the format \"vlanID,\" while known limitations involve hostname restrictions (e.g., no underscores) and software-specific issues such as problems with lvmlockd, scp, and MySQL installations.\n\nWhile OpenEuler does not have an official desktop version, it is deployed in containerized environments, development systems, and as a runtime platform for applications like Zabbix, GaussDB, Samba, LDAP, and deep learning frameworks. It serves as the base for the DevStation WSL image and is used on various hardware platforms, including Huawei’s Kunpeng servers and the VisionFive RISC-V board. The ecosystem includes projects such as the iSulad container engine, Kernel COW (KCO), SysCare, and public repositories on Gitee hosting tools like Gala-Gopher and the lcr project. The community maintains forums, documentation, and Special Interest Groups (SIGs) covering topics such as RFO and security.\n\nOpenEuler provides migration paths from legacy systems like CentOS and supports multiple deployment methods, including PXE, kickstart, and cloud images on platforms like Aliyun. Tools such as X2openeuler and forklift-like interfaces facilitate system upgrades, though some users have reported issues with SSH configuration changes and compatibility. Although primarily server-focused, the project includes active discussions on building a desktop ecosystem and expanding into embedded and industrial scenarios. Positioned as a key driver in China’s push for domestic IT infrastructure, OpenEuler stands as a leading open-source platform within the global Linux ecosystem."}

{"reference_id": "9", "content": "有效，否则为 0） |\n| DeleteSSHPublicKey | - | - | 删除 SSH 公钥 | 无 |\n| SetLastLogin | ss | y | 记录用户上次登录信息（第三方认证调用） | s: 上次登录 IP<br>s: 上次登录接口<br>出参：<br>y: 处理结果（0 成功） |\n| VerifyPassword | s | - | 校验用户密码 | s: 需要校验的密码字符串，最长 512 字符 |\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值类型    | 含义         | 触发条件     | 处理建议                 |\n| :------------ | :----------- | :----------- | :----------------------- |\n| kepler.account.PasswordComplexityCheckFail | 修改密码失败 | 新密码不满足复杂度要求 | 使用满足复杂度要求的密码 |\n| kepler.account.InvalidPasswordSameWithHistory | 修改密码失败 | 新密码与历史密码相同 | 更换新密码 |\n| kepler.account.PasswordNeedReset | 修改密码失败 | 用户首次登录需强制改密 | 先完成强制改密 |\n| kepler.account.IncorrectPublicKeyFormat | 导入公钥失败 | 公钥格式不正确 | 使用正确的 SSH 公钥文件 |\n| - | 操作成功 | NA | NA |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- Web 端修改用户密码、删除用户、管理 SSH 公钥\n- CDN/第三方认证登录后回写用户上次登录 IP 与接口\n- Web 前端登录时校验密码（VerifyPassword）\n\n#### 限制条件\n\n- `ChangePwd`/`ChangeSnmpPwd` 的密码为 `ay` 字节数组，总线上不出现明文\n- 修改密码会触发密码复杂度、弱口令字典、历史密码、用户名密码前缀比对等全量策略校验\n- 删除用户时，若用户为`内置用户`（如管理员、trapv3 用户、OEM 存储的底层用户等）会根据 `AccountPolicy.Deletable` 与删除保护规则失败\n- `ImportSSHPublicKey` 的 `URI` 参数支持远程地址或本地绝对 `.pub` 文件路径；本地文件应置于 `/tmp` 目录。`Text` 参数必须是完整的 OpenSSH 公钥文本（例如以 `ssh-rsa` 开头的单行公钥），不能使用截断示例或私钥内容\n\n#### 调试示例\n\n##### 命令行调试\n\n```bash\n# 参数说明：<账号ID> 为待操作的目标账号 ID；<当前密码> 与 <新密码> 替换为该账号的实际密码。\n# 1. VerifyPassword：校验指定账号的当前密码。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nVerifyPassword a{ss}s 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 <当前密码>\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 2. SetLastLogin：记录最后登录 IP 与接口。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nSetLastLogin a{ss}ss 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 127.0.0.1 Web\n\n# 预期响应：y 0\n\n# 3. ChangePwd：设置新密码 Xyz@2026AB；ay 长度为 10。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nChangePwd a{ss}ay 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 10 88 121 122 64 50 48 50 54 65 66\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 3.1 VerifyPassword：用新密码回读确认 ChangePwd 生效。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nVerifyPassword a{ss}s 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 Xyz@2026AB\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 4. ChangeSnmpPwd：设置 SNMP 密码 Snmp@2026AB；ay 长度为 11。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nChangeSnmpPwd a{ss}ay 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 11 83 110 109 112 64 50 48 50 54 65 66\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 5. ImportSSHPublicKey：将完整 OpenSSH 测试公钥预先传至远程 /tmp/account_it_pem_key.pub，再按 URI 导入。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService"}
