{"entity": "Password", "type": "data", "description": "Password is a secret, confidential string used as a security credential to authenticate user identity across a wide range of systems and services. It serves as a fundamental authentication mechanism, required for accessing systems, accounts, and network resources, including but not limited to the CLA Management System, PostgreSQL user accounts, BMC systems, remote machines, VNC access, SSH connections, FTP servers, proxy or repository access, and system upgrade operations. The password is typically used in conjunction with a username, forming a dual-factor authentication pair when required, and is essential for verifying identity during login processes, license installation, and remote virtual image access. \n\nIn specific technical contexts, Password is implemented as a string parameter, byte array (U8[]), or array of U8 values within various application programming interfaces and configuration settings, used in methods such as SetPassword, VerifyPassword, NewAccount, ChangePassword, and DeleteAccount. It appears as a required or optional input field, with null values indicating that no password is needed or that encryption is not in use. For instance, when CertificateType is set to PKCS12, the Password field is required to decrypt the certificate file, and an empty or null password indicates an unencrypted certificate. Similarly, in the context of PKCS12 files, the password secures the private key and is mandatory for its decryption.\n\nPassword is often masked in user interfaces—for example, displayed as asterisks (******) or dots (••••••) in login fields or configuration panels—to protect user confidentiality. It is a field used in HTTP request bodies (e.g., in PATCH requests) to set or retrieve authentication credentials, such as for USBMgmtService configuration or VNC access. Some implementations treat the password as an optional field when the associated resource is not encrypted, while others mandate it for system security. The length of the password is sometimes limited, with one source indicating a maximum of 20 characters.\n\nThere are specific instances where the Password credential is system-defined, such as the default password 'openeuler@2023' for a PostgreSQL user or a default 'admin' value in certain contexts. In some cases, the password is a predefined value not provided at setup, such as for a pre-created openGauss user. Additionally, the Password may also serve as a component in cryptographic operations, such as decrypting certificates or protecting private keys in PKCS12 files, and is used in SNMP v3 for user authentication. \n\nDescriptive inconsistencies are minimal but include variance in default values and flexibility in whether the field is required. These differences are context-specific, reflecting distinct system requirements rather than contradictions in the core definition. Overall, Password remains a universally recognized, variable-length, secret string that enables authentication across diverse systems and protocols, with implementation nuances tailored to security, usability, and compliance needs.<SEP>Password is the authentication credential used in conjunction with username to access the BMC."}

{"entity": "Virtual Machine", "type": "artifact", "description": "Virtual Machine refers to a software-based emulation of a physical computer system, functioning as a simulated computing environment that runs on a host machine. It is a virtualized computing environment capable of hosting one or more operating systems and applications in isolation, enabling the execution of multiple guest operating systems such as openEuler, CentOS 7.9, Ubuntu 24.04, and others on a single physical machine. Virtual Machines are created using hypervisors or virtualization platforms such as VirtualBox, VMware Workstation, Parallels Desktop, Azure, Aliyun ECS, and QEMU, and are often managed through tools like the VirtualBox Manager or hosted on servers such as the Tian Gong Server TG225 B1. They are extensively used for testing, development, and system upgrades—specifically for processes such as openEuler kernel hot upgrades, system installation, and migration—where isolated environments prevent interference with production systems. Instances have been reported where Virtual Machines hosted openEuler 20.03 SP4, 22.03 SP3, 23.09, 24.03, and 24.03-LTS-SP1, with some exhibiting boot anomalies after unexpected shutdowns or issues with the Zabbix-Agent and command-line interface. Configurations in these environments include settings for CPU mode, memory allocation, and network topology, such as the use of NAT network cards or additional network interfaces for configuration. Virtual Machines are utilized in diverse contexts, from running OpenEuler DevStation and testing upgrade processes to supporting experiments, compiling kernels, and isolating software environments. They are also recommended to mitigate deployment risks when installing tools like x2openEuler. Notably, some Virtual Machines are created from disk images such as qcow2 files and can be deployed within specific infrastructures like H3C’s hyper-converged systems or the Euler operating system. While most descriptions emphasize their role in isolated execution and virtualization, one entry mentions a virtual machine being proposed for openEuler experiments but ultimately rejected due to hardware product requirements, indicating contextual variability. Overall, Virtual Machines serve as software-based representations of physical computers, enabling flexible, scalable, and secure computing environments across research, testing, and deployment scenarios.<SEP>A virtual machine is a method used to run Ubuntu 24.04 on Windows systems.<SEP>Virtual Machine is a software-based emulation of a computer system, in this context referring to the QEMU virtual environment.<SEP>A virtual machine is a software-based computing environment that emulates a physical computer, used here to host legacy systems.<SEP>A virtual machine is a software-based emulation of a physical computer, used here to host CentOS 6.8 systems during migration."}

{"entity": "Public", "type": "partition", "description": "Public is a sub-namespace, subcategory, or section within the Oem (Original Equipment Manufacturer) object in the Redfish API, serving as a standardized container for publicly accessible, non-proprietary, and user-configurable data and settings. It is consistently described as a designated area within the Oem structure that holds information intended to be accessible to all users without privilege restrictions. This includes a wide range of data types such as system configuration settings, firmware-specific data, status and diagnostic information, certificate settings for the CertificateService, operational results, and drive-related properties and configurations. Public is used to expose vendor-specific configurations in a transparent and standardized way, particularly for network adapters, bridges, processors, power converters, and storage components. It supports general-purpose parameters, including HotPlugAttention, PreloadPortCount, bandwidth usage, switch connections, and task-related metadata like TaskPercentage. The field is employed across multiple contexts, including log entries, resource hierarchies, and dynamic settings, often used to define publicly visible attributes or actions accessible via API responses. Public is also recognized as a namespace or extension within Redfish paths, designed to separate non-proprietary from restricted data and to facilitate interoperability. Some descriptions reference Public as a user folder or directory within the PSR structure for shared file access, while others indicate it serves as a top-level container under Oem for publicly exposed actions, such as vendor-specific tasks or operations. Though multiple descriptions emphasize its role in hosting non-proprietary, observable, and generally configurable data, there is a consistent alignment on Public's function as a designated, open-access section within Oem, ensuring visibility and standardization of vendor-defined information in public APIs.<SEP>Public is an OEM extension namespace containing public configuration options for the manager.<SEP>Public is a subcategory under Oem for publicly accessible OEM extensions and commands.<SEP>Public is a namespace within Oem used for publicly accessible actions.<SEP>Public refers to a vendor-specific namespace within the Oem section of Redfish.<SEP>Public is a namespace under Oem used to expose vendor-specific actions that are publicly accessible.<SEP>Public is a partition within the Oem space that exposes certain firmware settings to public access."}

{"reference_id": "4", "content": "有效，否则为 0） |\n| DeleteSSHPublicKey | - | - | 删除 SSH 公钥 | 无 |\n| SetLastLogin | ss | y | 记录用户上次登录信息（第三方认证调用） | s: 上次登录 IP<br>s: 上次登录接口<br>出参：<br>y: 处理结果（0 成功） |\n| VerifyPassword | s | - | 校验用户密码 | s: 需要校验的密码字符串，最长 512 字符 |\n\n#### 返回值与异常\n\n| 返回值类型    | 含义         | 触发条件     | 处理建议                 |\n| :------------ | :----------- | :----------- | :----------------------- |\n| kepler.account.PasswordComplexityCheckFail | 修改密码失败 | 新密码不满足复杂度要求 | 使用满足复杂度要求的密码 |\n| kepler.account.InvalidPasswordSameWithHistory | 修改密码失败 | 新密码与历史密码相同 | 更换新密码 |\n| kepler.account.PasswordNeedReset | 修改密码失败 | 用户首次登录需强制改密 | 先完成强制改密 |\n| kepler.account.IncorrectPublicKeyFormat | 导入公钥失败 | 公钥格式不正确 | 使用正确的 SSH 公钥文件 |\n| - | 操作成功 | NA | NA |\n\n#### 应用场景\n\n- Web 端修改用户密码、删除用户、管理 SSH 公钥\n- CDN/第三方认证登录后回写用户上次登录 IP 与接口\n- Web 前端登录时校验密码（VerifyPassword）\n\n#### 限制条件\n\n- `ChangePwd`/`ChangeSnmpPwd` 的密码为 `ay` 字节数组，总线上不出现明文\n- 修改密码会触发密码复杂度、弱口令字典、历史密码、用户名密码前缀比对等全量策略校验\n- 删除用户时，若用户为`内置用户`（如管理员、trapv3 用户、OEM 存储的底层用户等）会根据 `AccountPolicy.Deletable` 与删除保护规则失败\n- `ImportSSHPublicKey` 的 `URI` 参数支持远程地址或本地绝对 `.pub` 文件路径；本地文件应置于 `/tmp` 目录。`Text` 参数必须是完整的 OpenSSH 公钥文本（例如以 `ssh-rsa` 开头的单行公钥），不能使用截断示例或私钥内容\n\n#### 调试示例\n\n##### 命令行调试\n\n```bash\n# 参数说明：<账号ID> 为待操作的目标账号 ID；<当前密码> 与 <新密码> 替换为该账号的实际密码。\n# 1. VerifyPassword：校验指定账号的当前密码。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nVerifyPassword a{ss}s 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 <当前密码>\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 2. SetLastLogin：记录最后登录 IP 与接口。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nSetLastLogin a{ss}ss 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 127.0.0.1 Web\n\n# 预期响应：y 0\n\n# 3. ChangePwd：设置新密码 Xyz@2026AB；ay 长度为 10。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nChangePwd a{ss}ay 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 10 88 121 122 64 50 48 50 54 65 66\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 3.1 VerifyPassword：用新密码回读确认 ChangePwd 生效。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nVerifyPassword a{ss}s 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 Xyz@2026AB\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 4. ChangeSnmpPwd：设置 SNMP 密码 Snmp@2026AB；ay 长度为 11。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService.ManagerAccount \\\nChangeSnmpPwd a{ss}ay 4 Interface CLI UserName <当前登录管理员> ClientAddr 127.0.0.1 Privilege 16 11 83 110 109 112 64 50 48 50 54 65 66\n\n# 预期响应：无输出。\n\n# 5. ImportSSHPublicKey：将完整 OpenSSH 测试公钥预先传至远程 /tmp/account_it_pem_key.pub，再按 URI 导入。\nbusctl --user call bmc.kepler.account \\\n/bmc/kepler/AccountService/Accounts/<账号ID> bmc.kepler.AccountService"}

{"reference_id": "8", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 385,\r\n  \"question\": \"openeuler20.3LTS 系统启动问题 - 当我在vmware workstation中安装完成openeuler20.3LTS后，由于不确定的原因导致系统在启动时直接进入grub命令行。当我修复并重新生成grub.cfg文件后，重启服务器，此时又有新的报错出现，如下图。\\n\\n需要输入用户名和密码，但是我并没有设置过grub的密码啊，diskfiler文件被禁止写入，该问题无法解决！！！！求支持！\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"Tianm\",\r\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\r\n  \"reply_posts\": [\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Tianm\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/385/2\",\r\n      \"text\": \"content: image1073×516 79.1 KB\\nlinks: [图片: OpenEuler2003SP1 - VMware Workstation  \\n文件(F) 编辑(E) 查看(V) 虚拟机(M) 选项卡(T) 帮助(H)  \\n主页 anshu 我的计算机 OpenEuler2003SP1  \\n在此处键入内容进行搜索  \\n创建文件夹  \\n[部分模糊化内容]  \\nanshu  \\nOpenEuler2003SP1  \\n请将输入定向到该虚拟机，请在虚拟机内部单击或按 Ctrl+G。  \\nerror: .../grub-core/disk/diskfilter.c:917:diskfilter writes are not supported.  \\nEnter username:  \\nEnter password:  \\nEnter username:  \\nroot  \\nEnter password:  \\nEnter username:  \\nroot  \\nEnter password:  \\nEnter username:  \\nEnter password:  \\nEnter username:  \\n-]\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Shoppingcao\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/385/3\",\r\n      \"text\": \"grub的用户名和密码为root，openEuler#12\"\r\n    }\r\n  ]\r\n}"}

{"reference_id": "2", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 1401,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler应用入门 05 - 搭建FTP服务器 - content: openEuler应用入门目录：\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 - 前言\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 01 - 安装openEuler操作系统\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 02 -  使用FinalShell连接服务器\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 03 - 搭建本地DNF源仓库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 04 - 安装DDE图形界面\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 05 - 搭建FTP服务器\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 06 -  搭建Windows文件共享服务\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 07 - 搭建本地Docker镜像仓\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 08 - 在服务器使用Docker\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 09 - 使用Nginx\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 10 - 使用WPS\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 11- 安装openGuass数据库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 12- 连接openGuass数据库\\n\\nopenEuler应用入门 13- 使用防火墙\\n\\n注：本节内容大部分来自官网文档。因官网文档所用的版本有点滞后，请阅读时注意。\\n\\n搭建FTP服务器\\n\\n总体介绍\\nFTP简介\\nFTP（File Transfer Protocol）即文件传输协议，是互联网最早的传输协议之一，其最主要的功能是服务器和客户端之间的文件传输。FTP使用户可以通过一套标准的命令访问远程系统上的文件，而不需要直接登录远程系统。另外，FTP服务器还提供了如下主要功能：\\n用户分类\\n默认情况下，FTP服务器依据登录情况，将用户分为实体用户（real user）、访客（guest）、匿名用户（anonymous）三类。三类用户对系统的访问权限差异较大，实体用户具有较完整的访问权限，匿名用户仅有下载资源的权限。\\n命令记录和日志文件记录\\nFTP可以利用系统的syslogd记录数据，这些数据包括用户历史使用命令与用户传输数据（传输时间、文件大小等），用户可以在/var/log/中获得各项日志信息。\\n限制用户的访问范围\\nFTP可以将用户的工作范围限定在用户主目录。用户通过FTP登录后系统显示的根目录就是用户主目录，这种环境被称为change root，简称chroot。这种方式可以限制用户只能访问主目录，而不允许访问/etc、/home、/usr/local等系统的重要目录，从而保护系统，使系统更安全。\\nFTP 使用到的端口\\nFTP的正常工作需要使用到多个网络端口，服务器端会使用到的端口主要有：\\n命令通道，默认端口为21\\n数据通道，默认端口为20\\n两者的连接发起端不同，端口21主要接收来自客户端的连接，端口20则是FTP服务器主动连接至客户端。\\nvsftpd 简介\\n由于FTP历史悠久，它采用未加密的传输方式，所以被认为是一种不安全的协议。为了更安全地使用FTP，这里介绍FTP较为安全的守护进程vsftpd（Very Secure FTPDaemon）。\\n之所以说vsftpd安全，是因为它最初的发展理念就是构建一个以安全为中心的FTP服务器。它具有如下特点：\\nvsftpd服务的启动身份为一般用户，具有较低的系统权限。此外，vsftpd使用chroot改变根目录，不会误用系统工具。\\n任何需要较高执行权限的vsftpd命令均由一个特殊的上层程序控制，该上层程序的权限较低，以不影响系统本身为准。\\nvsftpd整合了大部分FTP会使用到的额外命令（例如dir、ls、cd等），一般不需要系统提供额外命令，对系统来说比较安全。\\nvsftpd服务支持三种用户模式。\\n匿名用户\\n默认VSFTP是支持匿名用户的，该用户登录FTP服务使用anonymous用户直接登录，不需要输入密码。\\n系统用户\\n可以使用Linux系统本身存在的用户，作为FTP用户，具体哪些用户可以登录FTP，可以通过配置文件指定。\\n虚拟用户\\n虚拟用户的特点是只能访问服务器为其提供的FTP服务，而不能访问系统的其它资源。所以，如果想让用户对FTP服务器站内具有写权限，但又不允许访问系统其它资源，可以使用虚拟用户来提高系统的安全性。\\n\\n安装 vsftpd\\n安装 vsftpd\\n使用vsftpd需要安装vsftpd软件，在已经配置dnf源的情况下，通过root权限执行如下命令，即可完成vsftpd的安装。\\n如果已经安装了DDE图形界面，并且在图形界面中登录，可以打开“终端”输入以下命令。\\n#dnf install vsftpd -y\\n如果在系统安装时己经选择了“FTP服务器”，则输入命令并回车后，会提示vsftpd己安装，不需要再安装了。\\n管理 vsftpd\\n启动、停止和重启vsftpd服务，请在root权限下执行对应命令。\\n启动vsftpd服务\\n#systemctl start vsftpd\\n可以通过netstat命令查看通信端口21是否开启，如下显示说明vsftpd已经启动。\\n#netstat -tulnp grep 21\\"}
{"reference_id": "3", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 667,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler 系统安装问题 - 问题描述：openEuler 系统安装的时候报python3问题，截图如下。\\n\\n解决方法：清理所有硬盘，重新安装。\\n从硬盘尾清理数据：\\ndd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=512 seek=$(( $(blockdev --getsz /dev/sda) -630 )) count=630\\n\\n从硬盘头清理数据：\\ndd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=512 count=630\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"Sunny\",\r\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\r\n  \"reply_posts\": []\r\n}"}
{"reference_id": "4", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 7346,\r\n  \"question\": \"安装欧拉openEuler-24.03-LTS-SP1-everything-x86_64-dvd - content: 微信图片_20250403111112939×320 175 KB\\n这个报错是什么鬼，已经在虚拟机安装都没问题，拿到物理机装就有问题\\nlinks: [图片: (anacomda:2502): Gtk-WARNING **: 10:50:46.659: Can't show Caps Lock warning, since sec\\nEntering debugger...\\nUse 'continue' command to quit the debugger and get back to the main window\\n> /usr/lib/python3.11/site-packages/dnf/base.py(2721)_select_remote_pkgs()\\n-> raise dnf.exceptions.Error(\\n(Pdb)]\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"Routsky\",\r\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\r\n  \"reply_posts\": []\r\n}"}
{"reference_id": "5", "content": "{\n  \"topic_id\": 19146,\n  \"question\": \"openEuler 2509 devStation 安装tcpdump 失败。 - Downloading Packages:\\ntcpdump-4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64.rpm                                                           1.2 MB/s | 504 kB     00:00    \\n-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\nTotal                                                                                        323 kB/s | 504 kB     00:01     \\nRunning transaction check\\nTransaction check succeeded.\\nRunning transaction test\\nTransaction test succeeded.\\nRunning transaction\\n  Preparing        :                                                                                                     1/1 \\n  Running scriptlet: tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64                                                                   1/1 \\n错误：%prein(tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64) 脚本执行失败，退出状态码为 6\\n\\nError in PREIN scriptlet in rpm package tcpdump\\n  Verifying        : tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64                                                                   1/1 \\n\\nFailed:\\n  tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64                                                                                          \\n\\nError: Transaction failed\\n\\n系统信息：\\n$ cat /etc/openEuler-release \\nopenEuler release 25.09\\n$ uname -a\\nLinux hw-pc 6.6.0-102.0.0.8.oe2509.x86_64 #1 SMP Tue Sep 23 19:58:30 CST 2025 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux\\n\\n怎解？\",\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"xiejirong\",\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\n  \"reply_posts\": [\n    {\n      \"user_name\": \"yanzhicong\",\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\n      \"is_solution\": false,\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/19146/2\",\n      \"text\": \"① 是使用 root 用户安装的吗\\n② 看一下系统的 GID，72 是不是被占用了\\npre-install 脚本看起来就创建一个 tcpdump 组和用户：\\n%pre\\nuser_id=$(id -u tcpdump 2> /dev/null)\\n\\nif [ \\\"_${user_id}\\\" = \\\"_\\\" ]; then\\n    # check and create group tcpdump first\\n    if ! getent group tcpdump &> /dev/null; then\\n     /usr/sbin/groupadd -g 72 tcpdump 2> /dev/null\\n    fi\\n    # group tcpdump may created by other, id is not sure\\n    /usr/sbin/useradd -r -u 72 -g tcpdump -d /home/tcpdump -M -s /sbin/nologin tcpdump 2> /dev/null\\nfi\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"user_name\": \"xiejirong\",\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\n      \"is_solution\": false,\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/19146/3\",\n      \"text\": \"首先，肯定是使用root用户执行软件安装。\\n其次，我查了， /etc/passwd, group 两个文件中均未有uid,gid为72的用户或组名称。另外，在ubuntu下看到，用户或组号是 95，这种专用的用户或组号，是各发行版自己定义的吗？\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"}

{"reference_id": "8", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 6874,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler 24.03 LTS 下 emacs 打包得有问题？ - openEuler 24.03 LTS 安装了 emacs，使用中大量出现此类错误：\\nerror in process filter: Wrong type argument: stringp, (require . china-util) \\nerror in process filter: Wrong type argument: stringp, nil\\n导致 c, python, 等语言 mode 都不能使用。\\n是不是打包文件出现错误了吗？相对而言，el源码包不应该会出现错误啊。\\nemacs-version 29.1\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/2\",\r\n  \"reply_posts\": [\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": true,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/2\",\r\n      \"text\": \"自己去下载一个，从源代码开始安装就没有问题，顺带下载了最新版本 29.4，应该不是版本的问题。\\n编译Emacs需要 makeinfo，该文件在 texinfo 包中；需要 gif图形库 ~giflib-devel~ 。\\n\\n#+begin_src sh\\n  dnf install ncurses-devel libXt-devel libXpm-devel libXaw-devel gnutls-devel tcl-devel\\n  dnf install giflib-devel texinfo\\n  ./configure --without-pop\\n  make bootstrap # 检查更多测试项\\n#+end_src\\n\\n初，编译失败，使用命令 ~make bootstrap~ 查知，似乎缺少 makeinfo，在 texinfo 包中有。\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/3\",\r\n      \"text\": \"上述安装、编译，缺少 json 支持，在 elisp 下，求值 (json-available-p) 为假。\\n可在编译前，再安装库 json-c-devel 解决。\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Fundawang\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/4\",\r\n      \"text\": \"你是说系统自带的 emacs 有问题吗？\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/5\",\r\n      \"text\": \"是的。 24.03 LTS 默认源， dnf install emacs 安装的。 c-mode 下还有什么符号输不进去，也是因为触发命令出现上述错误。\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/6\",\r\n      \"text\": \"系统打包问题，在 openEuler 25.09 DevStation 中仍然有问题。\"\r\n    }\r\n  ]\r\n}"}

{"entity": "Installation Failure", "type": "event", "description": "Installation Failure is a multifaceted issue that manifests across various software and system deployment scenarios. It refers to the unsuccessful deployment of an operating system on a hardware platform, particularly observed in certain openEuler versions installed on the FT-D2000 architecture. This phenomenon is also documented in the context of the 2020年昭阳E53-80 (Zhaoyang E53-80, 2020 model), where the installation of OpenEuler 2403 fails in both character and graphical modes, indicating potential compatibility or driver-level issues. Technical difficulties such as missing parameters, unresolved dependencies, or system conflicts are known to contribute to installation failure, especially in the case of NVIDIA GPU drivers, which fail to install due to these underlying problems. Furthermore, the term applies to cases involving the Open Build Service, where the deployment process cannot complete due to persistent, unresolved errors, suggesting infrastructure or configuration-level barriers. Installation Failure also occurs during the installation of advanced operations and maintenance packages, where the failure to install the package or its dependencies halts the process. In some instances, the failure is silent—no error messages are provided, complicating diagnostic efforts. Additionally, installation failure is triggered when a GPL-incompatible module attempts to use a symbol exclusively available under the GPL license, preventing the module from being loaded and thereby disrupting system operations. The varied contexts—ranging from OS deployment on specific hardware platforms to software package installation and kernel module loading—indicate that Installation Failure is not a singular event but an umbrella term for diverse technical failures, often stemming from compatibility, licensing, or system configuration conflicts. Despite these differing causes, the core characteristic is consistent: the inability to complete a software or system installation process successfully.<SEP>Installation Failure is an occurrence where the software installation process does not complete successfully."}

{"entity": "Error", "type": "concept", "description": "Error is a multifaceted concept and technical construct used across software systems, programming languages, and operational environments to signify a failure or issue during execution. As a log level, Error denotes a critical failure that must halt current processing and propagate the issue, typically assigned the numerical value 2 within logging systems, and is used to report system failures such as missing commands, invalid version flags (e.g., \"if\"), or invalid file paths. It consistently represents a failure state requiring immediate attention, including during system upgrades, where it may indicate package conflicts, missing files, or configuration issues, and in installation contexts, where it arises due to missing dependencies or failed driver loading, such as when the Localbus driver fails to load due to service dependencies.\n\nIn API and system response design, Error functions as a structured response field or component that indicates any failure encountered during command execution, request processing, or operation. It typically includes a code, a human-readable message, and extended information—sometimes nested response data—to provide context for troubleshooting. This structure is used across various contexts, such as in execution of the ipmcget command, during authentication attempts (when credentials are missing), or in the event of a failed attempt to download an upgrade package. In some systems, Error signifies a general or specific issue detected during operation, including failures in log retrieval, invalid configuration, or runtime exceptions such as those occurring in a Kubernetes container when a runtime error is encountered.\n\nError also describes a failure condition in broader operational workflows, such as a failed build chain that halts due to a single error state, or during BIOS version validation, where a version number is read as empty despite being reported. In package management systems like DNF, Error is used to signal exceptions during package selection due to failures in remote resolution. In programming environments, particularly in Rust, Error can be a custom error type defined via libraries such as snafu, which supports standardized error handling with contextual information and backtrace support, enabling robust and traceable failure reporting.\n\nFrom a conceptual standpoint, Error serves as a general representation of any failure condition in software development, including misconfiguration, system issues, or invalid operations. It is consistently applied as a label for technical issues or system failures and operates as an indicator across diverse layers—from low-level logging, to high-level API responses, and to structured event handling in distributed systems. The multiple descriptions collectively reflect a rich yet coherent use of the term \"Error\" as both a systemic failure state and a structured mechanism for capturing, communicating, and resolving problems across software and infrastructure environments.<SEP>Error is a built-in Lua function used to raise runtime errors.<SEP>An error is a condition that prevents a system or software from functioning as expected."}
{"entity": "rsync", "type": "artifact", "description": "rsync is a widely used, open-source software utility designed for efficient file synchronization and data transfer between two locations, typically across a network or between local directories. It is commonly employed in system administration, backup workflows, and software deployment, particularly for copying and synchronizing files and directories with minimal bandwidth usage. The tool operates via a command-line interface and is known for its delta-transfer algorithm, which transfers only the differences between files, enhancing performance over slow or unreliable connections. rsync plays a critical role in the x2openEuler-upgrade process, where it is required to synchronize dnf core files and other system components during the upgrade. The upgrade process has a minimum version requirement of 3.1.0, and conflicts have been reported when the installed version (such as 3.0.9) is outdated, underscoring the importance of version compatibility. Beyond system upgrades, rsync is also utilized in source code management and distribution across development environments, facilitating reliable and efficient transfer of codebases between systems. Due to its reliability and efficiency, rsync is regarded as a foundational tool in Unix-like operating systems and is often integrated into automated scripts and deployment pipelines."}

{"reference_id": "5", "content": "{\n  \"topic_id\": 19146,\n  \"question\": \"openEuler 2509 devStation 安装tcpdump 失败。 - Downloading Packages:\\ntcpdump-4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64.rpm                                                           1.2 MB/s | 504 kB     00:00    \\n-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\nTotal                                                                                        323 kB/s | 504 kB     00:01     \\nRunning transaction check\\nTransaction check succeeded.\\nRunning transaction test\\nTransaction test succeeded.\\nRunning transaction\\n  Preparing        :                                                                                                     1/1 \\n  Running scriptlet: tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64                                                                   1/1 \\n错误：%prein(tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64) 脚本执行失败，退出状态码为 6\\n\\nError in PREIN scriptlet in rpm package tcpdump\\n  Verifying        : tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64                                                                   1/1 \\n\\nFailed:\\n  tcpdump-14:4.99.5-1.oe2509.x86_64                                                                                          \\n\\nError: Transaction failed\\n\\n系统信息：\\n$ cat /etc/openEuler-release \\nopenEuler release 25.09\\n$ uname -a\\nLinux hw-pc 6.6.0-102.0.0.8.oe2509.x86_64 #1 SMP Tue Sep 23 19:58:30 CST 2025 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux\\n\\n怎解？\",\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"xiejirong\",\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\n  \"reply_posts\": [\n    {\n      \"user_name\": \"yanzhicong\",\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\n      \"is_solution\": false,\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/19146/2\",\n      \"text\": \"① 是使用 root 用户安装的吗\\n② 看一下系统的 GID，72 是不是被占用了\\npre-install 脚本看起来就创建一个 tcpdump 组和用户：\\n%pre\\nuser_id=$(id -u tcpdump 2> /dev/null)\\n\\nif [ \\\"_${user_id}\\\" = \\\"_\\\" ]; then\\n    # check and create group tcpdump first\\n    if ! getent group tcpdump &> /dev/null; then\\n     /usr/sbin/groupadd -g 72 tcpdump 2> /dev/null\\n    fi\\n    # group tcpdump may created by other, id is not sure\\n    /usr/sbin/useradd -r -u 72 -g tcpdump -d /home/tcpdump -M -s /sbin/nologin tcpdump 2> /dev/null\\nfi\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"user_name\": \"xiejirong\",\n      \"topic_closed\": null,\n      \"is_solution\": false,\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/19146/3\",\n      \"text\": \"首先，肯定是使用root用户执行软件安装。\\n其次，我查了， /etc/passwd, group 两个文件中均未有uid,gid为72的用户或组名称。另外，在ubuntu下看到，用户或组号是 95，这种专用的用户或组号，是各发行版自己定义的吗？\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"}

{"reference_id": "7", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 6874,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler 24.03 LTS 下 emacs 打包得有问题？ - openEuler 24.03 LTS 安装了 emacs，使用中大量出现此类错误：\\nerror in process filter: Wrong type argument: stringp, (require . china-util) \\nerror in process filter: Wrong type argument: stringp, nil\\n导致 c, python, 等语言 mode 都不能使用。\\n是不是打包文件出现错误了吗？相对而言，el源码包不应该会出现错误啊。\\nemacs-version 29.1\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/2\",\r\n  \"reply_posts\": [\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": true,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/2\",\r\n      \"text\": \"自己去下载一个，从源代码开始安装就没有问题，顺带下载了最新版本 29.4，应该不是版本的问题。\\n编译Emacs需要 makeinfo，该文件在 texinfo 包中；需要 gif图形库 ~giflib-devel~ 。\\n\\n#+begin_src sh\\n  dnf install ncurses-devel libXt-devel libXpm-devel libXaw-devel gnutls-devel tcl-devel\\n  dnf install giflib-devel texinfo\\n  ./configure --without-pop\\n  make bootstrap # 检查更多测试项\\n#+end_src\\n\\n初，编译失败，使用命令 ~make bootstrap~ 查知，似乎缺少 makeinfo，在 texinfo 包中有。\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/3\",\r\n      \"text\": \"上述安装、编译，缺少 json 支持，在 elisp 下，求值 (json-available-p) 为假。\\n可在编译前，再安装库 json-c-devel 解决。\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Fundawang\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/4\",\r\n      \"text\": \"你是说系统自带的 emacs 有问题吗？\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/5\",\r\n      \"text\": \"是的。 24.03 LTS 默认源， dnf install emacs 安装的。 c-mode 下还有什么符号输不进去，也是因为触发命令出现上述错误。\"\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      \"user_name\": \"Xie Jirong\",\r\n      \"topic_closed\": true,\r\n      \"is_solution\": false,\r\n      \"post_url\": \"/t/topic/6874/6\",\r\n      \"text\": \"系统打包问题，在 openEuler 25.09 DevStation 中仍然有问题。\"\r\n    }\r\n  ]\r\n}"}
{"reference_id": "8", "content": "{\r\n  \"topic_id\": 667,\r\n  \"question\": \"openEuler 系统安装问题 - 问题描述：openEuler 系统安装的时候报python3问题，截图如下。\\n\\n解决方法：清理所有硬盘，重新安装。\\n从硬盘尾清理数据：\\ndd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=512 seek=$(( $(blockdev --getsz /dev/sda) -630 )) count=630\\n\\n从硬盘头清理数据：\\ndd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=512 count=630\",\r\n  \"topic_user_name\": \"Sunny\",\r\n  \"best_answer_url\": \"\",\r\n  \"reply_posts\": []\r\n}"}

  "question": "openEuler 系统安装问题 - 问题描述：openEuler 系统安装的时候报python3问题，截图如下。\n\n解决方法：清理所有硬盘，重新安装。\n从硬盘尾清理数据：\ndd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=512 seek=$(( $(blockdev --getsz /dev/sda) -630 )) count=630\n\n从硬盘头清理数据：\ndd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda bs=512 count=630",
